把烧煤得到的热变成机械功的第一种实用热机，点燃了工业革命。: The first practical heat engine to turn the heat from burning coal into mechanical work, helping launch the Industrial Revolution.
水变成蒸汽时体积膨胀约 1700 倍，蒸汽遇冷又会凝结成水、留下真空——让这一胀: When water turns into steam, its volume expands by about 1700 times. When the steam cools, it condenses back into water, leaving a vacuum—this expansion and contraction push the piston, converting the heat from burning coal into mechanical work ([[p:energy|conservation of energy]], [[p:phase|phase change]]).
锅炉烧水产生蒸汽，蒸汽进入气缸推动活塞。早期的纽科门机靠往气缸里喷冷水让蒸汽凝结: The boiler heats water to produce steam, which enters the cylinder to push the piston. Early Newcomen engines relied on spraying cold water into the cylinder to condense the steam; atmospheric pressure then pushed the piston back, and a beam connected to it drove the water pump.
问题是气缸每次都被冷水浇凉，下一次进蒸汽时大量热量白白用来重新加热缸体。瓦特的改: The problem was that the cylinder was cooled with cold water each time, so when steam entered again, much of the heat was wasted reheating the cylinder. Watt's improvement added a **separate condenser**: the used steam was directed into another container kept constantly cold to condense, while the cylinder remained hot. Later, a crank converted the reciprocating motion into rotation, and a centrifugal governor automatically stabilized the speed (see [[centrifugal-governor]]).
1712 年英国铁匠纽科门（Thomas Newcomen）建成第一台实用蒸汽机: In 1712, British blacksmith Thomas Newcomen built the first practical steam engine for pumping water out of coal mines. In 1769, Scottish instrument maker James Watt obtained a patent for the separate condenser. Starting in 1775, he partnered with entrepreneur Matthew Boulton to produce engines that used about one-quarter the coal of Newcomen's engines. After the patent expired in 1800, Richard Trevithick and others developed high-pressure steam engines, small enough to be mounted on [[locomotive|locomotives]] and ships.
工厂不必再建在河边借水力，可以建在煤矿和城市旁边；蒸汽机车和轮船让陆海运输提速数: Factories no longer needed to be built beside rivers to harness water power; they could be located next to coal mines or cities. Steam locomotives and ships increased land and sea transport speeds by several times. It was the driving force of the [[industrial-revolution|Industrial Revolution]].
瓦特并没有发明蒸汽机，他是把已有半个多世纪的纽科门机改得高效得多。早期蒸汽机的效: Watt did not invent the steam engine; he improved Newcomen's engine, which had existed for over half a century, making it much more efficient. Early steam engines still had efficiencies of only a few percent, with most heat lost through exhaust gases and cooling water.
瓦特蒸汽机的关键：锅炉产生蒸汽推动活塞，用过的蒸汽被送进独立的冷凝器变回水，气缸: Key feature of Watt's steam engine: the boiler produces steam to push the piston, while used steam is sent to an independent condenser to turn back into water, keeping the cylinder consistently hot.

人类寿命翻倍的秘密：看见病菌、读懂基因、设计药物: The technologies behind longer lives: seeing microbes, reading genes and designing medicines.
用更少的地和人，养活 80 亿人: Feeding eight billion people with less land and labor.
城市是人类最大的机器：钢筋混凝土、电梯和下水道: Cities as our largest machines: reinforced concrete, elevators and sewers.
攻与防的赛跑：从机枪到核弹，从密码机到网络战: The race between attack and defense: from machine guns to nuclear weapons, and cipher machines to cyberwarfare.
钱的数字化：从收银机到比特币和扫码支付: Money goes digital: from cash registers to Bitcoin and QR payments.
测量、减排、清除、适应：技术如何修补它自己留下的账: Measure, reduce, remove, adapt: how technology addresses the damage it has helped cause.
记录、复制、传播：把光和声音变成可以保存的东西: Record, copy and share: turning light and sound into something we can keep.
正在从实验室走向工厂的下一批技术: The next technologies making their way from laboratories to factories.
能量不会凭空产生或消失，只会从一种形式变成另一种；任何机器都只是\"能量搬运工\: Energy cannot be created or destroyed; it changes from one form into another. Every machine is simply an energy converter.
孤立系统总会从有序走向混乱；热量自发从热处流向冷处，要反过来就得额外付出功。: An isolated system tends toward increasing entropy. Heat flows spontaneously from hot to cold; moving it in the opposite direction requires work.
热机效率的上限只由高温端和低温端的温差决定：温差越大，能转成功的热越多。: The maximum efficiency of a heat engine is set by the temperatures of its hot and cold reservoirs. Increasing their temperature contrast can allow more heat to be converted into work.
力改变物体的运动：F=ma；不受力就保持原状态；作用力与反作用力成对出现。: A net force changes motion: F = ma. Without a net force, an object keeps its state of motion. Every action has an equal and opposite reaction.
一个系统向后抛出质量，自己就获得向前的动量——火箭和喷气发动机都靠\"往后扔东西: When a system ejects mass backward, it gains forward momentum. Rockets and jet engines move forward by throwing mass backward.
质量相互吸引；水平速度足够大时，物体一直在\"往下掉\"却永远掉不到地面，这就是: Masses attract each other. With enough sideways speed, an object keeps falling toward Earth while continually missing the ground: that is an orbit.
压力在密闭液体中处处传递（帕斯卡）；流速快的地方压力低，把气流向下推就能获得升力: Pressure is transmitted through an enclosed liquid (Pascal’s principle). Faster flow can correspond to lower pressure, and pushing airflow downward produces an upward lift force.
材料受力会变形；每种材料能承受的单位面积力有上限，结构设计就是让每处应力低于这个: Materials deform under force. Each material has a limit to the force per unit area it can withstand; structural design keeps stresses within those limits.
尺寸放大 k 倍，面积变 k² 倍、体积和重量变 k³ 倍；所以大东西更难支撑、: Scale an object’s dimensions by k, and its area grows by k² while its volume and weight grow by k³. Larger objects are harder to support, while smaller objects lose heat more readily.
热靠传导、对流、辐射三条路移动；想保温就堵路，想散热就开路。: Heat travels by conduction, convection and radiation. Insulation restricts these routes; cooling makes them easier.
物质在固、液、气之间转变时会吸收或放出大量热，而温度几乎不变。: Changing between solid, liquid and gas can absorb or release large amounts of heat while the temperature remains nearly constant.
单位重量或体积能储存多少能量，决定了一种能源能不能装进车、船、飞机和手机。: The energy stored per unit mass or volume helps determine whether an energy source is practical for cars, ships, aircraft or phones.
用更长的距离换更大的力（杠杆、齿轮、滑轮、液压）；功不变，力和距离此消彼长。: Levers, gears, pulleys and hydraulics trade a longer movement for a larger force. For the same work, force and distance trade off.
同性相斥、异性相吸；电荷周围有电场，电压就是推动电荷移动的\"压力差\"。: Like charges repel and opposite charges attract. Charges create electric fields; voltage is like a pressure difference that drives charge movement.
电流 = 电压 ÷ 电阻；电流在闭合回路中流动，节点处流入等于流出（基尔霍夫）。: Current = voltage ÷ resistance. Current flows around a closed circuit, and the current entering a junction equals the current leaving it (Kirchhoff’s law).
变化的磁场会在导线中产生电压——让磁铁和线圈相对运动就能发电。: A changing magnetic field can induce voltage in a conductor. Moving magnets and coils relative to one another can therefore generate electricity.
磁场中的电流会受到力；把这个力排成一圈，就是电动机。: An electric current in a magnetic field can experience a force. Arranging this force to produce rotation gives us an electric motor.
变化的电场产生磁场、变化的磁场产生电场，二者交替向外传播；无线电、光、X 射线都: Changing electric and magnetic fields sustain an outward-traveling electromagnetic wave. Radio waves, light and X-rays are the same kind of wave at different frequencies.
波相遇时会相加或抵消；频率匹配时能量会被放大（共振）。: When waves meet, they can reinforce or cancel each other. Driving a system at a matching frequency can build up a large response: resonance.
光在不同介质交界处会拐弯或反弹；角度够大时会全部反射回来（全反射）。: Light can bend or reflect at the boundary between different media. Under the right conditions, a sufficiently large angle produces total internal reflection.
原子里的电子只能待在特定\"台阶\"上；跳台阶时吸收或放出固定颜色（频率）的光。: Electrons in atoms can occupy only particular energy levels. Moving between levels absorbs or emits light at a specific frequency, or color.
固体中电子的能级连成\"带\"；半导体的禁带不宽不窄，掺一点杂质就能精确控制导电: In solids, electronic energy levels form bands. Semiconductors have a moderate band gap, and small amounts of added impurities allow their conductivity to be controlled precisely.
光以一份份光子的形式到来，能量够大的光子能把电子打出来——光可以直接变成电信号。: Light arrives in packets called photons. A photon with sufficient energy can release an electron, allowing light to be converted directly into an electrical signal.
E=mc²：极少的质量对应巨大的能量；原子核分裂或聚合时丢失的一点质量就变成能量: E = mc²: a tiny amount of mass corresponds to an enormous amount of energy. The small mass difference in nuclear fission or fusion is released as energy.
不稳定原子核按固定半衰期自发衰变并放出射线；半衰期像时钟一样稳定。: Unstable nuclei decay spontaneously and emit radiation. A characteristic half-life makes radioactive decay useful as a clock.
量子系统可以同时处于多个状态的叠加；纠缠的粒子无论相距多远，测量结果都相互关联。: A quantum system can be in a superposition of several states. Measurements of entangled particles remain correlated even when the particles are far apart.
微观粒子有一定概率\"穿墙\"越过本来越不过的能量壁垒。: A microscopic particle has some probability of passing through an energy barrier that it could not cross classically.
速度和引力都会改变时间流逝的快慢；精确到纳秒的系统必须修正它。: Both speed and gravity affect the passage of time. Systems requiring nanosecond precision must account for these effects.
原子靠化学键结合；断键吸能、成键放能，燃烧就是把弱键换成强键并放出差额。: Chemical bonds hold atoms together. Breaking bonds takes energy and forming bonds releases it; combustion releases the net difference when stronger bonds form.
化学反应就是电子转移；让电子绕道外电路走，化学能就变成电能（反之亦然）。: Redox reactions transfer electrons. Routing those electrons through an external circuit converts chemical energy into electrical energy, or vice versa.
催化剂降低反应的\"门槛\"（活化能），让反应更快、更省能，自己却不被消耗。: A catalyst lowers a reaction’s activation-energy barrier, helping it proceed faster or under less demanding conditions without being consumed overall.
把成千上万个小分子像串珠子一样连成长链，就得到塑料、纤维和橡胶。: Joining thousands of small molecules into long chains, like beads on a string, produces materials such as plastics, fibers and rubber.
同样的原子，排列方式不同，性质天差地别（石墨与金刚石）；材料科学就是设计排列。: The same atoms can have very different properties when arranged differently, as in graphite and diamond. Materials science designs these arrangements.
粒子会自发从浓处往稀处走；给它加一层只放行特定分子的膜，就能分离、过滤和提纯。: Particles tend to spread from higher to lower concentrations. A membrane that allows selected molecules through enables separation, filtration and purification.
可遗传的变异 + 筛选 = 适应；细菌耐药和\"定向进化\"育种都是它。: Heritable variation plus selection leads to adaptation. Antibiotic resistance and directed-evolution breeding both illustrate this process.
遗传信息从 DNA 抄写到 RNA，再翻译成蛋白质；改信息就能改生命的\"零件\: Genetic information is transcribed from DNA to RNA and then translated into proteins. Changing that information can change the components of living systems.
生物分子靠形状和电荷互补\"锁与钥匙\"般结合；药物、抗体、疫苗都在设计\"钥匙: Biological molecules bind through complementary shapes and charges, like a lock and key. Drugs, antibodies and vaccines depend on this recognition.
许多疾病由微生物引起；切断传播途径或杀死病原体就能预防和治疗。: Many diseases are caused by microorganisms. Interrupting transmission or targeting the pathogen can help prevent and treat them.
植物把阳光、水和二氧化碳变成糖；农业本质上是在管理阳光、水、氮的转化效率。: Plants use sunlight, water and carbon dioxide to make sugars. Agriculture manages how efficiently sunlight, water and nitrogen are converted into useful growth.
身体用负反馈把体温、血糖等维持在一个区间；许多疗法就是帮身体恢复这个调节。: Negative feedback helps the body keep temperature, blood sugar and other variables within a range. Many treatments help restore this regulation.
信息可以用比特度量；任何信道在给定带宽和噪声下都有传输速率上限（香农极限）。: Information can be measured in bits. For a given bandwidth and noise level, a communication channel has an upper limit on its reliable transmission rate: the Shannon limit.
一切逻辑都能用\"与、或、非\"组合出来，而它们只需要能表示 0 和 1 的开关: Logic can be built from combinations of AND, OR and NOT, using switches that represent 0 and 1.
只要能写成明确步骤的问题，一台足够简单的通用机器都能算；但有些问题任何机器都算不: A sufficiently simple universal machine can carry out any computation expressible as an effective sequence of steps. Some problems, however, cannot be solved by any such machine.
算法的代价随问题规模增长的速度比机器快慢更重要：n² 和 n log n 在大数: How an algorithm’s cost grows with problem size can matter more than processor speed. At large scales, n² and n log n make an enormous difference.
把复杂系统切成层，每层只暴露简单接口、隐藏内部细节；人才能驾驭百万行代码和十亿个: Divide a complex system into layers, each exposing a simple interface and hiding internal details. This makes millions of lines of code or billions of transistors manageable.
连续信号只要以高于最高频率两倍的速度采样，就能被数字完整还原（奈奎斯特—香农）。: A band-limited signal can be reconstructed from digital samples taken at more than twice its highest frequency (the Nyquist–Shannon sampling theorem).
测量结果与目标比较，用差值修正动作；负反馈让系统稳定，正反馈让系统放大。: Compare a measured result with a target and use the difference to adjust the action. Negative feedback counteracts deviations; positive feedback reinforces them.
用样本推断整体、用证据更新信念（贝叶斯）；不确定性可以被量化和管理。: Use samples to infer properties of a population, and update beliefs with evidence (Bayesian inference). Uncertainty can be quantified and managed.
把\"好坏\"写成一个可计算的分数，然后沿着让分数变好的方向一步步调参数。: Express how good or bad a result is as a computable score, then adjust parameters step by step in a direction that improves it.
有些运算正着算很容易、倒推却极难（如大数分解）；现代密码学就建立在这种不对称上。: Some computations are easy to perform but difficult to reverse, such as multiplying large factors versus recovering them from their product. Modern cryptography relies on such asymmetries.
多加一些精心设计的冗余位，就能在噪声中发现甚至修正错误。: Adding carefully designed redundant bits makes it possible to detect, and sometimes correct, errors caused by noise.
刚用过的、挨着的数据很可能马上再用；把它们放在更近更快的地方，整体就快很多。: Recently used data and nearby data are likely to be needed again soon. Keeping them closer and faster to access can greatly improve overall performance.
产量越大单位成本越低；累计产量每翻一倍，成本按固定比例下降（莱特定律）。: Larger production volumes can lower unit costs. Under Wright’s learning-curve model, each doubling of cumulative production reduces cost by a characteristic proportion.
用户越多，每个用户得到的价值越大（梅特卡夫定律）；所以通信和平台容易赢家通吃。: A network can become more valuable to each user as more people join (Metcalfe’s law). This helps explain winner-take-all tendencies in communication networks and platforms.
每隔固定时间翻一番，几十次后就是百万倍；人脑总是低估它。: Repeated doubling can produce a million-fold increase after only a few dozen steps. People often underestimate how quickly this growth accelerates.
统一尺寸、接口和协议，零件就能互换、系统就能互联，成本随之崩塌。: Standard sizes, interfaces and protocols make parts interchangeable and systems interoperable, dramatically lowering costs.
把一件复杂的事拆成许多简单工序，每人或每台机器只做一道，总效率成倍提高。: Breaking a complex task into simple stages lets each person or machine specialize in one stage, multiplying overall efficiency.
系统怎样分配奖惩，参与者就会怎样行动；好的机制让自私的个体合起来做对的事。: Participants respond to how a system distributes rewards and penalties. Good mechanism design aligns individual incentives with useful collective outcomes.
新技术先慢后快再饱和：早期贵而少人用，越过拐点后成本和普及互相推动，最后被下一条: A new technology often develops slowly, then rapidly, then approaches saturation. At first it is costly and uncommon; after the inflection point, falling costs and adoption reinforce one another, until a new S-curve takes over.

与其让蒸汽一下一下地推活塞，不如让高速蒸汽连续冲过一排排叶片，像风吹风车一样不停: Instead of letting steam push a piston back and forth, a steam turbine directs high-speed steam continuously through rows of blades, turning them like wind turning a windmill. A greater temperature difference allows more of the heat to be converted into work ([[p:carnot|Carnot efficiency limit]]).
燃料的化学能在气缸**内部**燃烧释放（[[p:bond|化学键]]），燃气瞬间: Fuel burns **inside** the cylinder, releasing its chemical energy ([[p:bond|chemical bonds]]). The combustion gases heat up and expand rapidly, pushing the piston. Greater compression and hotter combustion increase thermal efficiency ([[p:carnot|Carnot efficiency limit]]).
内燃机的功率重量比远超蒸汽机，让汽车、飞机、拖拉机和小型发电机成为可能，也让石油: Internal combustion engines have a much higher power-to-weight ratio than steam engines, making cars, aircraft, tractors and small generators possible. They also helped petroleum replace coal as the most important fuel (see [[petroleum-refining]]), while bringing exhaust pollution and large carbon emissions.
英文为机器辅助译本，可切换中英对照阅读。: English is a machine-assisted translation. Choose parallel text to compare it with the original.
气体被快速压缩时会剧烈升温；压得足够狠，空气热到能让喷进来的柴油自己着火，不需要: Rapid compression heats a gas sharply. With sufficient compression, the air becomes hot enough to ignite injected diesel fuel without a spark plug. A higher compression ratio raises thermal efficiency ([[p:carnot|Carnot efficiency limit]]).
压气机把空气压缩，燃料在其中燃烧，高温燃气冲过涡轮让它高速旋转，涡轮再反过来带动: A compressor compresses air, fuel burns in it, and the hot gases rush through a turbine, spinning it rapidly. The turbine, in turn, drives the compressor. All three processes occur continuously at the same time; the fast exhaust can also produce thrust ([[p:momentum|conservation of momentum]]).
高处的水具有势能，流下来变成动能；让水流推动叶轮旋转，再带动发电机，就把重力做的: Water at a height has potential energy, which becomes kinetic energy as it flows downward. The moving water turns a turbine connected to a generator, converting the work done by gravity into electricity ([[p:energy|conservation of energy]]).
热量自发从热处流向冷处，要让它倒着走就得付出功（[[p:entropy|热力学第: Heat flows spontaneously from hot to cold; making it flow the other way requires work ([[p:entropy|the second law of thermodynamics]]). But moving heat uses much less energy than producing it: 1 unit of electrical energy can move 2–3 units of heat from outdoors, delivering a total of 3–4 units indoors ([[p:phase|phase change]]).
液体蒸发时会从周围吸收大量热量（所以出汗会凉快），气体被压缩凝结成液体时又会把热: A liquid absorbs a great deal of heat from its surroundings as it evaporates, which is why sweating cools you. When the vapor is compressed and condenses back into liquid, it releases heat ([[p:phase|phase change and latent heat]]). A working fluid evaporates inside the refrigerator and condenses outside, continuously moving heat from the cold interior to the warmer surroundings. The compressor uses electricity to make this happen ([[p:entropy|increasing entropy]]).
液体能把压力传递到每一个角落（[[p:fluid|帕斯卡原理]]）；向井下高压注: A liquid transmits pressure throughout its volume ([[p:fluid|Pascal’s principle]]). Pumping liquid into a well at high pressure can exceed the rock’s strength, opening fractures that provide paths for oil and gas to flow out.
天然气的主要成分甲烷（CH₄）是最简单的碳氢化合物，一个碳配四个氢，燃烧时放出同: Methane (CH₄), the main component of natural gas, is the simplest hydrocarbon: one carbon atom bonded to four hydrogen atoms. Burning it releases about half as much carbon dioxide as coal for the same amount of heat ([[p:bond|chemical bonds]]).
气体冷到足够低就会凝结成液体，体积大大缩小；天然气在常压下冷到约 −162°C: Cooling a gas sufficiently makes it condense into a liquid and greatly reduces its volume. At atmospheric pressure, natural gas becomes liquid at about −162°C, occupying roughly one six-hundredth of its gaseous volume ([[p:phase|phase change]], [[p:energydensity|energy density]]).
燃气轮机排出的废气仍有约 600°C，直接排掉太可惜；用它再烧一锅蒸汽去推汽轮机: A gas turbine’s exhaust is still about 600°C, so simply discarding it wastes useful heat. Using that exhaust to generate steam for a steam turbine makes use of both the hotter and cooler parts of the temperature range ([[p:carnot|Carnot efficiency limit]]).
远古植物和浮游生物通过光合作用把阳光储存在有机物里，被埋到地下后在高温高压下经过: Ancient plants and plankton stored sunlight in organic matter through photosynthesis. After burial, millions of years of heat and pressure transformed that matter into coal, oil and natural gas. Burning them releases this long-stored chemical energy all at once ([[p:bond|chemical bonds]], [[p:energydensity|energy density]]).
电网里发电和用电必须每一秒都相等（[[p:energy|能量守恒]]），频率就是: Electricity generation and consumption must balance every second ([[p:energy|conservation of energy]]). Frequency acts like the needle of a balance: it rises when generation exceeds consumption and falls when consumption exceeds generation. Grid operators use these deviations to adjust output ([[p:feedback|feedback and control]]).
一个小系统只要自己能测量、自己能调节，就能独立保持稳定（[[p:feedback: A small system can remain stable on its own if it can measure and adjust its own operation ([[p:feedback|feedback and control]]). A microgrid is a miniature version of an electricity grid.
许多小资源通过网络连起来统一指挥，整体效果就能抵得上一座大电厂（[[p:netw: Many small resources can be connected through a network and coordinated so that together they act like a large power plant ([[p:network|network effects]]). The key is measuring and adjusting each unit in real time ([[p:feedback|feedback and control]]).
比较两种电源谁更便宜，不能只看建设费或燃料费，而要把一生所有成本摊到它一生发的每: To compare the cost of two electricity sources, looking only at construction or fuel costs is not enough. All lifetime costs must be spread over every unit of electricity generated over that lifetime. Higher production volumes and accumulated experience can lower costs ([[p:scale|economies of scale and learning curves]]).
与其建一座只在高峰时用几十个小时的电厂，不如花钱请用户在高峰时少用一点电——价格: Instead of building a power plant that runs for only a few dozen peak-demand hours, it may be cheaper to pay users to consume a little less during those hours. Price signals change behavior ([[p:incentives|incentives and game theory]]), making electricity demand itself an adjustable part of the system ([[p:feedback|feedback]]).
让发电企业报价竞争，按从便宜到贵的顺序调用，最后一台被调用机组的报价就是市场价；: Generators compete by submitting bids and are dispatched from the cheapest to the most expensive. The bid of the last generator needed sets the market price. Prices provide incentives both to invest and to conserve energy ([[p:incentives|incentives and game theory]]).
电站的\"装机容量\"只是它满功率时的出力，一年实际能发多少电取决于它有多少时间: A power plant’s installed capacity is its output at full power. Its actual annual electricity generation depends on how much time it operates at the equivalent of that full output ([[p:energy|conservation of energy]]).
开采能源本身也要消耗能源（[[p:energy|能量守恒]]）；如果拿到的能量只: Extracting energy also consumes energy ([[p:energy|conservation of energy]]). If the energy obtained only slightly exceeds the energy invested, little net energy remains for society to use.
铀-235 的原子核吸收一个中子后会分裂成两块较轻的核，分裂后的总质量比原来少了: When a uranium-235 nucleus absorbs a neutron, it can split into two lighter nuclei. The products have slightly less total mass; the small mass difference becomes a large amount of energy according to E=mc² ([[p:massenergy|mass–energy equivalence]]). Each fission also releases 2–3 neutrons, which can trigger further fissions and form a chain reaction.
水既能把快中子减速（慢化剂），又能带走热量（冷却剂）；给它加上约 150 个大气: Water can both slow fast neutrons as a moderator and carry away heat as a coolant. Pressurizing it to about 150 atmospheres keeps it from boiling even above 300°C, allowing it to carry heat safely out of the reactor core ([[p:massenergy|mass–energy equivalence]], [[p:heat|heat transfer]]).
天然铀中 99% 以上是不易裂变的铀-238；它吸收一个快中子后会经过两次衰变变: More than 99% of natural uranium is uranium-238, which is not readily fissile. After absorbing a fast neutron, it undergoes two decays to become fissile plutonium-239 ([[p:massenergy|mass–energy equivalence]]). A suitably designed reactor can produce more new fuel than it consumes.
铀-235 和铀-238 化学性质几乎一样，只是重了 3 个中子；把铀变成气体高: Uranium-235 and uranium-238 have almost identical chemical properties, but uranium-238 has three more neutrons. Converting uranium into a gas and spinning it rapidly pushes the heavier molecules outward while lighter ones concentrate nearer the center, allowing gradual separation ([[p:diffusion|diffusion and separation]], [[p:massenergy|mass–energy equivalence]]).
大型核电站造价高、工期长，常常超支；如果把反应堆做小、在工厂里像造飞机一样批量生: Large nuclear power plants are expensive, take a long time to build and often exceed their budgets. Smaller reactors manufactured in batches, much like aircraft, may reduce costs through [[p:scale|learning curves]] ([[p:massenergy|mass–energy equivalence]]).
风的功率与风速的三次方成正比，与叶轮扫过的面积成正比（[[p:fluid|流体与: Wind power is proportional to the cube of wind speed and to the area swept by the rotor ([[p:fluid|fluid flow and lift]]): doubling wind speed gives eight times the power, while doubling blade length gives four times the swept area. This favors taller, larger turbines. But as blades get longer, their weight grows faster, creating an engineering limit ([[p:squarecube|square–cube law]]).
电网必须实时平衡（[[p:energy|能量守恒]]），而风和光\"看天吃饭\": The electricity grid must balance generation and demand in real time ([[p:energy|conservation of energy]]), while wind and solar depend on the weather. Energy storage acts like a reservoir for the grid, storing surplus electricity and releasing it when electricity is in short supply.
电荷可以不经化学反应、直接吸附在电极表面形成双电层储存起来（[[p:charge: Electric charge can be stored directly on electrode surfaces in an electric double layer, without a chemical reaction ([[p:charge|electric charge and fields]]). Porous activated-carbon electrodes provide an enormous surface area—over a thousand square meters per gram—giving them a very large capacitance.
锂是最轻的金属，也最爱丢电子，所以能做出电压高、重量轻的电池（[[p:redox: Lithium is the lightest metal and readily gives up electrons, enabling lightweight, high-voltage batteries ([[p:redox|redox]], [[p:energydensity|energy density]]). In a lithium-ion battery, lithium remains in ionic form, moving like a tenant between two apartment buildings: the positive and negative electrodes. The electrode structures remain almost unchanged, allowing thousands of charge and discharge cycles.
氢和氧反应本质上是电子转移；让氢的电子不直接交给氧，而是绕道外电路走一圈，化学能: The reaction between hydrogen and oxygen is fundamentally a transfer of electrons. Routing hydrogen’s electrons through an external circuit instead of transferring them directly to oxygen converts chemical energy directly into electricity. It avoids the sequence of burning fuel, producing heat and driving machinery, so the Carnot efficiency limit does not apply ([[p:redox|redox and electrochemistry]]).
有的物质爱丢电子（如锌、锂），有的爱抢电子；把它们隔开，只留一条外电路让电子通过: Some substances, such as zinc and lithium, readily give up electrons, while others tend to accept them. Separating the reactants and giving electrons a path through an external circuit allows them to do work along the way ([[p:redox|redox and electrochemistry]]). A battery stores chemical energy in reactants kept from reacting freely, rather than storing electricity itself.
一块晶硅电池片是一张薄薄的硅片：上层掺磷成为 N 型，下层掺硼成为 P 型，交界: A crystalline-silicon solar cell is a thin silicon wafer. Its upper layer is doped with phosphorus to make it N-type, while its lower layer is doped with boron to make it P-type, forming a [[pn-junction|p–n junction]] at their boundary. Sunlight excites electrons, which move toward the N side, while holes move toward the P side. Fine silver grid lines on the front and an electrode on the back collect the current. Dozens of cells are connected in series and packaged into a module. An [[inverter|inverter]] converts the module’s direct current into alternating current for the grid.
硅的禁带宽度决定了它只能高效利用一部分太阳光谱，单结晶硅电池的理论效率上限约 2: Silicon’s bandgap allows it to use only part of the solar spectrum efficiently. The theoretical efficiency limit for a single-junction crystalline-silicon solar cell is about 29%–33%, while mass-produced modules have reached 22%–25%. Stacking a perovskite cell on silicon creates a tandem cell that can exceed this limit (see [[perovskite-solar]]).
电池的\"毫安时\"只是电量，能量还要乘以电压。同样 5000 毫安时，3.7: A battery’s milliampere-hour rating measures charge, not energy. Multiply charge by voltage to obtain energy. At the same capacity of 5000 milliampere-hours, a 3.7-volt lithium battery stores about three times as much energy as a 1.2-volt nickel-metal hydride battery.
负极通常是石墨，层与层之间能塞进锂离子；正极是钴酸锂、三元材料（镍钴锰）或磷酸铁: The negative electrode is usually graphite, whose layers can hold lithium ions. The positive electrode is a lithium-containing compound such as lithium cobalt oxide, a nickel–cobalt–manganese material, or lithium iron phosphate. During charging, an external power source draws lithium ions out of the positive electrode, through the electrolyte and separator, and into the graphite layers. During discharge, the ions return to the positive electrode while electrons travel through the external circuit and do work. This back-and-forth motion gives it the name “rocking-chair battery”.
停堆后裂变产物仍在衰变放热（[[p:decay|放射性衰变]]），所以冷却一刻也: Even after shutdown, the fission products continue to release decay heat ([[p:decay|radioactive decay]]), so cooling must continue.
电动机需要不断切换线圈中电流的方向才能持续旋转（[[p:lorentz|电磁力]: Electric motors need to continuously switch the direction of current in coils to keep rotating ([[p:lorentz|Lorentz force]]); rather than using friction-based mechanical commutation with brushes, it is better to use sensors to measure rotor position and have electronic switches perform precise commutation.
交流电在一组线圈里产生不断变化的磁场，这个磁场穿过另一组线圈时就会在其中感应出电: Alternating current produces a continuously changing magnetic field within a set of coils; when this field passes through another set of coils, it induces voltage in them ([[p:induction|electromagnetic induction]]); the ratio of turns between the two coils is the ratio of voltages.
变压器由一个闭合的铁芯和绕在上面的两组线圈组成。**初级线圈**接交流电源，在铁: Transformers consist of a closed iron core and two sets of coils wound around it. The **primary coil** connects to an AC power source, producing alternating magnetic flux in the core; the **secondary coil** is passed through by the same magnetic flux, inducing voltage. If the secondary turns are 10 times the primary, the voltage rises 10 times while current drops to one-tenth, with power remaining essentially unchanged ([[p:energy|Conservation of energy]]). Large power transformers exceed 99% efficiency.
穿过线圈的磁场一旦发生变化，线圈里就会产生电压（[[p:induction|电磁: A changing magnetic field through a coil induces a voltage in it ([[p:induction|electromagnetic induction]]). Keeping the coil rotating in the magnetic field therefore generates electricity continuously. A generator does not create energy: it converts the mechanical energy driving its rotor into electrical energy ([[p:energy|conservation of energy]]).
变化的磁场会在导体中感应出电流（[[p:induction|电磁感应]]），而这: A changing magnetic field induces currents in a conductor ([[p:induction|electromagnetic induction]]), and those currents experience forces in the field ([[p:lorentz|electromagnetic force]]). A rotating magnetic field can therefore drive a rotor without a direct electrical supply to the rotor.
金属被加热后，表面的电子会\"蒸发\"出来（热电子发射），在真空中它们会被正电压: Heating a metal releases electrons from its surface through thermionic emission. In a vacuum, a positively charged electrode attracts these electrons ([[p:charge|electric charge and fields]]). A negatively charged metal grid placed between the electrodes can strongly control this flow with only a small change in voltage.
把输出的一部分反向送回输入端，与原始信号比较，用差值来修正输出（[[p:feed: Part of the output is fed back to the input with its sign reversed and compared with the original signal. The difference is used to correct the output ([[p:feedback|feedback and control]]). The amplifier’s gain then depends mainly on a few stable resistors, making it much less sensitive to changes in transistor or vacuum-tube characteristics.
元件之间的连线只是让电流按规定路径流动（[[p:ohm|欧姆定律与电路]]）；与: Connections between components guide current along specified paths ([[p:ohm|Ohm’s law and circuits]]). Instead of soldering individual wires by hand, the complete wiring pattern can be printed on an insulating board, making each board the same ([[p:standard|standardization]]).
固体里电子的能量只能落在一段段\"能带\"里，带与带之间是不允许停留的\"禁带\: In a solid, electrons can occupy allowed ranges of energy called bands, separated by forbidden energy gaps ([[p:band|band theory and semiconductors]]). Electrons in a metal can move freely. An insulator’s gap is too large for electrons to cross easily, while a semiconductor’s smaller gap can be crossed with a modest energy input. Small changes can therefore alter its conductivity by thousands or tens of thousands of times.
在硅晶格里替换进极少量外来原子，就能凭空多出可移动的电子或空穴（[[p:band: Replacing a tiny fraction of the silicon atoms in a crystal with foreign atoms introduces mobile electrons or holes ([[p:band|band theory and semiconductors]]). The amount, location and depth of doping determine the device’s performance.
建一座先进晶圆厂要花几百亿美元，只有极大的产量才能摊薄成本（[[p:scale|: An advanced semiconductor fabrication plant can cost tens of billions of dollars, so very high production volumes are needed to spread its cost ([[p:scale|economies of scale]]). A foundry specializes in manufacturing chips for many design companies, allowing design and manufacturing to concentrate on their respective tasks ([[p:division|division of labor and specialization]]).
再聪明的工程师也无法手工画出几百亿个晶体管；把设计分成系统、逻辑、电路、版图等层: Even the most skilled engineer cannot draw tens of billions of transistors by hand. Chip design is divided into levels such as systems, logic, circuits and physical layouts. At each level, software generates and checks the next one ([[p:abstraction|abstraction and layering]]).
一块硅片越大，上面出现致命缺陷的概率越高，良率按面积急剧下降（[[p:scale: The larger a piece of silicon, the more likely it is to contain a fatal defect, so yield falls sharply as area increases ([[p:scale|economies of scale]]). Dividing a large chip into smaller chips, manufacturing them separately and combining the good ones can reduce the overall cost ([[p:division|division of labor]]).
每个像素都是一颗自己发光的无机 LED（[[p:levels|量子化能级]]），: Each pixel is an inorganic LED that emits its own light ([[p:levels|quantized energy levels]]). This combines the self-emitting display principle of OLED with the long life and high brightness of inorganic materials.
光子打进硅里能激发出电子（[[p:photoelectric|光电效应]]），光: Photons striking silicon can excite electrons ([[p:photoelectric|photoelectric effect]]); more light produces more electrons. A chip is divided into millions of small cells that collect electrons separately. Reading their charges and converting them into numbers produces a digital image ([[p:sampling|sampling and digitization]]).
用制造芯片的光刻和刻蚀工艺，同样能在硅上\"雕\"出微米级的可动机械结构；微小的: The photolithography and etching processes used to make chips can also carve movable structures only micrometers across into silicon. A tiny mass moves in response to acceleration ([[p:newton|Newton’s laws]]). Its movement changes capacitance, which an electronic circuit can measure ([[p:structure|structure]]).
电子在相互垂直的电场和磁场中会绕圈飞行（[[p:lorentz|电磁力]]）；让: Electrons curve around under mutually perpendicular electric and magnetic fields ([[p:lorentz|electromagnetic force]]). As they pass a ring of carefully designed resonant cavities, they excite strong oscillations, much like blowing across a bottle’s mouth ([[p:wave|resonance]]), producing high-power microwaves.
晶体管只需几伏电压、几毫安电流就能放大微弱的无线电信号（[[p:band|能带与: A transistor can amplify a weak radio signal using only a few volts and a few milliamperes ([[p:band|band theory and semiconductors]]), so a few batteries can power the radio for a long time.
任何算术运算都能分解成二进制的加法和移位，由逻辑门组成的电路完成（[[p:boo: Arithmetic operations can be broken down into binary addition and bit shifts, performed by circuits built from logic gates ([[p:boolean|Boolean logic]]).
石英晶体的机械共振频率极其稳定（[[p:wave|共振]]）；把它切成音叉形状，: Quartz has a highly stable mechanical resonance frequency ([[p:wave|resonance]]). A tuning-fork-shaped crystal can be made to vibrate 32,768 times per second, which is 2 to the 15th power.
把传感器贴近身体，持续测量并把结果反馈给用户，就能帮助人调整行为（[[p:fee: Sensors placed close to the body can take continuous measurements and provide feedback to the wearer, helping them adjust their behavior ([[p:feedback|feedback and control]]).
统一、公开的硬件接口和设计，让任何人都能复用、修改和组合，社区越大，可用的扩展和: Standard, publicly documented hardware interfaces and designs let people reuse, modify and combine components. As the community grows, more extensions and tutorials become available ([[p:standard|standardization and interchangeability]]).
发射线圈中的交变电流产生交变磁场，磁场穿过附近的接收线圈，在其中感应出电流（[[: Alternating current in a transmitting coil creates a changing magnetic field. As the field passes through a nearby receiving coil, it induces a current there ([[p:induction|electromagnetic induction]]). It works like a transformer whose primary and secondary coils have been separated.
信息可以\"骑\"在看不见的电磁波上传送（[[p:emwave|电磁波]]）：红: Information can be carried by invisible electromagnetic waves ([[p:emwave|electromagnetic waves]]). Both infrared light and radio can send encoded button presses over a distance of several meters.
家用冰箱就是一台小型蒸气压缩制冷机，把箱内的热量搬到箱外（[[p:phase|相: A household refrigerator is a small vapor-compression refrigeration machine that moves heat from inside the cabinet to the outside ([[p:phase|phase change]], [[p:entropy|increasing entropy]]).
电动机把电能变成稳定的机械运动，替代人手搓洗衣物（[[p:leverage|机械: An electric motor converts electrical energy into steady mechanical motion, replacing the work of scrubbing clothes by hand ([[p:leverage|mechanical advantage]]).
风机把空气抽走，在吸口形成低于外界的气压，外面的空气带着灰尘冲进来（[[p:fl: A fan draws air away, lowering the pressure at the intake below that of the surrounding air. Outside air then rushes in, carrying dust with it ([[p:fluid|fluid pressure]]).
交变磁场穿过导电的锅底时，会在锅底里感应出旋涡状的电流（涡流），电流在金属电阻中: An alternating magnetic field passing through a conducting pan base induces circulating currents called eddy currents. The metal’s electrical resistance converts their energy into heat ([[p:induction|electromagnetic induction]]).
只要锅里还有水，温度就被\"钉\"在 100°C 左右（[[p:phase|相变: As long as water remains in the pot, its temperature stays near 100°C ([[p:phase|phase change]]). Once the rice absorbs the water or it boils away, the temperature at the bottom rises quickly. This sharp temperature change signals that the rice is cooked ([[p:feedback|feedback]]).
测量温度，与设定值比较，偏低就加热、偏高就停止——这是最简单也最典型的负反馈控制: A thermostat measures temperature and compares it with a set value. It turns the heat on when the temperature is too low and stops heating when it is too high—a simple, familiar example of negative-feedback control ([[p:feedback|feedback and control]]).
大型电站发电机通常让磁极（转子）旋转、线圈（定子）固定，这样大电流不必经过滑动接: Large power-station generators usually rotate the magnetic poles—the **rotor**—while keeping the coils—the **stator**—stationary, so the large output current does not need to pass through sliding contacts. Producing more current requires more driving torque and creates a stronger opposing electromagnetic torque. When grid demand rises, more steam must therefore be supplied to the turbine to maintain its speed.
发电机和 [[electric-motor|电动机]] 本质上是同一种机器：给它: A generator and an [[electric-motor|electric motor]] are fundamentally the same kind of machine: driving it mechanically generates electricity, while supplying electricity produces rotation. During braking, an electric vehicle uses its motor as a generator to recover energy and charge the battery.
最简单的**二极管**有两个电极：加热的阴极发射电子，带正电的阳极（板极）吸收电: The simplest vacuum-tube **diode** has two electrodes: a heated cathode emits electrons, and a positively charged anode, or plate, collects them. Current flows in one direction, allowing rectification and signal detection. A **triode** adds a **control grid** between them. Making the grid voltage slightly more negative blocks many electrons; making it more positive greatly increases their flow. A weak signal on the grid therefore controls a much stronger signal in the anode circuit—this is **amplification**. Switching between fully conducting and fully cut off also makes an electronic **switch**.
纯净的硅导电性很差：每个硅原子用 4 个电子和邻居手拉手，电子被牢牢\"锁\"在: Pure silicon conducts poorly: each silicon atom uses four electrons to bond with its neighbors, leaving those electrons tightly bound in covalent bonds. There are three ways to change its conductivity:
**掺杂**（最重要）：掺入百万分之一量级的磷，磷有 5 个电子，多出的那个能自: **Doping** is the most important. Adding phosphorus at roughly parts-per-million concentrations introduces atoms with five valence electrons; the extra electron can move freely, producing **N-type** material, in which negative charges conduct. Boron has three valence electrons and leaves a vacancy, or **hole**, that a neighboring electron can fill. As electrons fill successive vacancies, the hole moves like a positive charge, producing **P-type** material (see [[doping]]).
集成电路的制造像在硅片上一层层\"盖楼\"：先在晶圆上用 [[photolith: Making an integrated circuit resembles constructing a building one layer at a time on silicon. [[photolithography|Photolithography]] defines patterns on the wafer; doping forms the source and drain regions of transistors, and gates are formed above them. A dozen or so layers of metal wiring are then added, separated by insulating material and joined through tiny vias. A 300-millimeter wafer can hold hundreds of chips at once. Dicing, packaging and testing turn them into the finished chips we use.
集成解决了\"数字暴政\"：电路越复杂，手工焊点越多，一个出错整机就失灵；集成后: Integration solved the “tyranny of numbers”: more complex circuits required more hand-soldered connections, and one faulty joint could disable the whole machine. Integrated circuits replaced those joints with metal tracks defined by lithography, fundamentally improving reliability and cost.
**涂胶**：在晶圆上旋涂光刻胶。**曝光**：把掩模上的图案经透镜缩小四倍投影: **Coating**: Spin-coat the wafer with photoresist. **Exposure**: Use lenses to project the mask pattern onto the resist at one-quarter of its original size. **Development**: Wash away the exposed or unexposed portions, depending on the resist. **Etching or implantation**: Use the remaining resist as a template to process the underlying material (see [[etching-deposition]]). Finally, strip the resist.
不同材料发不同颜色的光：砷化镓发红外光，磷砷化镓发红光，氮化镓发蓝光。**白光: Different materials emit different colors: gallium arsenide emits infrared light, gallium arsenide phosphide emits red light, and gallium nitride emits blue light. The most common **white LED** uses a blue LED to excite a yellow phosphor. The mixture of blue and yellow light appears white to our eyes.
芯片之间的连线又长又慢又耗电，把它们搬进同一块硅片里，距离缩短上千倍，速度更快、: Connections between separate chips are long, slow and power-hungry. Integrating them on the same silicon die shortens distances by over a thousand times, increasing speed and reducing power use ([[p:scale|economies of scale]]). Dedicated processing units then handle different kinds of tasks ([[p:division|division of labor and specialization]]).
把\"开关\"从齿轮换成继电器、再换成真空管，速度就能提高成千上万倍；而把程序也: Replacing mechanical gear switches first with relays, then with vacuum tubes, can make switching thousands or tens of thousands of times faster. Storing programs in memory also lets the machine change programs itself and run continuously without manual intervention.
把一项工作切成几个阶段，每个阶段由不同的部件负责，就能让多项工作同时处于不同阶段: Dividing a job into stages, each handled by a different component, lets several jobs occupy different stages at the same time. The total time for one job stays the same, but the number completed per unit of time increases several-fold ([[p:division|division of labor]]).
芯片价格按 [[p:exponential|指数]] 下降，跌破个人能承受的门槛: Chip prices fall [[p:exponential|exponentially]]. Once they cross the threshold of what individuals can afford, computers change from institutional assets into personal tools. More users attract more software developers, creating a positive cycle.
机器再快也只能线性地快，而好算法能让工作量按 [[p:complexity|数量: Faster hardware provides a proportional speedup, whereas a better algorithm can reduce the work by [[p:complexity|orders of magnitude]]. For large datasets, the choice of algorithm can matter far more than the choice of hardware.
如果程序和数据用同一种结构（列表）表示，程序就能像处理数据一样生成和修改程序。: When programs and data are represented using the same structure—lists—a program can generate and modify other programs in the same way that it processes data.
程序是否还\"需要\"一块内存，可以通过能否从程序的变量出发找到它来判断；找不到: Whether a program still needs a piece of memory can be judged by whether that memory is reachable from the program’s variables. Unreachable memory is treated as garbage and can be reclaimed automatically.
不必先把整个程序翻译完，可以读一句执行一句——启动更快、调试更方便，代价是运行时: Instead of translating an entire program before it runs, an interpreter can read and execute instructions as it goes. This makes startup and debugging convenient, at the cost of translation overhead during execution.
用\"有效数字 × 2 的若干次方\"表示小数（类似科学记数法），有限的比特就能: Representing a fractional number as a significand multiplied by a power of 2, much like scientific notation, lets a fixed number of bits cover both very large and very small values. The tradeoff is that many values can only be approximated.
硬件启动的第一刻，硬盘上的操作系统还读不出来；需要一段固化在芯片里的小程序先把硬: When hardware first starts, it cannot yet load the operating system from the disk. A small program stored in a chip must first initialize the hardware and then hand control over to the operating system.
数据一旦被多个程序、多个人同时使用，就需要一个专门的系统来负责\"存得稳、查得快: Once several programs or people use the same data, a dedicated system is needed to store it reliably, find it quickly and update it correctly, instead of having each program read and write files independently.
如果用户能自由地运行、研究、修改和分享软件，并要求修改后的版本同样自由，自由就能: If users are free to run, study, modify and share software, and modified versions must preserve those freedoms, that freedom can pass from one generation of code to the next.
需求在开发过程中一定会变；与其一开始就制定一份完美的长期计划，不如每隔几周交付一: Requirements inevitably change during development. Instead of trying to design a perfect long-term plan at the start, teams can deliver a usable version every few weeks and keep adjusting it in response to users ([[p:feedback|feedback]]).
开发团队想快速发布新功能，运维团队想保持系统稳定；把两者合为一体并高度自动化，就: Development teams want to release new features quickly, while operations teams want stable systems. Bringing their work together and automating it extensively can support both speed and stability.
只要双方约定好\"怎么提要求、会得到什么回答\"，一个程序就能使用另一个程序的功: If two programs agree on how to make a request and what response to expect, one can use the other’s capabilities without knowing how it works internally ([[p:abstraction|abstraction]]).
把一个庞大的应用拆成许多小服务，每个服务只负责一件事、可以由一个小团队独立开发和: A large application is divided into small services. Each does one job and can be developed and deployed independently by a small team, so the system’s structure follows the teams’ structure ([[p:division|division of labor]]).
单台计算机的能力和可靠性总有上限；把任务分给许多台通过网络连接的计算机，就能突破: A single computer always has limits in capacity and reliability. Dividing work among networked computers can overcome these limits, but the system must cope with network delays, lost connections and failed machines.
当网络断开、系统被分成两半时（分区），你只能二选一：要么拒绝部分请求以保证所有人: When a network failure splits a system into disconnected parts—a partition—the system faces a choice: reject some requests to ensure that everyone sees consistent data, or keep serving requests while allowing temporary inconsistency.
多台机器中有一些可能会宕机或失联，但只要过半数的机器同意，就能就某个值达成可靠的: Some machines may fail or lose contact, but a majority can still reach reliable agreement on a value: any two majorities must share at least one machine.
文字命令可以精确表达、可以组合、可以保存成脚本反复执行——这是图形界面的点点按按: Text commands can express instructions precisely, be combined, and be saved as scripts for repeated execution—capabilities that clicking around a graphical interface does not provide in the same way.
人对\"看得见、指得到\"的东西反应最快；把文件、程序画成屏幕上可以直接拖动的图: People respond quickly to things they can see and point at. Showing files and programs as icons and windows that can be dragged on a screen removes the need to memorize commands and makes available actions visible ([[p:abstraction|abstraction]]).
人的手非常擅长指向；把手在桌面上的移动一比一地映射成屏幕上光标的移动，眼和手就形: The human hand is very good at pointing. Mapping its movement on a desk to the movement of a cursor on screen creates a close [[p:feedback|feedback]] loop between hand and eye.
把计算写成格子之间的关系（\"这一格 = 那两格之和\"），改一个数，所有相关结: Calculations are expressed as relationships between cells, such as “this cell equals the sum of those two.” Change one number and all related results are recalculated automatically, letting people program without thinking of it as programming.
把文字先存在电子存储里而不是直接打在纸上，修改、复制、排版就都不再需要重打一遍。: Storing text electronically before putting it on paper means that editing, copying and formatting no longer require typing everything again.
图像可以用数学来描述：形状是一堆三角形的坐标，颜色由光线如何照射、反射和折射决定: Images can be described mathematically: shapes become coordinates of triangles, while colors depend on how light illuminates, reflects from and refracts through surfaces. With enough computing speed, a computer can draw any scene ([[p:optics|optics]]).
游戏是一个以极快速度循环的 [[p:feedback|反馈]] 系统：玩家操作、: A game is a very fast [[p:feedback|feedback]] loop: the player acts, the display responds, and the player acts again. The continuing demand for faster responses and better graphics has made games one of the strongest drivers of hardware development.
每个游戏都需要渲染、物理、声音、输入这些相同的基础功能；把它们做成可复用的平台，: Every game needs basic functions such as rendering, physics, sound and input. Packaging these into a reusable platform lets developers concentrate on the game itself.
一个集中的软件市场把\"找软件、装软件、付钱\"变成一键操作，开发者能直接触达全: A centralized software marketplace turns finding, installing and paying for software into a simple operation, while giving developers direct access to users worldwide. The platform controls distribution and takes a share of revenue ([[p:network|network effects]]).
为了节省当年昂贵的存储空间，程序只用两位数存年份；到了 2000 年，\"00\: To save storage space when it was expensive, programs stored years using only two digits. In 2000, “00” could therefore be interpreted as 1900. A small design shortcut became a worldwide risk decades later.
把\"提供服务\"和\"使用服务\"分开：数据和复杂计算集中在服务器上统一管理，: Providing a service and using it are separated: data and complex computation are managed centrally on the server, while the client handles presentation and interaction ([[p:division|division of labor]]).
把成千上万台服务器集中在一栋建筑里，共享电力、冷却和网络，规模越大，每单位计算的: Concentrating thousands or tens of thousands of servers in one building lets them share power, cooling and networking. Greater scale lowers the cost per unit of computation ([[p:scale|economies of scale]]), but almost all the electricity consumed becomes heat that must be removed ([[p:heat|heat transfer]]).
计算机的利用率通常很低，而自建机房又贵又慢；把海量服务器集中起来、通过网络按需出: Computers are often underused, while building a private data center is expensive and slow. Pooling large numbers of servers and renting their capacity over a network on demand lets customers pay for what they use, like water or electricity, and benefit from [[p:scale|economies of scale]] ([[p:abstraction|abstraction]]).
软件装在每个用户的电脑上，升级和维护就要做千万次；如果软件只运行在服务商那里、用: When software is installed on every user’s computer, upgrades and maintenance must be repeated millions of times. If it runs at the provider and users access it through a browser, only one shared service needs to be maintained ([[p:scale|economies of scale]]).
开发者真正关心的只是\"这段代码要运行\"，而不是\"运行在哪台服务器上\"；把: Developers mainly care that their code runs, rather than which server runs it. Handing server management to a platform allows them to pay only for the time their code actually runs ([[p:abstraction|abstraction]]).
光速和网络距离决定了延迟的下限；把计算放在离用户或设备更近的地方，就能更快响应，: The speed of light and the distance across a network set a lower limit on delay. Moving computation closer to users or devices can give faster responses and reduce the data that must be transmitted ([[p:locality|locality]]).
很多自然现象的规律能写成方程，却无法用纸笔求解；把时间和空间切成小块、一步步数值: Many natural phenomena can be described by equations that cannot be solved with pen and paper. Computers divide space and time into small steps for numerical approximation, or approach an answer through many random trials ([[p:probability|probability]]), creating a “third method of science.”
如果真有一个程序能判断\"任何程序是否会停\"，就可以构造一个\"故意和判断结果: Suppose a program could determine whether any program will stop. One could then construct a program that deliberately does the opposite of its prediction, producing a contradiction. A universal program of this kind therefore cannot exist ([[p:computability|computability]]).
检查一个答案对不对，往往比找出这个答案容易得多（比如验证一道数独比解开它容易）；: Checking an answer is often much easier than finding it—for example, checking a completed Sudoku is easier than solving it. Is this an unavoidable, fundamental difference? ([[p:complexity|computational complexity]])
如果 AI 能设计出比自己更聪明的 AI，改进的速度就可能一代比一代快，形成失控: If AI could design a smarter AI, each generation might improve faster than the previous one, producing uncontrolled [[p:exponential|exponential growth]]. This is a conjecture, not an established law.
CPU 只会做极简单的事——取一条指令、做一次加法或比较、把结果存起来——但它每: A CPU does only very simple things: fetch an instruction, perform an addition or comparison, and store the result. But it can repeat these steps several billion times per second, and vast numbers of simple operations add up to complex computation.
画面上几百万个像素、神经网络里几十亿次乘法，都是\"对大量数据做同一种运算\"；: Millions of pixels in an image and billions of multiplications in a neural network both involve applying the same operation to large amounts of data. Instead of a few powerful, sophisticated cores working through it sequentially, thousands or tens of thousands of simpler cores can work at once ([[p:division|division of labor]]).
数据搬运的速度取决于\"路有多宽、有多远\"。把内存芯片竖着叠起来、贴着处理器放: The speed of data movement depends on how wide the paths are and how far data must travel. Stacking memory chips vertically, placing them next to the processor and connecting them through thousands or tens of thousands of channels can increase bandwidth by an order of magnitude.
单个处理器的速度有物理上限，但把成千上万个处理器用高速网络连起来、把大问题拆成小: The speed of an individual processor has physical limits. But connecting thousands or tens of thousands of processors through a fast network and dividing a large problem into pieces to compute simultaneously can make total computing power grow linearly ([[p:division|division of labor]]).
现代 CPU 为了更快，加了大量\"预测\"和\"并行\"的技巧：[[pipel: Modern CPUs use many prediction and parallel-processing techniques to run faster. A [[pipeline|pipeline]] overlaps several instructions; branch prediction guesses which path a program will take; out-of-order execution handles ready instructions first; and multiple cores allow several CPUs to work at once (see [[multicore]]). These techniques are transparent to the programmer: the program still appears to execute instructions one at a time in order.
编程语言有严格的语法（怎么写才合法）和语义（写出来是什么意思）。程序员写好源代码: Programming languages have strict syntax—rules for valid writing—and semantics—the meaning of what is written. Once the programmer writes source code, a [[compiler|compiler]] translates the program into machine code, or an [[interpreter|interpreter]] reads and executes it as it goes. The higher-level a language is, the further it is from machine instructions: one line of Python may correspond to dozens of them.
**管 CPU**：在多个 [[process-thread|进程]] 之间快速: **Managing the CPU**: switching rapidly between [[process-thread|processes]], hundreds or thousands of times per second, so that they appear to run simultaneously;
**管内存**：用 [[virtual-memory|虚拟内存]] 给每个程序一: **Managing memory**: using [[virtual-memory|virtual memory]] to give each program its own address space, keeping programs from interfering with one another;
**管存储**：用 [[file-system|文件系统]] 把磁盘上的一堆数据: **Managing storage**: using a [[file-system|file system]] to organize disk blocks into files and folders;
**管设备**：通过 [[device-driver|驱动程序]] 统一操作键盘: **Managing devices**: using [[device-driver|device drivers]] to provide consistent ways to control keyboards, network cards, graphics cards and other hardware.
**存得稳**：数据写入后即使断电也不会丢，靠的是先写日志、再改数据；: **Reliable storage**: once data has been written, it survives even a power failure. The system achieves this by recording changes in a log before modifying the data;
**查得快**：用**索引**（通常是 B 树，像书末的索引页）避免逐行扫描，在: **Fast queries**: **indexes**, usually B-trees, work like the index at the back of a book, avoiding a row-by-row scan. Finding one record among a billion may require only a few disk reads;
**改得对**：用 [[transaction-acid|事务]] 保证多个人同: **Correct updates**: [[transaction-acid|transactions]] keep data correct when several people change it at the same time.
云服务商在全球建设巨型 [[data-center|数据中心]]，利用 [[vi: Cloud providers build large [[data-center|data centers]] around the world, using [[virtualization|virtualization]] and [[container|containers]] to divide physical resources among thousands or tens of thousands of customers. Cloud services usually fall into three layers, according to how much the provider manages for you:
**IaaS（基础设施即服务）**：租用虚拟机、存储和网络，操作系统以上自己管；: **IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service)**: rent virtual machines, storage and networking, while managing the operating system and everything above it yourself;
**PaaS（平台即服务）**：只需上传代码，运行环境由平台负责；: **PaaS (Platform as a Service)**: upload your code while the platform manages its runtime environment;
**SaaS（软件即服务）**：直接使用做好的软件，如网页邮箱和在线文档（见 [: **SaaS (Software as a Service)**: use ready-made software directly, such as webmail and online documents (see [[saas]]).
云的关键特点是**弹性**：几分钟内就能从 1 台服务器扩展到 1000 台，用: A defining feature of cloud computing is **elasticity**: capacity can grow from 1 server to 1,000 within minutes, then be released when it is no longer needed, with billing by the second or hour.
\"云\"并不在天上，而是地面上一栋栋耗电巨大的数据中心；数据放在云上也不代表自: The cloud is not in the sky: it consists of power-hungry data centers on the ground. Putting data in the cloud does not automatically make it secure; incorrect configuration is one of the most common causes of cloud data breaches.
1948 年香农（Claude Shannon）在《通信的数学理论》中使用并推广: In 1948, Claude Shannon used and popularized the word “bit” in A Mathematical Theory of Communication, crediting the statistician John Tukey with coining it. The 8-bit byte became a common standard with IBM System/360 in 1964.
比特让信息脱离了载体：同一份数据可以存在纸带、磁盘、光纤和闪存里，复制千万次也不: Bits separate information from its physical medium: the same data can be stored on paper tape, magnetic disks, optical fiber or flash memory, and copied millions of times without alteration.
水龙头能用一个小动作控制水流。晶体管也能用电信号控制另一部分电流，是芯片里的关键: A small movement of a faucet controls a flow of water. Similarly, a transistor uses an electrical signal to control current elsewhere in a circuit, making it a key component in chips.
**一句话导读：电子技术做的所有事，都是\"用电压推动电荷，再用一个开关控制它往: **In one sentence: everything electronics does comes down to using voltage to move electric charge, then using a switch to control where it goes.** This chapter follows the journey from capturing lightning to putting tens of billions of switches on a fingernail-sized piece of silicon.
卡片上每个位置打孔或不打孔，读卡机用电刷或探针穿过孔接通电路，计数器就加一。把卡: Each position on a card is either punched or left intact. In the reader, an electrical brush or probe passes through a hole to complete a circuit, adding one to a counter. Sorting cards by their hole patterns and adding the counts makes it possible to tabulate data on thousands or tens of thousands of people.
1971 年 [[microprocessor|微处理器]] 出现前，CPU 由: Before the [[microprocessor|microprocessor]] appeared in 1971, a CPU occupied many circuit boards. Today, phone and computer CPUs typically run at about 2–5 GHz, or 2–5 billion clock cycles per second.
今天一颗手机处理器有数百亿个晶体管，比 4004 多了约一千万倍。微处理器让\": A phone processor today contains tens of billions of transistors, roughly ten million times as many as the 4004. Microprocessors have embedded computation into everyday objects (see [[embedded-system]]).
共同点：用一个小的电信号控制一个大的电流: Both use a small electrical signal to control a larger current
控制端的电压决定通还是断: Control voltage turns it on or off
从上往下读：能量从自然界来，经热机或发电机转换，通过电网送达，存进电池，最后变成: Read downward: natural energy → heat engines or generators → power grid → batteries → light, heat and motion.
⑤ 用起来：光与热: ⑤ Use energy: light and heat

相控阵由成百上千个天线单元组成，每个单元后面有一个可调的移相器。计算机在微秒内改: A phased array contains hundreds or thousands of antenna elements, each with an adjustable phase shifter. A computer changes their phases within microseconds, steering the beam almost instantly in any direction, or even creating several beams to track several targets at once.
手机里有射频收发器、天线、处理芯片和电池。开机后它会自动寻找信号最强的基站并登记: A mobile phone contains a radio transceiver, antennas, processing chips and a battery. When switched on, it finds the strongest base-station signal and registers its location, so the network knows which base station should contact it for an incoming call. As the user moves, the call is handed over between base stations without interruption. Early 1G phones carried voice using analog frequency modulation and were easy to eavesdrop on. From 2G onward, digital signals enabled encryption and text messaging.
每一代移动网络都在三件事上进步：更高效的 [[modulation|调制]] 和: Each generation of mobile networks improves three things: [[modulation|modulation]] and multiple-access methods, the amount and width of available [[spectrum|spectrum]], and the use of multiple antennas (see [[mimo]]). A new generation arrives roughly every decade: 1G brought analog voice, 2G digital voice and texts, 3G mobile internet, 4G mobile broadband, and 5G connectivity for many kinds of devices.
据爱立信移动报告，2026 年第一季度全球 5G 用户已超过 30 亿，全世界大: According to the Ericsson Mobility Report, global 5G users exceeded 3 billion in the first quarter of 2026. Most people worldwide can receive a mobile signal (see [[mobile-phone]], [[5g]]).
把语音变成数字信号后，可以压缩、加密和纠错，还能让多个用户轮流使用同一频率（[[: Converting voice into a digital signal allows compression, encryption and error correction, and lets several users take turns on the same frequency ([[p:standard|standardization]]). A common standard across Europe lets one phone work in different countries.
GSM 把每个 200 千赫的频道按时间切成 8 个时隙，8 个用户轮流使用；用: GSM divides each 200 kHz channel into 8 time slots, shared by 8 users in turn. A [[sim-card|SIM card]] stores the user’s identity and keys, so they can move the card to another phone. The signaling channel can also carry short messages: [[sms|SMS]]. Later, GPRS and EDGE enabled 2G phones to access the internet at tens to hundreds of kilobits per second.
GSM 成为全球最普及的 2G 标准，\"全球漫游\"由此成为现实（见 [[ce: GSM became the world’s most widely used 2G standard, making global roaming possible (see [[cellular-network]], [[3g]]).
在已有的信令通道里\"顺便\"捎带一点数据，几乎不占额外资源（[[p:info|: Small amounts of data can be carried alongside existing signaling traffic, using almost no additional resources ([[p:info|information theory]]).
短信意外成为全球最流行的通信方式之一，催生了\"拇指一代\"，后来被 [[ins: SMS unexpectedly became one of the world’s most popular forms of communication, creating a “thumb generation.” It was later displaced by [[instant-messaging|instant messaging]], but remains a major channel for verification codes and notifications (see [[gsm-2g]]).
要让手机上网，就要把更宽的频带和更高效的编码分给数据（[[p:info|信息论]: Giving phones internet access requires wider frequency bands and more efficient coding for data ([[p:info|information theory]]).
3G 让手机真正能浏览网页、收发邮件，为 2007 年后智能手机的爆发准备了网络: 3G made practical web browsing and email possible on phones, providing the network capacity for the smartphone boom after 2007 (see [[4g-lte]], [[mobile-internet]]).
把一段宽频带切成成百上千个互相正交的窄子载波并行传输（正交频分复用，OFDM），: Dividing a wide frequency band into hundreds or thousands of mutually orthogonal narrow subcarriers allows parallel transmission. This is orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM). Combined with multiple antennas, it greatly improves spectrum efficiency ([[p:info|information theory]]).
4G 让移动支付、网约车、短视频、直播和外卖成为日常，是移动互联网真正爆发的基础: 4G made mobile payments, ride-hailing, short videos, live streaming and food delivery part of everyday life, providing the foundation for the mobile internet boom (see [[3g]], [[5g]], [[mobile-internet]]).
智能的很大一部分可以看成\"根据输入选出好的输出\"。只要能把\"好\"写成可计: Much of intelligence can be viewed as choosing a good output for a given input. If “good” can be expressed as a computable score, enough examples or rules allow a machine to approach that mapping step by step ([[p:optimization|optimization]]). In principle, a cognitive process that can be described as precise steps can be carried out by a machine.
AI 不是某一种技术，而是一个目标，七十年来大致走过三条路：: AI is a goal rather than a single technology. Over roughly seventy years, researchers have followed three broad approaches:
**符号主义**：人把知识写成规则，机器负责推理（见 [[symbolic-ai: **Symbolic AI**: people encode knowledge as rules, and machines perform the reasoning (see [[symbolic-ai]]). This works well for tasks such as chess and theorem proving, but it is impossible to write rules for everything, so the approach struggles with the ambiguity of the real world.
**机器学习**：不写规则，给数据，让机器自己总结规律（见 [[machine-: **Machine learning**: provide data instead of explicit rules, and let the machine discover patterns (see [[machine-learning]]).
**深度学习与大模型**：用多层神经网络自动学特征，再把规模放大到千亿参数（见: **Deep learning and large models**: multilayer neural networks learn features automatically, with models scaled to hundreds of billions of parameters (see [[deep-learning]], [[llm]]). Much of what people call AI today follows this approach.
AI 不等于\"像人一样思考\"。它可能在难题上超过专家，却在数清物体这类简单事: AI does not necessarily think like a person. It may outperform experts on difficult tasks while making mistakes on seemingly simple ones, such as counting objects.
与其由人写规则，不如给出大量\"输入—正确输出\"的例子，再定义一个衡量\"错了: Instead of writing rules by hand, provide many examples of inputs and their correct outputs, then define a score measuring the error. The computer adjusts parameters to minimize it ([[p:optimization|optimization]]). Applying what it learns to new data relies on [[p:probability|statistics]]: when old and new data come from the same distribution, good performance on a sample is more likely to extend to the wider population.
四个要素：**数据**（例子）、**模型**（带参数的函数，如决策树、神经网络）: There are four elements: **data** (examples), a **model** (a function with parameters, such as a decision tree or neural network), a **loss function** (see [[loss-function]]) and an **optimization algorithm** (such as [[gradient-descent]]).
按\"老师给不给答案\"分三类：[[supervised-learning|监督: Depending on whether and how a teacher supplies answers, the main categories are [[supervised-learning|supervised learning]], [[unsupervised-learning|unsupervised learning]] and [[reinforcement-learning|reinforcement learning]]. After training, the model must be tested on unseen data to check for [[overfitting|overfitting]].
它学到的是相关而非因果。数据有偏，模型就有偏（见 [[ai-bias]]）；数据: It learns correlations rather than causes. Biased data leads to biased models (see [[ai-bias]]), and a change in the data distribution can cause a model to fail.
一个人工神经元只做一件事：输入乘权重、加起来，再过一个非线性\"开关\"。单个神: An artificial neuron multiplies its inputs by weights, adds them together and applies a nonlinear “switch.” One neuron is simple, but thousands or tens of thousands arranged in layers can approximate almost any input–output relationship, as described by the universal approximation theorem. Learning adjusts the weights to bring outputs closer to the answers ([[p:optimization|optimization]]). Each layer processes the previous layer’s results into increasingly [[p:abstraction|abstract]] features.
网络由输入层、若干隐藏层和输出层组成。以识别手写数字为例：输入是 784 个像素: A network has an input layer, several hidden layers and an output layer. For handwritten-digit recognition, the input might be the brightness values of 784 pixels. The first layer may learn to detect short strokes, the next may combine them into circles and corners, and the output layer’s 10 neurons represent the likelihoods of the digits 0–9.
非线性激活函数（如 ReLU：负数变 0、正数不变）至关重要——没有它，再多层也: Nonlinear activation functions are essential. ReLU, for example, turns negative values into 0 and leaves positive ones unchanged. Without nonlinearity, even many layers would be equivalent to a single linear transformation. The network’s knowledge is stored in its connection weights; large models contain hundreds of billions of these numbers.
人工神经网络只是\"受大脑启发\"，并不模拟真实神经元的放电和化学信号。: Artificial neural networks are inspired by the brain; they do not simulate the electrical spikes and chemical signals of real neurons.
网络输出错了，要知道每个权重\"该负多少责任\"。微积分的链式法则说：复合函数的: When a network’s output is wrong, training needs to determine how much each weight contributed to the error. The chain rule of calculus computes a composite function’s derivative by multiplying derivatives through its layers. Starting at the output error and working backward gives the gradients for all weights in one pass, after which [[gradient-descent|gradient descent]] updates them ([[p:optimization|optimization]]).
每次训练分两趟：: Each training step involves two passes:
**前向传播**：输入从第一层流到最后一层，得到预测，用 [[loss-func: **Forward pass**: input flows from the first layer to the last to produce a prediction, and a [[loss-function|loss function]] measures its error.
**反向传播**：误差信号从最后一层往回传。每经过一层，就用这一层的局部导数乘上: **Backward pass**: an error signal travels backward from the last layer. At each layer, local derivatives multiply the incoming signal to calculate gradients for that layer’s weights, while the signal continues to the preceding layer.
妙处在效率：算出全部上亿个梯度，只需约两倍于前向计算的工作量；若逐个权重试探，要: The advantage is efficiency: computing hundreds of millions of gradients takes only about twice the work of a forward calculation. Probing each weight separately would require hundreds of millions of additional forward calculations. Frameworks such as PyTorch and JAX automate this process for programs; it is called automatic differentiation.
大脑大概率不是这样学习的——生物神经元没有把精确误差往回送的通道。: The brain probably does not learn this way: biological neurons have no channel for transmitting precise error signals backward.
像素、声波、文字与\"猫\"\"你好\"这样的概念之间隔着很多层抽象。深层网络让: Many layers of abstraction separate pixels, sound waves and written characters from concepts such as “cat” or “hello.” In a deep network, each layer performs a small processing step. Stacking these steps lets the network learn increasingly [[p:abstraction|abstract]] features directly from raw data. Performance improves as data and computing resources increase by orders of magnitude ([[p:scale|scale effects]]).
传统机器学习要专家手工设计特征，模型只做最后一步分类。深度学习把特征提取也交给网: In traditional machine learning, experts hand-design features and the model performs the final classification. Deep learning also assigns feature extraction to the network: in image recognition, lower layers learn edges and colors, middle layers learn textures and parts such as eyes and wheels, and higher layers learn whole objects.
它在 2010 年代爆发，靠三样东西同时到位：**大数据**（互联网与 [[im: Its rapid growth in the 2010s depended on three things arriving together: **large datasets** from the internet and [[imagenet]], **powerful computation** using [[gpu]], and **better methods**, including ReLU, dropout, improved initialization and [[resnet|residual networks]].
深度学习擅长在见过的数据附近\"插值\"；遇到全新情况仍可能出错，而且难以解释原: Deep learning is good at interpolating near data it has seen. It may still fail in entirely new situations, and its reasons can be difficult to explain (see [[explainable-ai]]).
句子里任意两个词之间都可能有关系，不必按顺序一个个传递——[[attention: Any two words in a sentence may be related; information need not pass through them one at a time in sequence. [[attention-mechanism|Attention]] lets each word directly examine the other words. Positions can be computed in parallel without waiting for the preceding position, making good use of GPUs ([[p:division|division of labor]]). This parallelism allows unprecedented model and dataset sizes ([[p:scale|scale effects]]).
文本先被切成 token（见 [[tokenization]]），每个 toke: Text is divided into tokens (see [[tokenization]]). Each token becomes a vector with added position information, then passes through tens to hundreds of similarly structured layers. Each layer performs two steps:
**自注意力**：每个 token 按相关度从其他 token 收集信息；多个\: **Self-attention**: each token gathers information from other tokens according to their relevance. Multiple attention heads focus on different relationships, such as syntax, references and meaning.
**前馈网络**：对每个 token 单独做一次非线性加工，被认为存放了大量\": **Feed-forward network**: each token is processed separately through a nonlinear transformation. These networks are thought to store much of the model’s knowledge.
每步都带 [[resnet|残差连接]] 和归一化，最后一层输出下一个 toke: Each step includes [[resnet|residual connections]] and normalization. The last layer outputs probabilities for the next token. The original translation paper used an encoder–decoder architecture; GPT uses only a decoder for generation, while BERT uses only an encoder for understanding.
注意力的计算量随长度平方增长，处理百万 token 需要稀疏注意力等改进；也有研: Attention’s computational cost grows with the square of sequence length, so handling a million tokens requires improvements such as sparse attention. Researchers are also exploring architectures that might replace it.
要把下一个词猜准，就得掌握语法、事实、逻辑甚至说话人的意图——猜得越准，压缩进参: Accurately predicting the next word requires learning grammar, facts, logic and even a speaker’s intent. Better prediction compresses more knowledge about the world into the parameters ([[p:probability|probability]]). Increasing model size, data and computation by orders of magnitude produces predictable improvements and new capabilities ([[p:scale|scale effects]]; see [[scaling-laws]]).
大语言模型的诞生分三步：: A large language model is developed and used in three stages:
**预训练**：用数万亿 token 的网页、书籍和代码训练一个巨大的 [[tr: **Pretraining**: a large [[transformer-model|Transformer]] is trained on trillions of tokens from webpages, books and code. Its task is to predict the next token from the preceding text. This stage consumes most of the computing resources and produces a base model that can continue text.
**后训练**：用人写的问答示范做指令微调，再用 [[rlhf|人类反馈强化学习: **Post-training**: human-written question-and-answer examples are used for instruction tuning, followed by [[rlhf|reinforcement learning from human feedback]] to make the model useful, honest and safe. More recently, large-scale reinforcement learning on automatically checkable tasks, such as mathematics and code, has produced reasoning models that can spend longer working through problems (see [[chain-of-thought]]).
**使用**：模型每次生成一个 token，接到末尾再生成下一个，直到答完；还能: **Use**: the model generates one token, appends it to the text and generates the next until the answer is complete. It can also call tools such as search and code execution to carry out multistep tasks (see [[ai-agent]]).
预测下一个词不等于只会鹦鹉学舌，但它也会自信地编造（见 [[hallucinat: Predicting the next word does not mean a model can only parrot text. However, it can confidently invent information (see [[hallucination]]), and its knowledge has a cutoff date.
电流在导线中以接近光速的速度传播，而在远端用电磁铁就能让它\"做动作\"（[[p: An electrical signal travels along a wire at close to the speed of light, and an electromagnet at the far end turns it into movement ([[p:lorentz|electromagnetic force]]). Agreeing on which on/off patterns represent each letter allows information to cross great distances almost instantly ([[p:info|information theory]]).
调幅把声音的强弱变成载波幅度的大小，调频把它变成载波频率的快慢（[[p:emwa: Amplitude modulation makes the carrier’s amplitude vary with the strength of a sound signal. Frequency modulation varies its frequency instead ([[p:emwave|electromagnetic waves]]). Noise from lightning and electrical appliances mainly affects amplitude, so FM is inherently more resistant to such interference.
光从玻璃射向空气时，只要入射角足够大，就会被全部反射回来，一点也不漏出去（全反射: When light travels from glass toward air at a sufficiently large angle of incidence, it is reflected entirely back into the glass rather than escaping across the boundary—total internal reflection ([[p:optics|reflection and refraction]]). Light’s frequency is tens of thousands of times higher than radio frequencies, allowing it to carry far more information ([[p:info|information theory]]).
电话不需要线，只要让手机和附近的基站之间用无线电通信（[[p:emwave|电磁: A phone can work without a wire by communicating with a nearby base station using radio ([[p:emwave|electromagnetic waves]]), while the base station connects to the fixed telephone network. The real challenge is letting thousands or tens of thousands of people call at once using limited frequencies. The solution is the [[cellular-network|cellular network]].
一个频率被一部手机占用后，附近的其他手机就不能再用；但无线电信号会随距离衰减，相: Once a phone occupies a frequency, nearby phones cannot use it in the same way. But radio signals weaken with distance, so sufficiently separated locations can reuse a frequency without interference ([[p:emwave|electromagnetic waves]]). Dividing an area into small cells allows more reuse as cells get smaller, multiplying total capacity ([[p:scale|scale]], [[p:info|information theory]]).
一个网页被链接，就像得到一票；来自重要网页的票分量更重。这是一个\"随机浏览者\: A link to a webpage acts like a vote, with votes from important pages carrying more weight. In the random-surfer model, a person follows links at random; pages with a higher probability of being visited are considered more important ([[p:probability|probability]]).
把消息层层加密，像洋葱一样包好，每个中继只能剥开一层、只知道上一站和下一站，没有: A message is encrypted in layers, like an onion. Each relay can remove only one layer and knows only the previous and next hops. No single relay knows both who is visiting and what they are visiting ([[p:oneway|one-way functions]]).
给全世界每份文档一个唯一的地址（URL），用统一的格式写网页、统一的协议传网页，: Assign each document a unique address, or URL; use a common page format and transfer protocol; and allow any page to link to any other. Scattered information then becomes an interconnected web ([[p:standard|standardization]]). Each additional website makes that web more useful to everyone ([[p:network|network effects]]).
利用\"公开加密、私密解密\"的数学单向性，素不相识的两方能在被人窃听的网络上安: The mathematical one-way relationship between public-key encryption and private-key decryption allows two parties who have never met to agree on a shared secret key over a network that others can monitor ([[p:oneway|one-way functions]]).

你能用一个生活例子解释它的原理吗？: Can you explain how it works using an everyday example?
纯铁很软，因为铁原子排成整齐的晶格，受力时原子层容易成片滑移。混进少量碳原子，这: Pure iron is soft because its atoms form an orderly crystal lattice whose layers can slide easily under force. Small amounts of carbon act like tiny pins in the lattice, obstructing this movement and making the iron harder and tougher; too much carbon makes it brittle. Heating and cooling change the internal structure, allowing the same steel to be made softer or harder ([[p:structure|structure determines properties]], [[p:stress|stress and strength]]).
空气中近八成是氮气，但两个氮原子之间是极牢固的三键，植物无法直接利用。在高温下，: Almost four-fifths of air is nitrogen, but nitrogen molecules have exceptionally strong triple bonds that plants cannot use directly. At high temperatures, an iron catalyst helps break these bonds so nitrogen can combine with hydrogen to form ammonia ([[p:catalysis|catalysis]], [[p:bond|chemical bonds]]). The reaction reduces gas volume, so high pressure favors ammonia production. Higher temperatures speed the reaction but make its equilibrium less favorable; engineers balance pressure, temperature and catalyst performance.
把成千上万个小分子（单体）用化学键首尾相连，就得到一条长链分子。长链像一盆面条一: Joining thousands or tens of thousands of small molecules, called monomers, with chemical bonds produces long molecular chains. These chains tangle like noodles, allowing the material to stretch without easily breaking, soften when heated and hold its shape when cooled ([[p:polymer|polymerization]]). Whether chains are straight or branched, orderly or irregular, and linked to one another determines whether the material is a rigid plastic, a strong fiber or elastic rubber ([[p:structure|structure determines properties]]).
塑料是以合成高分子为主体的材料。加热时长链能滑动，就能注塑、挤出成任意形状；冷却: Plastics are materials based on synthetic polymers. On heating, the long chains can slide past one another, allowing injection molding or extrusion into many shapes. Cooling locks the chains in place to form a solid product ([[p:polymer|polymerization]]). Stable carbon–carbon and carbon–hydrogen bonds make plastics light, water-resistant and corrosion-resistant, but also difficult to break down naturally.
一个人一天能输出的机械功很有限，而一台蒸汽机可以不知疲倦地输出几十个人的力气（[: A person can deliver only a limited amount of mechanical work in a day. A steam engine can continuously provide the power of dozens of people ([[p:energy|energy]]). Connecting that power to specialized machines, bringing workers and machines together in factories, and dividing work into simple operations multiplies output ([[p:division|division of labor]]). Larger production volumes lower unit costs ([[p:scale|economies of scale]]).
与其让工人围着一辆车走来走去，不如让车在传送带上移动，每个工人站在固定位置，只做: Instead of workers walking around a car, the car moves along a conveyor while each worker stays in one place and performs a simple operation ([[p:division|division of labor]]).
