1956 年，美国 Ampex 公司推出第一台实用的录像机，供电视台使用；197: American Ampex introduced the first practical videotape recorder for broadcasters in 1956. Sony launched Betamax in 1975 and JVC introduced VHS in 1976. VHS ultimately won the home-video format war.
观众第一次可以随时录下和回看节目，录像租赁业兴起，电影公司多了一项重要收入；\": Viewers could record and replay programs at convenient times. Video rental became an industry and an important revenue source for film studios. Time-shifted viewing later continued through digital recording and on-demand services.
只记录画面之间的变化和人眼敏感的信息，把视频压缩上百倍。: Records changes between frames and visually significant information, reducing video data by a hundredfold or more.
视频中相邻的两帧画面通常只有很小的差别。只记录变化，而不是每一帧都完整保存，再去: Adjacent video frames usually differ only slightly. Recording these changes instead of every complete frame, then discarding less perceptible detail ([[p:info|information and compression]]), can reduce data by a hundredfold or more.
编码器每隔一段时间保存一张完整的关键帧，其余帧只记录\"哪一块画面从哪里移动过来: The encoder periodically stores a complete keyframe. Other frames describe which image blocks moved where and the remaining differences: motion compensation. The differences are compressed using transforms and quantization similar to [[jpeg|JPEG]]. The decoder follows the same rules to reconstruct the pictures.
2003 年，国际电信联盟和国际标准化组织联合发布 H.264 标准；之后又有效: The ITU and ISO jointly released H.264 in 2003, followed by the more efficient H.265 in 2013 and royalty-free AV1 in 2018.
高清视频可以通过普通网络流畅播放，视频通话、短视频和流媒体因此成为可能；视频已占: High-definition video can play smoothly over ordinary networks, enabling video calls, short videos and streaming. Video now accounts for most global internet traffic.
把图像分成小块、去掉人眼不敏感的高频细节，是最常用的照片格式。: Divides images into small blocks and discards less noticeable high-frequency detail, producing a widely used photograph format.
人眼对亮度的大块变化很敏感，对颜色和细微纹理却比较迟钝。把图像分解成从平缓到细密: Vision is sensitive to broad brightness changes but less sensitive to color differences and fine texture. Decomposing an image into low- and high-frequency components and storing fine detail less precisely ([[p:info|information and compression]]) can shrink a file roughly tenfold with little visible change.
图像先分成 8×8 像素的小块，每块用离散余弦变换转换成 64 个频率系数；高频: The image is divided into 8×8-pixel blocks. A discrete cosine transform converts each into 64 frequency coefficients. High-frequency coefficients are rounded heavily, often to zero, then packed with lossless coding. Excessive compression creates visible block artifacts.
1974 年，艾哈迈德（Nasir Ahmed）等人提出离散余弦变换；1992: Nasir Ahmed and colleagues proposed the discrete cosine transform in 1974. The Joint Photographic Experts Group published the JPEG standard in 1992.
数码照片可以快速存储和在网上传送，网页图片和数码相机都采用它；它是迄今为止使用最: Digital photographs could be stored and transmitted online quickly. Used by cameras and websites, JPEG became the most widely used image format.
用头戴显示器把人带进虚拟世界（VR）或在现实上叠加信息（AR）。: Head-mounted displays immerse users in virtual worlds (VR) or overlay information on reality (AR).
人用两只眼睛从略有不同的角度看世界，大脑据此判断距离（[[p:optics|光学: Our eyes view the world from slightly different angles, allowing the brain to judge distance ([[p:optics|optics and vision]]). Showing a different image to each eye and updating it rapidly as the head turns can create the impression of occupying another space.
头显内部有两块屏幕和放大透镜，惯性传感器和摄像头每秒数百次地追踪头部的位置和朝向: A headset contains two displays and magnifying lenses. Inertial sensors and cameras track head position and orientation hundreds of times per second, allowing a computer to render new views. Motion-to-display latency should stay below roughly 20 milliseconds to reduce dizziness. AR overlays virtual objects using transparent optics or camera views of the real world.
1968 年，计算机图形学先驱萨瑟兰（Ivan Sutherland）造出第一台: Computer-graphics pioneer Ivan Sutherland built the first head-mounted display in 1968. So heavy that it hung from the ceiling, it was nicknamed the “Sword of Damocles.” Oculus Rift gained attention through crowdfunding in 2012, and Pokémon Go popularized mobile AR games worldwide in 2016.
VR 用于游戏和手术训练；但头显的重量、价格和眩晕问题，让它至今未能像手机一样普: VR is used in gaming and surgical training. Headset weight, price and motion sickness have limited adoption compared with smartphones.
把电视信号数字化压缩传输，同一频道可传多套高清节目。: Digitizes and compresses television signals so one channel can carry several high-definition programs.
模拟电视信号一旦受到干扰就会出现雪花和重影，而数字信号只要能分辨 0 和 1 就: Interference causes snow and ghosting in analog television. Digital signals can be recovered exactly as long as 0s and 1s remain distinguishable ([[p:info|digitization]]). Combined with video compression, this lets a channel that once carried one analog program carry several high-definition programs ([[p:sampling|sampling]]).
电视台把节目压缩编码成数据流，加上纠错码，调制后通过地面、有线或卫星发送；接收端: Broadcasters compress programs into data streams, add error correction and modulate them for terrestrial, cable or satellite transmission. A set-top box or television demodulates, corrects errors and decodes the picture. Reception tends to remain clear until it fails, rather than gradually developing analog snow.
1998 年，英国和美国开始播出地面数字电视；美国 2009 年关闭了全功率模拟: The United Kingdom and United States began terrestrial digital television broadcasts in 1998. The United States shut down full-power analog broadcasts in 2009. China published its terrestrial digital television standard in 2006.
画质提升到高清和 4K，频道数量大增；腾出来的频谱被拍卖给移动通信使用，这被称为: Picture quality rose to HD and 4K, and channel counts increased. Released spectrum was auctioned for mobile communications, creating the “digital dividend.”
持续存在、多人共享的三维虚拟空间设想，2021 年成为热词，落地远低于预期。: The idea of persistent, shared 3D virtual spaces became a buzzword in 2021, but adoption fell far below expectations.
互联网从文字发展到图片和视频，下一步自然是共享的三维空间：许多人以虚拟化身同时出: The internet progressed from text to images and video; a proposed next step is shared 3D space. Many people appear as avatars in a persistent world ([[p:network|network effects]]) to socialize, work and trade.
它依赖游戏引擎实时渲染三维场景，服务器同步成千上万用户的位置和动作，VR/AR: Game engines render scenes in real time, servers synchronize thousands or tens of thousands of users, and VR/AR devices provide immersion. Some systems use blockchains to record ownership of virtual goods. Existing close examples are massively multiplayer online games and virtual social platforms.
1992 年，斯蒂芬森的科幻小说《雪崩》创造了\"元宇宙\"（Metaverse: Neal Stephenson coined “metaverse” in his 1992 science-fiction novel Snow Crash. Facebook renamed itself Meta in October 2021, making the term widely discussed.
资本一度大量涌入，但用户增长远低于预期，Meta 的相关部门累计亏损数百亿美元；: Investment surged, but user growth fell far below expectations. Meta’s related division accumulated losses of tens of billions of dollars, and generative AI soon displaced much of the attention.
用蒸汽动力和滚筒连续印刷，每小时数千到数万张，让报纸成为大众媒体。: Steam power and rotating cylinders print thousands to tens of thousands of sheets per hour, making newspapers a mass medium.
手摇印刷机每印一张都要放纸、压印、取纸，速度受限于人力。改用蒸汽动力和连续旋转的: Hand presses require loading, pressing and removing each sheet, limiting speed to human effort. Steam power and continuously rotating cylinders ([[p:leverage|mechanical transmission]]) replace intermittent movements with continuous ones, increasing speed tens or hundreds of times ([[p:scale|economies of scale]]).
轮转印刷机把印版弯成圆筒，与压印滚筒相对旋转，连续的卷筒纸从中间穿过，两面同时印: A rotary press curves printing plates around cylinders that rotate against impression cylinders. Continuous paper passes between them, printing both sides before automatic cutting and folding. Combined with Linotype typesetting, a newspaper can move from composition to printing in a few hours.
1814 年 11 月，伦敦《泰晤士报》首次用柯尼希（Friedrich Koe: In November 1814, The Times in London first used Friedrich Koenig’s steam press, printing about 1,100 sheets per hour. American Richard Hoe invented the rotary press in 1843.
报纸价格降到人人买得起，\"便士报\"和大众新闻业兴起，识字率和公共舆论随之发展: Newspapers became affordable to ordinary readers. Penny papers and mass journalism emerged, supporting literacy and public debate.
按键驱动字锤把字母打到纸上，QWERTY 键盘布局沿用至今。: Keys drive typebars that strike letters onto paper. The QWERTY layout remains in use today.
手写速度慢且字迹因人而异。把每个字母做成一个固定的字锤（[[p:standard: Handwriting is slow and varies between people. Giving every letter a fixed typebar ([[p:standard|standardization]]) lets a key and lever strike it through an ink ribbon onto paper, producing uniform text regardless of the typist.
每个按键连接一根字杆，按下后字杆向上弹起，把字母印在纸上；滚筒随后自动向左移动一: Each key connects to a typebar that swings up to print a letter. The carriage then moves left one space and returns at the end of a line. The QWERTY arrangement separates common letter combinations to reduce neighboring typebars jamming.
1868 年，美国人肖尔斯（Christopher Latham Sholes）: Christopher Latham Sholes and colleagues received a US typewriter patent in 1868. Remington began mass production in 1874 using a QWERTY keyboard.
办公文书效率大大提高，打字员成为女性大规模进入办公室的重要职业；QWERTY 布: Office document production became much faster. Typing was an important route for women entering office employment. Computer keyboards inherited QWERTY, which remains widespread.
把按键变成字符编码；拼音和五笔等输入法解决了汉字输入难题。: Converts keystrokes into character codes. Input methods such as Pinyin and Wubi make Chinese characters practical to type.
键盘的每个按键对应一个编码，按下时计算机收到一个代码，再按编码标准显示成字符（[: Each key sends a code that the computer interprets as a character under an encoding standard ([[p:standard|standards]]). A few dozen keys directly represent Latin letters; Chinese input methods convert key sequences into thousands or tens of thousands of characters.
拼音输入法根据拼音列出同音字词，并用统计语言模型（[[p:probability: Pinyin input lists characters and words matching the typed pronunciation, using statistical language models ([[p:probability|probability]]) to rank likely choices. Shape-based systems such as Wubi encode character components, offering fewer ambiguities and fast entry but requiring memorization. Phones also support handwriting, speech and nine-key input.
1983 年，王永民发明五笔字型输入法；2000 年代，智能拼音输入法借助大规模: Wang Yongmin invented the Wubi input method in 1983. Intelligent Pinyin input spread rapidly in the 2000s using large text corpora.
输入法解决了\"汉字不能进入计算机\"的担忧，中文信息化得以快速推进。: Input methods overcame fears that Chinese characters would be incompatible with computers, accelerating Chinese-language computing.
利用静电吸附墨粉复制文件，施乐 914 让复印成为办公日常。: Uses electrostatic attraction to copy documents with toner. The Xerox 914 made photocopying routine in offices.
某些材料在黑暗中是绝缘体，见光后变成导体（光电导，[[p:photoelectr: Some materials are insulators in darkness but conduct when illuminated: photoconductivity ([[p:photoelectric|photoelectric effect]]). A uniformly charged drum receives an image of the original. Charge disappears in bright areas and remains in dark areas, forming an invisible electrostatic image that oppositely charged toner reveals ([[p:charge|electrostatics]]).
墨粉被吸附到感光鼓上有电荷的地方，再转印到纸上，经过加热辊熔化固定。几秒钟就能复: Toner adheres to charged regions of the drum, transfers to paper and is melted in place by heated rollers. A page can be copied in seconds.
1938 年，美国专利律师卡尔森（Chester Carlson）发明了静电复印: American patent attorney Chester Carlson invented xerography in 1938, and Xerox later developed it. The Xerox 914, introduced in 1959, became a highly successful office machine.
复制文件变得快速廉价，办公室、学校和图书馆的信息流通大大加快；激光打印机正是在复: Fast, inexpensive copying accelerated information exchange in offices, schools and libraries. Laser printers developed from photocopier technology.
激光在感光鼓上\"画\"出静电图像吸附墨粉；喷墨则把微小墨滴精确喷到纸上。: A laser draws an electrostatic image on a drum to attract toner; inkjet printers place tiny ink droplets precisely on paper.
激光打印机和复印机用的是同一套静电成像原理（[[p:charge|静电]]），区: Laser printers use the same electrostatic imaging principle as photocopiers ([[p:charge|electrostatics]]). Instead of projecting an original document, a computer controls a [[laser|laser]] that draws the image line by line on the drum ([[p:optics|optics]]).
旋转的多面镜让激光束横向扫过感光鼓，激光按照像素数据快速开关，照到的地方电荷消失: A rotating polygon mirror sweeps the laser across the drum, switching it on and off according to pixel data. Illuminated areas lose charge. The drum collects toner, transfers it to paper and the toner is fused by heat. Resolutions of 600 dots per inch or more produce sharp text edges.
1971 年，施乐帕洛阿尔托研究中心的斯塔克韦瑟（Gary Starkweath: Gary Starkweather at Xerox PARC built the first laser printer in 1971. HP’s 1984 LaserJet brought laser printing into ordinary offices.
激光打印机与桌面出版软件结合，让普通办公室也能印出接近印刷品质量的文件；彩色和家: Laser printers combined with desktop-publishing software let offices produce near-press-quality documents. Color and home printing often use [[inkjet-printing|inkjet printers]].
用热气泡或压电陶瓷把皮升级墨滴精确喷到纸面，也用于 3D 打印和 OLED 制造: Thermal bubbles or piezoelectric ceramics eject picoliter ink droplets precisely onto paper, with applications in 3D printing and OLED manufacturing.
要在纸上精确放置颜料，可以不接触纸面，直接把极小的墨滴\"射\"上去。让墨水受热: Pigment can be placed precisely without touching the paper by firing tiny droplets at it. Rapidly heating ink to form a vapor bubble, or squeezing an ink chamber with piezoelectric ceramic ([[p:fluid|fluid mechanics]]), ejects picoliter-scale drops.
打印头上有数百个微型喷嘴，每个喷嘴旁有一个加热电阻或压电元件，按照图像数据在微秒: A printhead contains hundreds of microscopic nozzles, each beside a heating resistor or piezoelectric element. Image data triggers droplets within microseconds. The head moves horizontally as paper advances vertically; cyan, magenta, yellow and black droplets combine to reproduce colors.
1977 年前后，佳能的工程师发现加热会让墨水喷射，发明了热发泡技术；1984: Around 1977, Canon engineers discovered that heating could eject ink and developed thermal bubble technology. HP launched its first thermal inkjet printer in 1984, while Epson developed piezoelectric inkjet printing.
喷墨打印机让彩色照片打印走进家庭；同样的技术还用于印制电路、3D 打印和 OLE: Inkjet printers brought color photo printing into homes. The technology also prints circuits and supports 3D printing and OLED-screen manufacturing.
把书变成可下载的文件，配合电子墨水屏，像读纸一样读屏幕。: Turns books into downloadable files, often read on reflective e-ink screens that resemble paper.
书的本质是文字信息，可以变成文件下载（[[p:info|信息]]）。电子墨水屏像: A book’s text can be stored and downloaded as a file ([[p:info|information]]). E-ink reflects ambient light like paper rather than emitting light or flickering. It needs power to change a page, but not to hold the image.
电子墨水屏的每个微胶囊里有带正电的白色颗粒和带负电的黑色颗粒，施加电压后，一种颜: Each e-ink microcapsule contains positively charged white particles and negatively charged black particles. Voltage brings one color to the surface to form text. Readers download books online, and one device can hold thousands of titles.
1971 年，哈特（Michael Hart）发起古登堡计划，开始把公版书变成电: Michael Hart founded Project Gutenberg in 1971 to digitize public-domain books. E-ink was developed at MIT around 1997, and Amazon introduced Kindle in 2007.
电子书改变了出版业的发行和定价；但纸质书并未消失，至今仍占图书市场的大部分。: E-books changed publishing distribution and pricing. Printed books remain in use and still account for most of the book market.
用轮廓字体和排版软件代替铅字，TeX、PostScript 和桌面出版改变了印刷: Outline fonts and layout software replaced metal type. TeX, PostScript and desktop publishing transformed printing.
铅字和照相排版里，每种字号的每个字都要一个实物字模。改用数学曲线描述字形的轮廓（: Metal type and phototypesetting required a physical master for each character at each size. Describing outlines mathematically ([[p:abstraction|abstraction]]) lets one font scale to any size and render clearly at different resolutions.
轮廓字体用贝塞尔曲线描述每个字形，渲染时根据大小和分辨率实时填充成像素；排版软件: Outline fonts describe glyphs with Bézier curves, converting them to pixels at the required size and resolution. Typesetting software handles line breaks, alignment, spacing and equations.
1978 年，计算机科学家高德纳（Donald Knuth）发布 TeX 排版系: Computer scientist Donald Knuth released TeX in 1978. In 1985, Apple’s laser printer, Adobe PostScript and page-layout software together launched the desktop-publishing revolution. In China, Wang Xuan led development of Chinese laser phototypesetting, replacing the traditional world of molten lead type.
排版从专业工厂走进了每台电脑；数学和科学论文至今仍大量使用 TeX。: Typesetting moved from specialist plants to personal computers. TeX remains widely used for mathematics and scientific papers.
受激辐射让大量原子发出相位一致的光，亮度高、方向集中、颜色纯。: Stimulated emission makes many atoms emit light in phase, producing a bright, narrow and spectrally pure beam.
原子中的电子在不同能级之间跳跃，可以吸收或发出特定频率的光子（[[p:level: Electrons moving between atomic energy levels absorb or emit photons of specific frequencies ([[p:levels|energy levels]]). A photon passing an excited atom can stimulate it to emit an identical photon with the same frequency, direction and phase. If more atoms occupy the upper level than the lower one—a population inversion—photons trigger an avalanche of copies, producing intense, directional and spectrally pure light ([[p:wave|coherent waves]]).
① 增益介质：红宝石晶体、氦氖气体、半导体等，里面的原子或电子可以被\"抽运\": ① Gain medium: ruby, helium-neon gas or a semiconductor, whose atoms or electrons can be pumped to higher energy levels.
② 泵浦：用闪光灯、电流或另一束光不断把粒子送上高能级，维持粒子数反转。: ② Pumping: a flashlamp, electric current or another light beam continually supplies energy to maintain population inversion.
③ 谐振腔：介质两端各放一面反射镜，光在中间来回穿行、不断放大，从略微透光的一端: ③ Resonator: mirrors at each end send light repeatedly through the medium, amplifying it. A partially transmitting mirror lets the beam escape.
1917 年，爱因斯坦提出受激辐射的理论；1954 年，汤斯（Charles T: Einstein proposed stimulated emission in 1917. Charles Townes and colleagues built a microwave maser in 1954; Townes and Schawlow proposed an optical laser in 1958. Theodore Maiman built the first laser using ruby at Hughes Research Laboratories in May 1960. Townes, Basov and Prokhorov shared the 1964 Nobel Prize in Physics.
激光刚发明时被戏称为\"一个寻找问题的解决方案\"，今天却无处不在：[[fibe: Initially called “a solution looking for a problem,” lasers now underpin [[fiber-optic|fiber-optic communication]], barcode scanners, optical discs, eye surgery, lidar and chip lithography.
激光的能量集中在极小的光斑里，直射眼睛也可能造成永久性视网膜损伤。: Laser energy is concentrated in a very small spot. Direct exposure to the eye can cause permanent retinal damage.
激光的三个要素：泵浦把原子送上高能级（粒子数反转），受激辐射复制出完全相同的光子: Three parts of a laser: pumping creates population inversion; stimulated emission produces identical photons; two mirrors amplify the light through repeated passes before it exits through the partially transmitting mirror.
记录光波的强度和相位，重现物体的立体像；防伪标签就是应用。: Records light’s intensity and phase to reconstruct a three-dimensional image. Anti-counterfeiting labels are one application.
普通照片只记录光的强弱，丢掉了光波的相位，也就丢掉了深度。全息术让物体反射的光和: Ordinary photographs record intensity but lose phase and therefore depth information. Holography combines reflected light with a reference beam, recording both through interference fringes ([[p:wave|wave interference]]). Illuminating the recording with the reference beam reconstructs the original light wave and a three-dimensional image.
激光分成两束：一束照亮物体，另一束直接照到底片上，两束光在底片上干涉，形成细密的: A laser is split into two beams. One illuminates the object; the other reaches the recording plate directly. Their interference produces fine fringes. After development, similar illumination diffracts from these fringes and reconstructs the light wave from the object.
1947 年，匈牙利裔英国物理学家伽博（Dennis Gabor）发明了全息术，: Hungarian-born British physicist Dennis Gabor invented holography in 1947 and received the 1971 Nobel Prize in Physics. It became practical after lasers appeared.
信用卡和钞票上的防伪全息标签让伪造变得困难；: Holographic security labels on credit cards and banknotes make counterfeiting harder.
每种元素都有独特的\"光谱指纹\"，用分光分析能远程得知物质成分。: Each element has a distinctive spectral fingerprint. Spectroscopy can identify a substance’s composition remotely.
每种原子和分子的电子都只能处在特定的能级上，所以它们只吸收和发出特定波长的光（[: Atoms and molecules occupy specific energy levels, so they absorb and emit particular wavelengths ([[p:levels|energy levels]]). Spreading light into a spectrum reveals bright or dark lines that act as distinctive fingerprints.
棱镜或衍射光栅把不同波长的光分开，探测器记录每个波长的强度。炽热的气体发出明亮的: A prism or diffraction grating separates wavelengths, and a detector measures their intensities. Hot gas emits bright lines; continuous light passing through cooler gas loses certain wavelengths, leaving dark absorption lines. Line positions identify elements, intensities help measure abundance, and shifts reveal velocity.
1814 年，夫琅禾费（Joseph von Fraunhofer）在太阳光谱中: Joseph von Fraunhofer discovered hundreds of dark lines in the solar spectrum in 1814. In 1859, Gustav Kirchhoff and Robert Bunsen showed that elements have characteristic spectral lines, then used them to discover cesium and rubidium.
人类第一次知道了恒星由什么组成；光谱中的红移揭示了宇宙在膨胀。今天光谱分析用于化: People could determine what stars contain for the first time. Spectral redshifts revealed cosmic expansion. Spectroscopy now supports chemical analysis, environmental monitoring and [[ghg-monitoring|greenhouse-gas satellites]].
发射光谱与吸收光谱：氢原子发出的几条亮线，恰好对应连续光谱中被吸收掉的暗线——位: Emission and absorption spectra: hydrogen’s bright emission lines correspond exactly to dark lines absorbed from a continuous spectrum. Their positions are the element’s fingerprint.
X 射线经过晶体会形成衍射图样，由此反推原子排列；解出了 DNA 和许多蛋白质的: X-rays diffracted by crystals reveal atomic arrangements, including the structures of DNA and many proteins.
晶体中的原子排列成规则的点阵，间距与 X 射线的波长相近。X 射线照进晶体后被各: Atoms in crystals form regular lattices with spacings comparable to X-ray wavelengths. The atomic layers scatter incoming X-rays; at particular angles, waves from successive layers are in phase and reinforce each other ([[p:wave|diffraction]]). The pattern reveals the atomic arrangement ([[p:structure|structure]]).
把晶体放在 X 射线束中旋转，探测器记录成千上万个衍射斑点的位置和强度，计算机据: A crystal rotates in an X-ray beam while a detector records the positions and intensities of thousands or tens of thousands of diffraction spots. A computer calculates an electron-density map from them.
1912 年，劳厄（Max von Laue）发现晶体能衍射 X 射线；次年布拉: Max von Laue discovered X-ray diffraction by crystals in 1912. The Braggs proposed their diffraction equation the following year. Rosalind Franklin’s 1952 “Photo 51” supplied crucial evidence for DNA’s double-helix model.
它揭示了食盐、DNA和成千上万种蛋白质的结构，是现代化学、材料科学和药物设计的基: It revealed the structures of salt, DNA and thousands of proteins, underpinning modern chemistry, materials science and drug design.
用波长极短的电子代替光，分辨率比光学显微镜高上千倍，能看见病毒和原子排列。: Uses short-wavelength electrons instead of light, achieving resolution over a thousand times finer than optical microscopes and revealing viruses and atomic arrangements.
显微镜能看清的最小尺寸约为所用波长的一半，可见光的波长约为 400–700 纳米: A microscope’s smallest resolvable feature is roughly half its operating wavelength. Visible wavelengths of about 400–700 nm cannot resolve viruses or atoms. Electrons also behave as waves ([[p:wave|wave–particle duality]]); acceleration reduces their wavelength to a few picometers, about 100,000 times shorter than visible light. Their charge allows magnetic fields to focus them like lenses ([[p:lorentz|Lorentz force]]).
透射电镜让电子束穿过极薄的样品，经过电磁透镜放大后成像，可以看到原子排列；扫描电: Transmission electron microscopes send electrons through very thin samples and magnify the image with electromagnetic lenses, revealing atomic arrangements. Scanning electron microscopes sweep a focused beam across a surface and collect emitted or scattered electrons to form strongly three-dimensional-looking images. The electron path must remain under vacuum.
1931 年，德国的鲁斯卡（Ernst Ruska）和克诺尔造出第一台电子显微镜: Ernst Ruska and Knoll built the first electron microscope in Germany in 1931. Ruska received the 1986 Nobel Prize in Physics. The 2017 Nobel Prize in Chemistry recognized cryo-electron microscopy, which images frozen biomolecules at near-atomic resolution.
人类第一次看到了病毒、细胞内部的细微结构和材料中的原子排列；电镜是芯片检测、材料: Scientists could see viruses, fine structures inside cells and atomic arrangements in materials. Electron microscopes became essential in chip inspection, materials development and structural biology.
用极细针尖和表面之间的隧穿电流\"摸\"出单个原子的形貌，还能搬动原子。: Uses tunneling current between an ultrafine tip and a surface to map individual atoms, and can even move them.
按照经典物理，电子无法越过针尖和样品之间的真空缝隙；但量子力学允许电子以一定概率: Classical physics would prevent electrons crossing the vacuum gap between tip and sample. Quantum mechanics gives them a probability of tunneling through it, creating a current ([[p:tunneling|quantum tunneling]]). Increasing the gap by about 0.1 nm reduces current roughly tenfold.
一根末端只有一个原子的金属针尖贴着样品表面逐行扫描，反馈电路调整针尖高度，让电流: A metal tip ending in a single atom scans the sample line by line. Feedback adjusts its height to maintain constant current; recording these adjustments produces an atomic-scale topographic map.
1981 年，IBM 苏黎世实验室的宾尼希（Gerd Binnig）和罗雷尔（H: Gerd Binnig and Heinrich Rohrer invented the scanning tunneling microscope at IBM Zurich in 1981 and received the 1986 Nobel Prize in Physics. In 1989, IBM researchers arranged 35 xenon atoms to spell “IBM.”
人类第一次\"看见\"并操纵单个原子，开启了纳米科技时代。: For the first time, people could “see” and manipulate individual atoms, opening the era of nanotechnology.
接收天体发出的无线电波；中国\"天眼\"FAST 是最大的单口径射电望远镜。: Receives radio waves from celestial objects. China’s FAST is the largest single-aperture radio telescope.
天体不仅发出可见光，还发出无线电波（[[p:emwave|电磁波]]）。无线电波: Celestial objects emit radio waves as well as visible light ([[p:emwave|electromagnetic waves]]). Radio waves can penetrate cosmic dust and parts of Earth’s atmosphere, but their long wavelengths require enormous antennas to resolve detail.
抛物面天线把来自天空的微弱无线电波会聚到馈源上。把相隔很远的多台望远镜联合观测，: A parabolic antenna focuses weak radio waves from the sky onto a feed. Interferometry combines widely separated telescopes, achieving resolution comparable to an aperture as large as their separation.
1932 年，贝尔实验室的央斯基（Karl Jansky）发现了来自银河系中心的: Karl Jansky at Bell Labs discovered radio noise from the Milky Way’s center in 1932. China’s Five-hundred-meter Aperture Spherical Telescope, FAST, was completed in 2016. The Event Horizon Telescope released the first black-hole image in 2019.
射电天文学发现了宇宙微波背景辐射、脉冲星和类星体。: Radio astronomy discovered the cosmic microwave background, pulsars and quasars.
用可快速变形的镜面实时抵消大气抖动，让地面望远镜拍出清晰图像。: Rapidly deformable mirrors cancel atmospheric distortions in real time, sharpening images from ground-based telescopes.
星光穿过湍动的大气时，波前被扭曲，星星因此\"闪烁\"，地面望远镜的图像变得模糊: Turbulent air distorts starlight’s wavefront, making stars twinkle and blurring telescope images. Measuring the distortion and applying the opposite deformation with a flexible mirror ([[p:feedback|feedback control]]) flattens the wavefront ([[p:optics|optics]]).
波前传感器以每秒上千次的速度测量一颗亮星或人造激光\"导星\"的畸变，计算机算出: A wavefront sensor measures a bright star or artificial laser guide star over a thousand times per second. A computer calculates corrections and drives hundreds or thousands of actuators behind a deformable mirror.
1953 年，美国天文学家巴布科克首先提出了这一构想；1989 年，欧洲南方天文: American astronomer Babcock proposed the idea in 1953. The European Southern Observatory first successfully applied it to an astronomical telescope in 1989.
地面大型望远镜的清晰度接近太空望远镜，帮助证实了银河系中心存在超大质量黑洞；它也: Large ground-based telescopes can approach space-telescope sharpness. The technique helped confirm a supermassive black hole at the Milky Way’s center and also supports eye imaging and laser communication.
以原子能级跃迁的频率作为\"钟摆\"，最好的原子钟上亿年误差不到一秒，是 GNS: Uses atomic transition frequencies as a clock’s pendulum. The best atomic clocks would lose less than a second over hundreds of millions of years and underpin GNSS and internet timekeeping.
钟的精度取决于\"钟摆\"有多稳定。所有同种原子都完全相同，它们在两个能级之间跃: A clock’s accuracy depends on the stability of its oscillator. Identical atoms share the same transition frequencies between energy levels ([[p:levels|energy levels]]), providing a natural reference without mechanical wear or manufacturing variation. This makes them exceptionally stable clock references.
铯原子钟让铯原子束穿过微波腔，调节微波频率直到被吸收得最多，此时频率锁定在每秒: A cesium clock sends atoms through a microwave cavity and tunes the frequency for maximum absorption. The reference is 9,192,631,770 cycles per second: counting that many defines one second. Optical clocks use much higher-frequency laser light, dividing time more finely and improving precision by over a hundredfold.
1955 年，英国国家物理实验室的埃森（Louis Essen）造出第一台实用的: Louis Essen at Britain’s National Physical Laboratory built the first practical cesium atomic clock in 1955. In 1967, the second was formally defined using the cesium transition frequency.
卫星导航依靠原子钟测量信号传播时间，钟差十亿分之一秒就会带来约 30 厘米的定位: Satellite navigation uses atomic clocks to measure signal travel time. A one-billionth-of-a-second error means roughly 30 cm of position error, and [[p:relativity|relativity]] must be corrected for. Communications, power grids and financial trading also depend on atomic timekeeping.
从 2019 年起所有基本单位都由物理常数定义，不再依赖实物原器。: Since 2019, all base units have been defined through physical constants rather than material artifacts.
单位如果依赖某个实物，比如一块金属，那么它会磨损或变化，而且只有一个地方能去校准: A unit based on an object, such as a metal cylinder, can drift through wear or change and must be calibrated against one physical reference. Definitions based on natural constants ([[p:standard|standards]]) let laboratories anywhere independently reproduce the same unit.
如今秒由铯原子的跃迁频率定义，米由光速定义，千克由普朗克常数定义，安培由电子电荷: The second uses cesium’s transition frequency, the meter uses the speed of light, the kilogram uses Planck’s constant and the ampere uses elementary charge. All seven base units are linked to fixed constants and realized through precision experiments.
1875 年，17 个国家签署《米制公约》；1960 年，国际单位制正式命名。2: Seventeen countries signed the Metre Convention in 1875. The International System of Units was formally named in 1960. On May 20, 2019, units including the kilogram moved to constant-based definitions, retiring the international kilogram prototype kept near Paris.
全世界的科学、工业和贸易使用同一套可复现的单位，从芯片制造到药品剂量都依赖它。: Science, industry and trade share reproducible units worldwide. Everything from chip manufacturing to medicine dosage depends on them.
生物死后碳-14 按约 5730 年半衰期衰减，测剩余比例即可推算年代。: After an organism dies, carbon-14 decays with a half-life of about 5,730 years. Its remaining proportion indicates age.
宇宙射线在大气中不断生成放射性的碳-14，生物活着时通过呼吸和进食保持体内碳-1: Cosmic rays continually produce radioactive carbon-14 in the atmosphere. Living organisms replenish it through food and respiration; after death, replenishment stops and carbon-14 decays with a roughly 5,730-year half-life ([[p:decay|radioactive decay]]). Measuring the remaining proportion estimates time since death.
早期方法计数样品发出的衰变粒子，需要较多样品；加速器质谱法直接数出碳-14 原子: Early methods counted decay particles and required relatively large samples. Accelerator mass spectrometry counts carbon-14 atoms directly, needing only milligrams. Results are calibrated against known-age samples such as tree rings, with a useful range of about 50,000 years.
1949 年，美国化学家利比（Willard Libby）及其团队发表了放射性碳: American chemist Willard Libby and his team published radiocarbon dating in 1949. He received the 1960 Nobel Prize in Chemistry.
考古学和地质学第一次有了可靠的\"时钟\"，从史前遗址到古代文物都能测定年代。: Archaeology and geology gained a reliable clock for dating prehistoric sites and ancient artifacts.
相差、荧光、共聚焦和超分辨技术让活细胞内部清晰可见，突破了光学衍射极限。: Phase contrast, fluorescence, confocal and super-resolution methods reveal details inside living cells; super-resolution methods surpass conventional diffraction limits.
光学显微镜受衍射限制，分辨率约为光波长的一半（[[p:wave|衍射极限]]）。: Conventional optical resolution is limited to roughly half the light’s wavelength ([[p:wave|diffraction limit]]). Greater magnification alone cannot solve this. Making selected molecules fluoresce and allowing only a few to emit at once ([[p:optics|optics]]) lets their positions be determined precisely, circumventing the conventional limit.
荧光显微镜用荧光蛋白给特定分子\"染色\"；共聚焦显微镜用小孔挡住焦点外的光，得: Fluorescence microscopy labels selected molecules with fluorescent proteins. Confocal microscopes reject out-of-focus light through a pinhole, producing clear optical sections. Super-resolution methods control fluorescent molecules’ emission to reach resolutions of tens of nanometers.
1873 年，阿贝推导出衍射极限；2014 年，三位科学家因超分辨荧光显微技术获: Abbe derived the diffraction limit in 1873. Three scientists received the 2014 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for super-resolution fluorescence microscopy.
科学家可以观察活细胞内部的分子运动，这是现代细胞生物学和神经科学的基本工具。: Scientists can observe molecular motion inside living cells, making these methods fundamental tools in cell biology and neuroscience.
用拼接镜面和自适应光学造出口径十米以上的地面望远镜。: Segmented mirrors and adaptive optics enable ground-based telescopes with apertures of ten meters or more.
望远镜口径越大，收集的光越多，能看到更暗的天体，分辨率也越高（[[p:optic: A larger aperture gathers more light, reveals fainter objects and improves resolution ([[p:optics|optics]]). Single mirrors larger than about eight meters are difficult to manufacture and transport, so many smaller segments form one large mirror.
凯克望远镜的主镜由 36 块六角形镜片拼成，直径 10 米，每块镜片背后的促动器: The Keck telescope’s 10-meter primary mirror comprises 36 hexagonal segments. Actuators adjust each segment many times per second to maintain one ideal surface with errors of only a few nanometers. [[adaptive-optics|Adaptive optics]] then counters atmospheric distortion.
1993 年，美国夏威夷的凯克一号望远镜投入观测；正在建造的欧洲极大望远镜口径约: Keck I in Hawaii began observations in 1993. The European Extremely Large Telescope under construction has an aperture of about 39 meters.
大型望远镜发现了宇宙加速膨胀的证据，研究了遥远的星系和系外行星。: Large telescopes found evidence of accelerating cosmic expansion and study distant galaxies and exoplanets.
射线让管内气体电离产生电脉冲，\"咔咔\"声代表探测到的辐射。: Radiation ionizes gas in a tube, producing electrical pulses. Each click represents a detected event.
放射性射线能把气体分子中的电子打出来（电离，[[p:charge|电荷]]）。在: Radiation can knock electrons from gas molecules: ionization ([[p:charge|charge]]). High voltage accelerates these electrons, causing further ionization and an avalanche. An invisible particle becomes a measurable electrical pulse ([[p:decay|radioactive decay]]).
盖革管是一根充有惰性气体的金属管，中间有一根细金属丝，两者之间加上几百伏电压。每: A Geiger tube is a gas-filled metal cylinder with a fine central wire and several hundred volts between them. An incoming particle that triggers an avalanche generates a pulse, incrementing a counter or producing a speaker click. Count rate indicates radiation intensity.
1908 年，盖革（Hans Geiger）在卢瑟福的实验室制成了早期的粒子计数: Hans Geiger built an early particle counter in Rutherford’s laboratory in 1908. In 1928, he and his student Müller developed the sensitive, practical Geiger–Müller tube.
它成为核物理研究、辐射防护、矿产勘探和核事故应急中最常用的辐射探测仪。: It became a widely used detector in nuclear physics, radiation protection, mineral exploration and nuclear-emergency response.
用惯性质量记录地面的微小晃动，测定地震位置和强度，也用于监测核试验。: An inertial mass records tiny ground movements to locate and measure earthquakes and help monitor nuclear tests.
地面晃动时，一个悬挂得很松的重物因为惯性几乎保持不动（[[p:newton|惯性: When the ground moves, a loosely suspended mass tends to remain still through inertia ([[p:newton|inertia]]). Measuring ground motion relative to it records seismic waves ([[p:wave|waves]]).
现代地震仪用弹簧悬挂质量块，用电磁感应或电容传感器测量相对运动，并用反馈电路保持: Modern seismometers suspend a mass on springs and measure relative movement through electromagnetic or capacitive sensors. Feedback keeps the mass centered, allowing nanometer-scale motion detection. Global networks compare arrival times of longitudinal and transverse waves to determine an earthquake’s location, depth and magnitude.
公元 132 年，东汉张衡制成候风地动仪，用来指示地震的方向；1880 年，英国: In AD 132, Zhang Heng of China’s Eastern Han dynasty built an instrument indicating earthquake direction. British geologist John Milne developed a modern seismograph in Japan in 1880.
地震学揭示了地球内部的地核、地幔结构；地震仪还是地震预警的基础，也能识别地下核试: Seismology revealed Earth’s core and mantle. Seismometers underpin earthquake early warning and can identify underground nuclear tests.
铁路和电报需要统一时间，1884 年确立格林尼治本初子午线，今天以原子时为基准。: Railways and telegraphs required common time. Greenwich became the prime meridian in 1884; modern timekeeping uses atomic time.
每个地方按太阳最高的时刻定中午，相邻城市的时间就会差几分钟。火车和电报出现后，各: If each place defines noon by the Sun’s highest point, neighboring cities differ by minutes. Railways and telegraphs needed a shared time standard ([[p:standard|standards]]) to make timetables workable.
全球按经度大致划分为 24 个时区，每 15 度相差一小时，以格林尼治为起点。今: The world is divided roughly into 24 time zones, nominally one hour per 15 degrees of longitude from Greenwich. Coordinated Universal Time, UTC, uses atomic clocks with leap seconds to stay aligned with Earth’s rotation.
1847 年，英国铁路统一使用格林尼治时间；1883 年北美铁路采用了标准时区；: British railways adopted Greenwich time in 1847. North American railways adopted standard time zones in 1883. The International Meridian Conference in Washington selected Greenwich as the prime meridian in 1884.
全球时间协调一致，交通、通信和金融得以同步运行；2022 年，国际计量大会决定在: Shared time coordinates transport, communications and finance worldwide. In 2022, the General Conference on Weights and Measures decided to end leap-second insertions by 2035.
亲手切换输入，发现逻辑门的规则。: Flip the inputs and discover the rules of logic gates.
先猜一猜：两个条件里只有一个成立，灯会亮吗？点击 A、B，再切换判断规则。: Make a prediction: if only one input is on, will the light turn on? Toggle A and B, then try a different gate.
展开真值表，检查所有组合: Show the truth table and check every combination
看见变化之后，再把原理串起来。: Now connect what you observed to the underlying ideas.
用自己的话，记下一点: Write it in your own words
二氧化碳等气体让阳光进来、却挡住地面向外散发的红外热，地球因此变暖。: Gases such as carbon dioxide let sunlight in but absorb outgoing infrared radiation, warming Earth.
太阳的能量主要以可见光的形式到达地球，大气几乎不挡；地面吸收后变暖，又以红外线的: Solar energy reaches Earth mainly as visible light, which passes readily through the atmosphere. The warmed surface emits infrared radiation toward space ([[p:emwave|electromagnetic radiation]]). Vibrations of carbon-dioxide, water-vapor and methane molecules absorb infrared and re-emit it in all directions, including back toward the surface, like a blanket ([[p:heat|heat transfer]]). A thicker blanket requires a warmer surface to release the same amount of energy.
① 天然温室效应：如果没有大气，地球平均温度约为零下 18 °C；正因为有温室气: ① Natural greenhouse effect: without an atmosphere, Earth’s average temperature would be about −18°C. Greenhouse gases help keep it around 15°C.
② 增强温室效应：燃烧化石燃料让大气二氧化碳浓度从工业革命前的约 280 ppm: ② Enhanced greenhouse effect: burning fossil fuels has raised atmospheric carbon dioxide from about 280 ppm before industrialization to over 420 ppm.
③ 反馈放大：变暖使空气中的水蒸气增多、冰雪减少，进一步放大了升温。: ③ Amplifying feedback: warming increases atmospheric water vapor and reduces snow and ice, further increasing warming.
1824 年傅里叶（Joseph Fourier）推测大气像一层保温罩；1856: Joseph Fourier proposed an insulating effect of the atmosphere in 1824. In 1856, American scientist Eunice Foote found that carbon-dioxide-filled containers warmed more in sunlight. John Tyndall measured gases’ infrared absorption in 1859. Svante Arrhenius first estimated warming from doubled carbon dioxide in 1896.
This is the physical basis of global warming. Long-term global temperature is about 1.3–1.4°C above preindustrial levels. The single year 2024 first exceeded 1.5°C, at about 1.55°C according to the WMO; 2025 was about 1.43°C. Increasing extreme heat, heavy rainfall and sea-level rise make emissions reduction a global issue.
\"温室\"只是一个比喻：真正的温室主要靠玻璃阻挡空气对流，而大气温室效应靠的是: “Greenhouse” is an analogy: glass greenhouses mainly restrict air convection, whereas the atmospheric greenhouse effect depends on molecular absorption of infrared radiation.
地球的能量收支示意：阳光（短波）大多穿过大气到达地面；地面发出的红外线（长波）被: Earth’s energy balance: most incoming shortwave sunlight passes through the atmosphere. Greenhouse gases absorb outgoing longwave infrared and re-emit some toward the surface. More greenhouse gases require a warmer surface to release energy to space.
夏威夷莫纳罗亚山连续测量的大气二氧化碳浓度曲线，从约 315 ppm 升到 42: Continuous measurements at Hawaii’s Mauna Loa trace atmospheric carbon dioxide rising from about 315 ppm to over 420 ppm.
要证明大气在变化，必须在远离污染源的地方用同一种方法长期精确测量（[[p:pro: Demonstrating atmospheric change requires precise, long-term measurements using consistent methods far from pollution sources ([[p:probability|statistics and measurement]]). Carbon dioxide mixes sufficiently well for one remote station to represent the global trend.
莫纳罗亚观测站位于夏威夷海拔约 3400 米的火山上，用红外气体分析仪连续测量。: Mauna Loa Observatory sits about 3,400 meters above sea level on a Hawaiian volcano and measures continuously with infrared gas analyzers. The curve combines seasonal sawteeth—Northern Hemisphere plants absorb carbon dioxide in summer and release it in winter—with a steadily rising underlying trend.
1958 年，美国科学家查尔斯·基林（Charles David Keeling: American scientist Charles David Keeling began measurements in 1958, when the concentration was about 315 ppm. His son Ralph Keeling continues the work.
这是人类活动改变大气最直接的证据，今天的浓度已超过 420 ppm，是数十万年来: The curve directly demonstrates human alteration of the atmosphere. Concentrations above 420 ppm are the highest in hundreds of thousands of years.
基林曲线示意：每年一次的锯齿来自北半球植物的季节性呼吸，锯齿下面是持续上升的长期: The Keeling Curve: annual sawteeth reflect seasonal plant activity in the Northern Hemisphere, superimposed on a steadily rising long-term trend.
把大气、海洋、冰和陆地的物理方程放进超算模拟未来气候；真锅淑郎因此获诺贝尔奖。: Supercomputers simulate atmospheric, oceanic, ice and land physics to project climate. Syukuro Manabe received a Nobel Prize for this work.
气候由物理定律决定：能量守恒、流体运动、水的相变和辐射传输（[[p:energy: Climate follows physical laws: energy conservation, fluid motion, phase changes of water and radiative transfer ([[p:energy|energy conservation]], [[p:heat|heat transfer]]). Encoding these equations creates a virtual Earth for experiments impossible on the real planet, such as doubling carbon dioxide.
模型把大气和海洋切成几十到一百公里见方的网格，垂直方向分成几十层，每个格子里按时: Models divide the atmosphere and ocean into grids tens to a hundred kilometers across and dozens of vertical layers. Each time step updates temperature, wind, humidity and currents, including feedback from clouds, ice and vegetation. Processes smaller than the grid, such as individual clouds, require approximations—a major source of uncertainty.
1967 年，真锅淑郎（Syukuro Manabe）和韦瑟罗尔德发表了第一个可: In 1967, Syukuro Manabe and Wetherald published a reliable radiative-convective model estimating just over 2°C of surface warming from doubled carbon dioxide. Manabe and Klaus Hasselmann received the 2021 Nobel Prize in Physics for climate modeling.
几十年前的模型预测与后来实测的升温基本吻合；模型是 [[ipcc|IPCC]]: Decades-old projections broadly match subsequently observed warming. Models underpin [[ipcc|IPCC]] assessments, national emissions targets and adaptation planning.
计算一个产品从原料、生产、使用到废弃全过程的资源消耗和排放。: Accounts for resource use and emissions throughout a product’s life, from raw materials and production to use and disposal.
只看一个环节会产生错觉：电动车开起来不排放，但造电池和发电可能排放。把产品从原料: Looking at one stage can mislead: electric cars have no exhaust emissions, but battery manufacturing and electricity generation may emit carbon. Including raw materials, production, transport, use and disposal ([[p:energy|energy conservation]]) makes comparisons fairer.
先划定系统边界，再清点每个环节的能源和材料输入以及排放输出，最后换算成全球变暖、: First define system boundaries, then inventory energy and material inputs and emissions at each stage. Convert them into impacts such as warming and acidification. A carbon footprint considers greenhouse gases alone; reporting often distinguishes direct emissions, purchased electricity and upstream/downstream supply chains.
1969 年，可口可乐公司委托研究比较不同饮料瓶的资源消耗，被视为生命周期评价的: A 1969 Coca-Cola-commissioned comparison of beverage containers’ resource use is often treated as an early life-cycle assessment. ISO published its 14040 series in the late 1990s.
它被用于环保标签、碳核算和政策制定；但边界和假设不同，结论可能相差很大。: Used in environmental labels, carbon accounting and policymaking, though different boundaries and assumptions can yield very different results.
用大气物理方程在计算机上推算未来天气；1950 年 ENIAC 完成首次数值预报: Computers solve atmospheric equations to forecast weather. ENIAC made the first successful numerical forecast in 1950.
大气遵循流体力学和热力学方程，知道此刻全球的温度、气压、风和湿度，原则上就能一步: The atmosphere follows fluid mechanics and thermodynamics. Given current global temperature, pressure, wind and humidity, its future can in principle be calculated step by step ([[p:energy|physical laws]]). But atmospheric chaos amplifies tiny initial errors ([[p:probability|probability]]), limiting forecast range.
每天从气象站、探空气球、卫星收集数以亿计的观测数据，经过\"同化\"拼成最可信的: Hundreds of millions of daily observations from stations, balloons and satellites are assimilated into a best-estimate initial state. Supercomputers then integrate equations over a grid to forecast several days to roughly two weeks ahead.
1922 年，英国的理查森（Lewis Fry Richardson）手工尝试数: Lewis Fry Richardson attempted a numerical forecast by hand in 1922. Jule Charney, von Neumann and colleagues completed the first successful numerical forecast on ENIAC in 1950, taking about 24 hours to forecast 24 hours. From 2023, AI weather models from Google, Huawei and others matched conventional models on some measures.
预报准确度大约每十年提前一天，今天的 5 天预报和 1980 年的 3 天预报一: Forecast skill has advanced roughly one day per decade; today’s five-day forecasts can match three-day forecasts from 1980. Better typhoon tracks and heavy-rain warnings have saved many lives.
南极和格陵兰冰层里封存的气泡和同位素，记录了几十万年来的大气成分和温度。: Bubbles and isotopes trapped in Antarctic and Greenland ice record atmospheric composition and temperature over hundreds of thousands of years.
极地冰盖由逐年降雪压实而成，雪花之间的空气被封进冰中成为小气泡（[[p:phas: Polar ice forms as successive snowfall compacts. Air trapped between snowflakes becomes sealed bubbles ([[p:phase|phase change]]), preserving atmospheric samples. Oxygen and hydrogen isotope ratios in the ice also reflect past temperatures.
钻机从冰盖向下钻取数千米长的冰柱，按年层计算年代。实验室在真空中压碎冰样，测量释: Drills retrieve ice columns thousands of meters long, dated using annual layers. Crushing samples under vacuum releases carbon dioxide and methane for measurement. Colder snowfall contains less heavy oxygen, allowing temperature estimates.
20 世纪 60 年代起，丹麦科学家丹斯高（Willi Dansgaard）等开: Willi Dansgaard and colleagues pioneered ice-core isotope research from the 1960s. Antarctic Vostok and European EPICA cores extended records to about 800,000 years ago.
冰芯显示，过去 80 万年二氧化碳在约 180–300 ppm 之间起落，与温度: Ice cores show carbon dioxide fluctuating around 180–300 ppm over 800,000 years, closely tracking temperature. Today’s concentration is far outside that range.
数千个自动浮标在全球海洋中沉浮，测量温度和盐度；海洋吸收了全球变暖绝大部分多余热: Thousands of autonomous floats rise and sink through the oceans, measuring temperature and salinity. Oceans absorb most excess heat from global warming.
海洋的热容量巨大，全球变暖多出的热量九成以上被海洋吸收（[[p:heat|热容与: Oceans have enormous heat capacity and absorb over 90% of the excess heat from global warming ([[p:heat|heat capacity and transfer]]). Measuring Earth’s accumulated heat requires broadly distributed ocean sampling ([[p:sampling|sampling]]).
Argo 浮标能调节自身浮力，平时在约 1000 米深处随洋流漂流，每隔约 10: Argo floats adjust their buoyancy. They usually drift around 1,000 meters deep, descend to 2,000 meters about every ten days, then measure temperature and salinity while rising. At the surface they transmit data by satellite before sinking again.
国际 Argo 计划于 2000 年前后开始布放浮标，2007 年达到约 300: The international Argo program began deploying floats around 2000 and reached its target of roughly 3,000 in 2007. About 4,000 now operate across the oceans.
海洋上层温度的观测从稀少的船测变成全球实时覆盖，证实了海洋热含量在持续上升，也大: Upper-ocean observations expanded from sparse ship measurements to near-real-time global coverage, confirming rising ocean heat content and improving climate models and seasonal forecasts.
用卫星和地面光谱仪测量二氧化碳和甲烷浓度，定位\"超级排放源\"。: Satellite and ground spectrometers measure carbon dioxide and methane, locating major emission sources.
二氧化碳和甲烷分子只吸收特定波长的红外光（[[p:levels|能级与光谱]]）: Carbon-dioxide and methane molecules absorb particular infrared wavelengths ([[p:levels|energy levels and spectra]]). Measuring how much these wavelengths weaken through the atmosphere reveals the total gas along the light path ([[p:emwave|electromagnetic waves]]).
卫星上的光谱仪测量地面反射的阳光，计算每个地点上空的平均浓度；高分辨率卫星和飞机: Satellite spectrometers measure reflected sunlight to estimate average overhead concentrations. High-resolution satellites and aircraft can detect methane plumes over individual oil fields, coal mines and landfills, identifying large leaks and “super-emitters.”
2009 年日本发射了首颗专门测温室气体的卫星 GOSAT；美国 2014 年发: Japan launched GOSAT, the first dedicated greenhouse-gas satellite, in 2009. The United States launched OCO-2 in 2014, and Europe launched Sentinel-5P carrying TROPOMI in 2017.
排放从各国自己上报变成可以从太空独立核查；甲烷升温能力强、寿命短，修补泄漏成为最: Emissions can be independently checked from space instead of relying solely on national reports. Methane is powerful but relatively short-lived, making leak repair one of the fastest ways to reduce near-term warming.
联合国下属的气候科学评估机构，定期汇总全球研究，是气候谈判的科学依据。: A UN climate-science assessment body that periodically synthesizes global research to inform climate negotiations.
气候研究分散在成千上万篇论文中，结论有强有弱。科学家定期系统评估全部文献，用\": Climate findings span thousands of papers with differing strengths of evidence. Regular systematic assessment uses calibrated terms such as “very likely” and “high confidence” ([[p:probability|probability]]) to give policymakers a consistent scientific foundation.
每轮评估分为三个工作组：物理科学基础、影响与适应、减缓。数百位作者撰写报告，最后: Each assessment has three working groups: physical science; impacts and adaptation; and mitigation. Hundreds of authors write reports, while governments review and approve the Summary for Policymakers line by line.
1988 年，世界气象组织和联合国环境规划署成立 IPCC，1990 年发布第一: The WMO and UNEP established the IPCC in 1988; its first assessment appeared in 1990. The Sixth Assessment, published in 2021–2023, described human-caused warming as unequivocal.
IPCC assessments directly informed the UN climate convention and Paris Agreement negotiations, including discussions of 1.5°C and net-zero targets around 2050.
地震、海啸、台风和洪水预警抢在灾害到来前发出警报，是最划算的气候适应措施之一。: Warnings for earthquakes, tsunamis, typhoons and floods arrive before the danger, while weather-related early warning is among the most cost-effective adaptation measures.
灾害往往无法阻止，但人可以提前躲开。地震波比电信号慢得多，台风和洪水可以提前几天: Disasters cannot always be prevented, but people can move out of danger. Seismic waves travel much more slowly than electrical signals, while typhoons and floods can be predicted days ahead ([[p:probability|probabilistic forecasting]]). Timely warnings reaching everyone can save many lives ([[p:feedback|feedback]]).
地震预警在震中附近检测到最先到达、破坏较小的纵波后，立即计算震级并发出警报，抢在: Earthquake systems detect the first, less damaging longitudinal waves near the epicenter, estimate magnitude and warn seconds to tens of seconds before destructive transverse waves arrive. Typhoon and flood warnings combine satellites and numerical forecasts with evacuation plans.
20 世纪 40 年代末美国在夏威夷建立海啸预警系统；2004 年印度洋海啸造成: The United States established a tsunami-warning system in Hawaii in the late 1940s. After the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami killed about 230,000 people, an Indian Ocean warning system was established in 2006.
孟加拉国 1970 年的气旋造成数十万人死亡，近年同等强度的气旋死亡人数已降到数: Bangladesh’s 1970 cyclone killed hundreds of thousands. In recent years, similarly powerful cyclones have caused deaths numbering in the dozens.
从化石能源转向风、光、核、储能和电气化的系统性变革。: A system-wide shift from fossil fuels toward wind, solar, nuclear power, storage and electrification.
全球约四分之三的温室气体排放来自能源。能源转型的核心思路是\"电气化 + 清洁电: Energy accounts for roughly three-quarters of global greenhouse-gas emissions. The central approach is electrification plus clean electricity: switch transport, heating and industry to efficient motors and heat pumps ([[p:energy|energy conservation]]), then supply wind, solar, hydro and nuclear power. Manufacturing at scale makes solar and batteries cheaper ([[p:scale|economies of scale]]).
发电侧用风电、光伏替代煤电；由于风光不稳定，需要储能、电网互联和需求响应来平衡。: Wind and solar replace coal generation, balanced by storage, interconnected grids and demand response. Electric vehicles and heat pumps expand on the demand side. Hard-to-electrify steel, cement, aviation and shipping require options such as hydrogen, sustainable fuels and carbon capture.
2010 年代，光伏组件价格下降约九成，风电和光伏在多数地区成为最便宜的新增电源: Solar-module prices fell roughly 90% during the 2010s, making wind and solar the cheapest new generation in many regions. According to the IEA, global electric-car sales exceeded 20 million in 2025, around a quarter of new cars; China’s share approached 55%.
清洁能源投资已超过化石能源投资；但化石能源仍占全球一次能源的约八成，转型的速度和: Clean-energy investment now exceeds fossil-energy investment. Fossil fuels still supply about four-fifths of global primary energy, and the transition’s speed and fairness remain debated.
让人为排放与清除相抵；《巴黎协定》后各国纷纷提出净零目标，中国目标为 2060: Balances human emissions with removals. Many countries announced net-zero targets after the Paris Agreement; China targets carbon neutrality before 2060.
二氧化碳在大气中可以停留几百年甚至更久，升温幅度大致与累计排放量成正比。所以要让: Carbon dioxide can affect the atmosphere for centuries or longer, and warming is approximately proportional to cumulative emissions. Stabilizing temperature therefore requires human emissions to balance removals: net zero ([[p:incentives|incentives and cooperation]]).
国家和企业先大幅削减能源、工业、交通和农业的排放，剩余难以消除的部分，用造林或: Countries and companies first cut energy, industrial, transport and agricultural emissions deeply. Remaining hard-to-eliminate emissions are balanced through afforestation or [[carbon-dioxide-removal|carbon removal]]. A typical pathway peaks emissions, reduces them, then reaches neutrality.
2015 年 12 月通过的《巴黎协定》提出把升温控制在远低于 2 °C、并努力: The Paris Agreement, adopted in December 2015, seeks warming well below 2°C while pursuing 1.5°C. In September 2020, China announced aims to peak carbon emissions before 2030 and reach carbon neutrality before 2060.
全球大部分排放已被各国的净零目标覆盖；但目标与实际行动之间差距很大，部分国家的政: National net-zero targets cover most global emissions, but large gaps remain between pledges and action, and some countries have repeatedly changed policy.
给碳排放标价（碳税或总量交易），让污染者付费、让减排有利可图。: Prices carbon through taxes or emissions trading, making polluters pay and rewarding reductions.
排放的危害由全社会承担，排放者自己却不用付钱，所以排放太多。给每吨二氧化碳定一个: Society bears emissions damage while emitters may pay nothing, encouraging excessive emissions. Pricing each ton of carbon dioxide ([[p:incentives|incentives]]) encourages the cheapest reductions first, achieving a given reduction at lower total cost.
碳税直接对每吨排放征税，价格确定但总量不确定。总量控制与交易（碳市场）则由政府设: A carbon tax fixes the price per ton but leaves total emissions uncertain. Cap-and-trade fixes and gradually tightens an overall cap, allocating or auctioning allowances. Companies that reduce more can sell surplus allowances; those exceeding their allocation must buy them. The cap is set, while the market determines price.
1990 年芬兰率先开征碳税；美国 20 世纪 90 年代用排放交易治理二氧化硫: Finland introduced a carbon tax in 1990. US sulfur-dioxide trading in the 1990s cut pollution at much lower cost than expected. The EU emissions market began in 2005; China’s national market began trading in 2021 and is the largest by covered emissions.
碳价让减排成为企业财务账上的一项数字，欧盟电力行业的煤电大幅减少；但全球仍只有约: Carbon prices put emissions reductions onto company balance sheets and helped reduce EU coal power. Only about a quarter of global emissions are covered, however, and prices are often low.
从烟气中分离二氧化碳，压缩后注入地下岩层封存。: Separates carbon dioxide from exhaust gases, compresses it and injects it into underground rock formations.
燃烧后的烟气中二氧化碳只占百分之十几，必须用一种能\"抓住\"二氧化碳的溶剂把它: Carbon dioxide makes up only around a tenth to a fifth of combustion exhaust. A solvent selectively captures it from nitrogen ([[p:bond|chemical bonds]]). Heating the saturated solvent releases carbon dioxide and allows the solvent to be reused.
烟气通过装有胺溶液的吸收塔，二氧化碳与胺发生可逆反应被吸收；溶液送到再生塔加热，: Exhaust passes through an absorber containing amine solution, which binds carbon dioxide reversibly. Heating in a regenerator releases concentrated carbon dioxide. It is compressed into a supercritical state and piped into saline formations or depleted oil and gas fields over 1,000 meters underground, beneath sealing rock layers.
1972 年，美国得克萨斯州开始把天然气处理厂分离出的二氧化碳注入油田以提高采收: In 1972, Texas projects injected carbon dioxide separated from natural gas into oil fields to improve recovery. Norway’s Sleipner project began in 1996 as the first large project primarily for storage, storing about one million tons per year.
它是钢铁、水泥和化工等难减排行业的重要选项；但成本高、耗能大，全球的捕集量仍不到: An important option for hard-to-abate steel, cement and chemicals, but costly and energy-intensive. Global capture remains below one-thousandth of total emissions, and some captured gas supports additional oil extraction, making it controversial.
直接从空气中吸取二氧化碳，空气中浓度极低，所以能耗和成本都很高。: Removes carbon dioxide directly from air. Its very low concentration makes the process expensive and energy-intensive.
空气中的二氧化碳只有约 0.04%，比烟气稀几百倍。把高度分散的分子重新集中起来: Air contains only about 0.04% carbon dioxide, hundreds of times less concentrated than flue gas. Gathering dispersed molecules requires energy ([[p:entropy|entropy]]); lower concentrations mean processing more air at higher cost.
大型风扇把空气吹过涂有吸附剂的过滤器，二氧化碳被化学吸附；加热或抽真空后释放出纯: Large fans move air through sorbent-coated filters. Heat or vacuum releases captured carbon dioxide for underground storage or synthetic fuels. Other processes absorb it in alkaline liquids and regenerate them through high-temperature calcination.
2021 年，瑞士 Climeworks 公司在冰岛建成每年捕集约 4000 吨: In 2021, Swiss company Climeworks opened Iceland’s Orca plant, designed to capture about 4,000 tons annually and pair capture with underground mineral storage.
它能清除来自任何地方的排放，包括飞机和历史排放；但目前每吨成本为数百美元，总规模: It can remove emissions regardless of origin, including aviation and historical emissions. Costs remain hundreds of dollars per ton and total scale is small; clean energy is essential for meaningful benefit.
用氢代替焦炭还原铁矿石，或改良水泥配方，减少重工业排放。: Uses hydrogen instead of coke to reduce iron ore, or changes cement formulations, cutting heavy-industry emissions.
炼铁要把铁矿石中的氧夺走（[[p:redox|氧化还原]]），传统高炉用焦炭里的: Ironmaking removes oxygen from ore ([[p:redox|redox]]). Conventional blast furnaces use carbon in coke, producing carbon dioxide; hydrogen instead produces water. More than half of cement’s emissions come from limestone decomposition itself.
氢基直接还原法用绿氢在竖炉中把铁矿石还原成海绵铁，再用电弧炉炼钢；废钢回收也能大: Hydrogen direct reduction uses green hydrogen in a shaft furnace to make sponge iron, then an electric arc furnace makes steel. Scrap recycling also sharply reduces emissions. Lower-carbon cement reduces clinker content with calcined clay or slag, or combines production with carbon capture.
2021 年，瑞典的 HYBRIT 项目交付了第一批用氢还原的无化石钢材。: Sweden’s HYBRIT project delivered its first hydrogen-reduced fossil-free steel in 2021.
钢铁和水泥各占全球二氧化碳排放的约 7%–8%。绿色工艺正在示范，但成本更高，还: Steel and cement each account for roughly 7–8% of global carbon-dioxide emissions. Green processes are being demonstrated but cost more and require abundant affordable clean electricity and hydrogen.
用废油、生物质或绿氢合成的航油，可直接用于现有飞机。: Jet fuel made from waste oils, biomass or green hydrogen can be used in existing aircraft.
飞机对燃料的能量密度要求极高（[[p:energydensity|能量密度]]）: Aircraft need very high fuel energy density ([[p:energydensity|energy density]]); batteries are too heavy for broad near-term replacement. Chemically equivalent fuels made from biomass or atmospheric carbon release carbon previously absorbed from the air, potentially lowering life-cycle emissions.
目前主流做法是把废弃食用油和动物脂肪加氢处理成航油；未来可用农林废弃物。它能和普: Current production mainly hydrogen-treats used cooking oil and animal fats into jet fuel, with agricultural and forestry waste as future feedstocks. Approved fuels can be blended with conventional jet fuel, commonly up to 50% under applicable standards.
2008 年起，航空公司开始用生物燃料试飞；欧盟规定从 2025 年起航油中必须: Airlines began biofuel test flights in 2008. EU rules require a sustainable-fuel share from 2025, increasing over time.
它是航空业减排的主要希望；但目前产量不到航油总量的 1%，价格是普通航油的数倍，: A leading aviation decarbonization option, but production remains below 1% of jet-fuel use, prices are several times conventional fuel prices, and feedstocks are limited.
用造林、生物炭、增强风化、BECCS 和直接空气捕集等办法，把已经排放的二氧化碳: Afforestation, biochar, enhanced weathering, BECCS and direct air capture remove previously emitted carbon dioxide from the atmosphere.
即使排放降到很低，农业和航空等仍会剩下一部分难以消除的排放，还有已经累积在大气中: Even after deep cuts, agriculture and aviation retain difficult residual emissions, while past carbon dioxide remains accumulated in the atmosphere. Net zero—and eventually lower temperatures—requires removing carbon into plants, soils, rocks or underground storage ([[p:photosynthesis|photosynthesis]], [[p:bond|chemical bonds]]).
造林和改善土壤利用光合作用固碳；增强风化把碎玄武岩撒在农田里吸收二氧化碳；BEC: Afforestation and soil improvements store carbon through photosynthesis. Enhanced weathering spreads crushed basalt on farmland to absorb carbon dioxide. BECCS combines biomass power with capture and storage. Another option is [[direct-air-capture|direct air capture]].
2018 年 IPCC 的 1.5 °C 特别报告指出，几乎所有达标路径都需要碳: The IPCC’s 2018 special report on 1.5°C found that nearly all compatible pathways require carbon removal.
今天每年约 20 亿吨的碳移除几乎全部来自森林，新型技术还不到其中的千分之一；如: Almost all of today’s roughly two billion tons of annual carbon removal comes from forests. Novel technologies contribute less than one-thousandth of that amount, and verifying real removal is a central challenge.
让烟尘颗粒带电后被电极吸住，去除电厂和工厂烟气中的大部分粉尘。: Charges smoke particles and collects them on electrodes, removing most dust from power-plant and factory exhaust.
带电的颗粒在电场中会受力移动（[[p:charge|电荷与电场]]）。先让烟尘带: Charged particles move under electric-field forces ([[p:charge|charge and electric fields]]). Charging dust and attracting it to opposite-polarity electrodes removes particles with little obstruction to airflow.
烟气流过一排排高压放电线和接地的金属板之间，放电线周围的空气电离，使经过的颗粒带: Exhaust passes between high-voltage wires and grounded plates. Air ionized around the wires gives particles a negative charge, drawing them to the plates. Periodic rapping drops accumulated dust into hoppers below. Removal efficiency can exceed 99%.
1907 年，美国化学家科特雷尔（Frederick Cottrell）获得静电: American chemist Frederick Cottrell patented the electrostatic precipitator in 1907, initially to recover acid mist from smelter exhaust.
燃煤电厂、水泥厂和钢厂的烟囱不再冒黑烟，城市空气中的大颗粒物大幅减少；它也是烟气: Coal plants, cement works and steel mills could greatly reduce black smoke and coarse urban particles. Electrostatic collection is often the first stage of flue-gas treatment.
用石灰浆吸收烟气中的二氧化硫，治理酸雨。: Limestone slurry absorbs sulfur dioxide from exhaust, helping control acid rain.
煤中的硫燃烧后变成二氧化硫，在大气中氧化后形成酸雨。二氧化硫是一种酸性气体，用碱: Sulfur in coal burns into sulfur dioxide, which can oxidize in the atmosphere and contribute to acid rain. Spraying alkaline limestone slurry through the exhaust neutralizes and absorbs this acidic gas ([[p:redox|redox]]).
在吸收塔中，烟气由下往上流动，石灰石浆液从上往下喷淋，二氧化硫被吸收，再被鼓入的: Exhaust rises through an absorber while limestone slurry sprays downward. Absorbed sulfur dioxide is oxidized by injected air to form gypsum for building materials. Removal typically exceeds 95%.
20 世纪 30 年代伦敦的巴特西电厂就装过早期脱硫设施；20 世纪 70 年代: London’s Battersea power station used early desulfurization in the 1930s. US and Japanese environmental rules drove widespread adoption in the 1970s. China fitted such systems broadly across coal plants in the late 2000s.
欧洲和北美的酸雨问题基本得到控制，森林和湖泊逐渐恢复；中国的二氧化硫排放在十几年: Acid rain was substantially controlled in Europe and North America, allowing forests and lakes to recover. China’s sulfur-dioxide emissions also fell by over 80% in a little more than a decade.
用铂、钯、铑等催化剂把汽车尾气中的一氧化碳、碳氢化合物和氮氧化物转为无害物。: Platinum, palladium and rhodium catalysts convert carbon monoxide, hydrocarbons and nitrogen oxides in vehicle exhaust into less harmful substances.
一氧化碳和碳氢化合物需要被氧化，氮氧化物需要被还原，这些反应在常温下极慢。贵金属: Carbon monoxide and hydrocarbons need oxidation, while nitrogen oxides need reduction. These reactions are slow at room temperature. Precious-metal catalysts provide reaction sites and lower activation energy ([[p:catalysis|catalysis]]), making conversion rapid at exhaust temperatures.
尾气流过蜂窝状陶瓷载体，表面涂有铂、钯、铑。三种污染物同时转化，关键是发动机必须: Exhaust flows through a ceramic honeycomb coated with platinum, palladium and rhodium. Simultaneous treatment requires precise air–fuel control, maintained through feedback from an exhaust oxygen sensor.
20 世纪 50 年代，法国工程师胡德利（Eugene Houdry）在美国研究: French engineer Eugene Houdry studied exhaust catalysts in the United States in the 1950s. New US cars began using oxidation catalysts in 1975; three-way catalysts treating all three pollutants appeared in the early 1980s.
新车尾气污染物减少九成以上；铅会让催化剂\"中毒\"，所以它也推动了 [[lea: New-car exhaust pollutants fell by more than 90%. Lead poisons catalysts, so their adoption also supported the [[leaded-gasoline-phaseout|phaseout of leaded gasoline]].
含铅汽油曾广泛用于防爆震，但铅损害神经；2021 年全球最终停止使用。: Leaded gasoline was widely used to prevent engine knock, but lead harms the nervous system. Its global phaseout was completed in 2021.
四乙基铅能抑制发动机里汽油的过早爆燃（爆震），但铅是神经毒素，会通过尾气进入空气: Tetraethyl lead suppresses premature combustion, or knock, in gasoline engines. Lead is neurotoxic, however, and exhaust spreads it into air and soil, harming children’s cognitive development.
替代方案是提高汽油本身的抗爆性，比如改进炼油工艺、添加含氧化合物，同时提高发动机: Alternatives improve gasoline’s knock resistance through refining and oxygen-containing additives, together with engine improvements. Countries phased out leaded gasoline while adopting [[catalytic-converter|three-way catalytic converters]].
1921 年，通用汽车的米奇利（Thomas Midgley）发现四乙基铅的抗爆: General Motors’ Thomas Midgley discovered tetraethyl lead’s antiknock effect in 1921. Geochemist Clair Patterson exposed the extent of lead pollution in the 1960s. After Algeria exhausted its final stocks in 2021, the UN announced the global end of leaded gasoline use.
许多国家儿童的血铅水平大幅下降，研究认为这每年可避免上百万例过早死亡，经济收益数: Children’s blood-lead levels fell sharply in many countries. Research estimates the phaseout prevents over a million premature deaths annually and yields economic benefits measured in trillions of dollars.
全球淘汰破坏臭氧层的氟利昂，是最成功的国际环境协议之一。: The global phaseout of ozone-depleting CFCs became one of the most successful international environmental agreements.
氟利昂（CFC）非常稳定，能一直飘到平流层，在紫外线下释放出氯原子。一个氯原子作: CFCs are stable enough to reach the stratosphere, where ultraviolet light releases chlorine atoms. A single chlorine atom acts as a catalyst ([[p:catalysis|catalysis]]) destroying thousands or tens of thousands of ozone molecules. The ozone layer blocks much harmful solar ultraviolet radiation.
《蒙特利尔议定书》规定各国按时间表停止生产和使用 CFC 等物质，并设立基金资助: The Montreal Protocol schedules national phaseouts of CFC production and use and provides funding to help developing countries transition.
1974 年，莫利纳（Mario Molina）和罗兰（F. Sherwood: Mario Molina and F. Sherwood Rowland predicted CFC damage to ozone in 1974. The British Antarctic Survey discovered the ozone hole in 1985. The protocol was signed in 1987.
它是第一个获得全世界所有国家批准的联合国条约，臭氧层预计在本世纪中叶基本恢复；2: It became the first universally ratified UN treaty. The ozone layer is expected to broadly recover around mid-century. The 2016 Kigali Amendment added controls on HFCs, which are strong greenhouse gases.
用活性污泥中的微生物\"吃掉\"污水中的有机物，再沉淀、消毒后排放或回用。: Microorganisms in activated sludge consume organic matter in wastewater, followed by settling and disinfection before discharge or reuse.
污水里的有机物是细菌的食物。只要给细菌充足的氧气，它们就会把有机物\"吃\"成二: Wastewater’s organic matter feeds bacteria. With sufficient oxygen, they convert it into carbon dioxide and water and form settling flocs ([[p:germ|microorganisms]]). A wastewater plant is effectively a carefully managed microbial factory.
① 一级处理：格栅和沉淀池去除漂浮物和泥沙。: ① Primary treatment: screens and settling tanks remove floating debris and sediment.
② 二级处理：活性污泥法在曝气池中鼓入空气，富含微生物的污泥分解有机物，然后在二: ② Secondary treatment: air is bubbled into activated-sludge tanks, where microbes break down organics. Sludge settles in a secondary tank, with some returned for reuse.
③ 深度处理：去除氮和磷防止水体富营养化，再经过消毒；高标准的处理水可以回用，甚: ③ Advanced treatment: nitrogen and phosphorus are removed to prevent eutrophication, followed by disinfection. High-quality treated water can be reused, including as a source for drinking-water production.
1914 年，英国曼彻斯特的阿登（Edward Ardern）和洛克特（Will: Edward Ardern and William Lockett developed activated sludge in Manchester in 1914. It remains the world’s dominant wastewater-treatment process.
河流从\"露天下水道\"恢复了生态，伦敦泰晤士河重新有了鱼；新加坡用深度处理的再: Rivers recovered from functioning as open sewers; fish returned to London’s Thames. Singapore supplies some urban demand with advanced recycled water. Large quantities of wastewater worldwide nevertheless remain untreated.
用反渗透膜把海水中的盐分挡住，只让水分子通过，或用蒸馏法淡化。: Reverse-osmosis membranes retain salt while allowing water through; distillation provides another desalination route.
盐水和淡水之间隔着一层只让水分子通过的半透膜，水会自发流向盐水一侧，这就是渗透（: Across a semipermeable membrane, water naturally moves from fresh water toward salt water: osmosis ([[p:diffusion|diffusion]]). Applying pressure above osmotic pressure to the salty side reverses this flow, leaving salt behind. Separating salt and water requires energy ([[p:entropy|entropy]]).
海水经过预处理去除泥沙和微生物，高压泵加压到约 60 个大气压，送入卷式反渗透膜: Pretreated seawater is pressurized to about 60 atmospheres and sent through spiral-wound membranes. Roughly 40% becomes fresh water; concentrated brine returns to the sea. Energy-recovery devices transfer brine pressure to incoming water, reducing electricity use to about 3–4 kWh per ton of fresh water. Distillation is another route, widely used where energy is inexpensive in the Middle East.
1960 年前后，美国加州大学洛杉矶分校的洛布（Sidney Loeb）和索里拉: Around 1960, Sidney Loeb and Srinivasa Sourirajan at UCLA developed the first practical asymmetric reverse-osmosis membrane.
沙特、以色列和新加坡等缺水国家的大量饮用水来自海水淡化，以色列已从缺水国变成\": Water-scarce countries such as Saudi Arabia, Israel and Singapore obtain substantial drinking water through desalination. Israel moved from scarcity toward surplus. Costs include energy use and brine impacts on coastal ecosystems.
渗透与反渗透：自然状态下水从淡水一侧渗向盐水；施加超过渗透压的压力，水就被\"挤: Osmosis and reverse osmosis: water naturally crosses toward the saltier side. Pressure exceeding osmotic pressure pushes it back through the membrane toward the fresh-water side, leaving salt behind.
化肥和污水中的氮磷让藻类疯长、水体缺氧，需控制源头排放。: Nitrogen and phosphorus from fertilizer and wastewater cause algal blooms and oxygen depletion, requiring source controls.
氮和磷是植物生长的限制因素。化肥流失和污水把大量氮磷带进湖泊和近海，藻类疯狂繁殖: Nitrogen and phosphorus can limit plant growth. Fertilizer runoff and sewage supply excess nutrients to lakes and coasts, causing rapid algal growth ([[p:photosynthesis|photosynthesis]]). Bacteria decomposing dead algae consume oxygen, suffocating aquatic life and creating dead zones.
治理首先是控制源头：污水厂除磷脱氮、禁用含磷洗衣粉、科学施肥和建设湿地拦截农田径: Prevention begins at the source: remove wastewater nutrients, restrict phosphate detergents, improve fertilization and intercept farm runoff with wetlands. Sediment removal, algal harvesting and restoring aquatic plants can also help.
20 世纪 60 年代美国伊利湖严重富营养化，美加两国随后签署协议削减磷排放；2: Severe eutrophication in Lake Erie during the 1960s prompted US–Canadian agreements to reduce phosphorus. A 2007 bloom in Lake Taihu disrupted Wuxi’s water supply, spurring extensive lake restoration in China.
伊利湖等湖泊一度好转，说明控制磷有效；但农业面源污染难以管住，墨西哥湾等近海的季: Lake Erie’s initial recovery showed that phosphorus controls work. Agricultural diffuse pollution remains difficult to control, and seasonal coastal dead zones such as the Gulf of Mexico’s persist and expand.
高效空气过滤器能拦截 99.97% 的 0.3 微米颗粒，用于洁净室、医院和家用: High-efficiency filters capture 99.97% of 0.3-micrometer particles for cleanrooms, hospitals and home air cleaners.
小颗粒并不是被\"筛\"掉的，而是撞上纤维被粘住：大颗粒因惯性撞上，中等颗粒随气: Particles are not simply sieved out: they contact and adhere to fibers. Larger particles collide through inertia, intermediate particles are intercepted as they follow airflow, and very small particles wander into fibers through Brownian motion ([[p:diffusion|diffusion]]). Particles around 0.3 micrometers are especially difficult to capture, making them a test benchmark.
HEPA 滤材由直径不到一微米的玻璃纤维杂乱交织而成，折叠成大面积的滤芯；对 0: HEPA media contain randomly interwoven glass fibers less than a micrometer in diameter, folded into a large-area cartridge. The stated standard captures at least 99.97% of 0.3-micrometer particles, with higher efficiency for larger and smaller particles.
20 世纪 40 年代，美国曼哈顿计划为了拦截放射性尘埃而研制了这种高效过滤器，: The US Manhattan Project developed these high-efficiency filters in the 1940s to capture radioactive dust. Civilian applications followed.
它让芯片厂的 [[cleanroom|洁净室]]、医院的手术室和隔离病房成为可能: They support chip-factory [[cleanroom|cleanrooms]], operating rooms and hospital isolation facilities. Home air cleaners and N95 masks use related particle-capture principles.
向烟气或柴油车尾气中喷入氨或尿素，在催化剂上把氮氧化物还原成氮气和水。: Ammonia or urea injected into flue gas or diesel exhaust reacts over catalysts to convert nitrogen oxides into nitrogen and water.
氮氧化物会形成酸雨和光化学烟雾。在催化剂表面，氨能\"有选择地\"只与氮氧化物反: Nitrogen oxides contribute to acid rain and photochemical smog. A catalyst lets ammonia react selectively with nitrogen oxides rather than simply burning in oxygen, producing nitrogen and water ([[p:catalysis|catalysis]], [[p:redox|redox]]).
电厂在锅炉后的烟道中喷入氨气，烟气在约 300–400 °C 时流过钒钛等催化剂: Power plants inject ammonia downstream of boilers. Exhaust at about 300–400°C passes over catalysts such as vanadium/titanium compounds, removing 80–90% of nitrogen oxides. Diesel vehicles inject aqueous urea, which decomposes into ammonia and performs the same function.
20 世纪 70 年代，日本率先在燃煤电厂大规模应用 SCR；欧洲和中国后来把它: Japan pioneered large-scale SCR at coal plants in the 1970s. Europe and China later applied it to power plants and heavy-duty diesel emissions control.
电厂和柴油车的氮氧化物排放大幅下降；2015 年大众汽车的\"排放门\"事件，起: Nitrogen-oxide emissions from power plants and diesel vehicles fell sharply. Volkswagen’s 2015 emissions scandal involved cheating on tests to evade emissions-control requirements.
用自动监测站和低成本传感器实时测量 PM2.5、臭氧等污染物，数据公开推动了治理: Automatic stations and inexpensive sensors measure pollutants such as PM2.5 and ozone in real time. Public data encourages control measures.
看不见的污染无法管理。用光散射、β 射线吸收等方法实时测量 PM2.5、臭氧、二: Pollution that cannot be observed is hard to manage. Methods including light scattering and beta-ray absorption measure pollutants such as PM2.5, ozone and nitrogen dioxide ([[p:sampling|sampling]]). Public data lets people and governments track change and identify sources.
标准监测站用精密仪器连续测量并上传数据，换算成空气质量指数（AQI）；廉价的激光: Reference stations continuously measure with precision instruments, upload data and calculate an Air Quality Index. Cheap laser-particle sensors fill gaps through dense deployment, while satellites reveal regional patterns.
2008 年起，美国驻北京大使馆在社交网络上公布 PM2.5 读数，引发公众关注: From 2008, the US embassy in Beijing published PM2.5 readings on social media, drawing public attention. China added PM2.5 to air-quality standards in 2012, with cities publishing real-time observations from the following year.
Public data supported action. China launched its Air Pollution Prevention and Control Action Plan in 2013; Beijing’s annual average PM2.5 subsequently fell by roughly 60%.
用微生物、植物或工程手段清除土壤和地下水中的石油、重金属等污染。: Microorganisms, plants and engineering methods remove oil, heavy metals and other contamination from soil and groundwater.
很多微生物能把石油等有机污染物当作食物分解掉（[[p:redox|氧化还原]]）: Many microbes consume and decompose organic pollutants such as oil ([[p:redox|redox]]), while some plants absorb heavy metals. Providing suitable conditions accelerates these natural cleanup processes.
石油污染的土壤可以通过翻耕、通气、补充氮磷养分来促进微生物降解；地下水污染可以注: Tilling, aeration and added nitrogen/phosphorus can promote microbial oil degradation in soil. Groundwater treatment may inject nutrients or selected microbes. Heavy metals cannot be decomposed; they must be absorbed, immobilized or excavated for treatment.
1989 年阿拉斯加\"埃克森·瓦尔迪兹号\"漏油事故后，研究人员在海滩上施加肥: After the 1989 Exxon Valdez spill in Alaska, researchers applied fertilizer to beaches to accelerate oil degradation, creating a well-known bioremediation case.
生物修复成本低、扰动小，已被广泛用于工业场地和油田治理；但速度慢，对重金属和难降: Bioremediation is inexpensive and causes relatively little disturbance, supporting industrial-site and oil-field cleanup. It is slow, however, and has limited effectiveness for heavy metals and persistent pollutants.
把废金属、纸、玻璃和塑料分拣再生；回收铝只需原生铝约 5% 的能量。: Sorts and reprocesses metal, paper, glass and plastics. Recycling aluminum uses only about 5% of primary production’s energy.
从矿石中提炼金属要打破很强的化学键，耗能巨大；废金属已经是金属，只需重新熔化（[: Extracting metals from ore breaks strong chemical bonds and consumes substantial energy. Scrap is already metallic and mainly needs remelting ([[p:energy|energy conservation]]). Recycled aluminum uses about 5% of primary aluminum’s energy. Separating mixed waste is the central difficulty ([[p:entropy|entropy]]).
垃圾先在源头分类，再到分拣中心用磁铁选出钢铁，用涡流选出铝，用近红外光谱识别不同: Waste is separated at source, then sorted with magnets for steel, eddy currents for aluminum and near-infrared spectroscopy for plastics. Materials are baled for reprocessing. Paper is pulped and reformed; glass is melted and reshaped.
20 世纪 70 年代起，发达国家推广路边分类回收；2018 年起，中国禁止进口: Developed countries expanded curbside recycling from the 1970s. China’s restrictions on most imported waste from 2018 forced other countries to rebuild domestic recycling systems.
全球钢铁和铝的相当一部分来自回收料；回收也减少了填埋和开采，但垃圾混杂和再生料质: Recycled material supplies substantial shares of global steel and aluminum, reducing landfill and mining. Mixed waste and declining material quality limit repeated recycling.
塑料回收率低、易降级；碎成的微塑料已遍布海洋和人体。: Plastic recycling rates are low and material quality often declines. Microplastics now occur throughout oceans and in human bodies.
塑料是长链高分子（[[p:polymer|高分子]]），每次熔化再加工，链会断裂: Plastics are long-chain polymers ([[p:polymer|polymers]]). Melting and reprocessing can shorten chains and reduce performance, while different plastics generally cannot be melted together. Many plastics can therefore undergo only a few rounds of downcycling.
机械回收把同一种塑料洗净、粉碎、熔化造粒；化学回收把塑料分解回单体或油品再重新合: Mechanical recycling cleans, shreds, melts and pelletizes one plastic type. Chemical recycling breaks plastics into monomers or oils for resynthesis but uses more energy. Sunlight and abrasion fragment environmental plastic into particles under 5 mm, which are extremely difficult to recover.
研究估计，人类生产过的塑料中只有约 9% 被回收过；2004 年英国海洋生物学家: Research estimates that only about 9% of all plastic ever produced has been recycled. British marine biologist Richard Thompson introduced the term “microplastics” in 2004.
微塑料已在深海、极地乃至人的血液中被检测到；减少一次性塑料、统一包装材料和推动全: Microplastics have been detected in deep oceans, polar regions and human blood. Reducing single-use plastics, standardizing packaging and pursuing a global plastics treaty are emerging policy directions.
高温焚烧城市垃圾减容并发电，需要严格控制二噁英等污染。: High-temperature waste incineration reduces volume and generates electricity, requiring strict control of pollutants such as dioxins.
城市垃圾中的纸、塑料和厨余含有化学能（[[p:bond|化学能]]），高温燃烧可: Paper, plastic and food waste contain chemical energy ([[p:bond|chemical energy]]). Combustion can cut volume by roughly 90% and supply heat for electricity. Complete combustion and stringent flue-gas treatment are essential.
垃圾在炉排上以 850 °C 以上的温度燃烧，并保持足够长的时间以分解二噁英，余: Waste burns on grates above 850°C for sufficient time to destroy dioxins. A heat-recovery boiler supplies steam to a turbine. Exhaust undergoes acid-gas removal, activated-carbon adsorption and bag filtration. Bottom ash may become building material; fly ash is handled as hazardous waste.
1874 年，英国诺丁汉建成了早期的垃圾焚烧炉；20 世纪 70 年代发现焚烧会: An early waste incinerator opened in Nottingham in 1874. Discoveries of dioxin formation in the 1970s led countries to tighten emissions standards sharply.
日本、北欧和中国等土地紧张的地区大量依靠焚烧发电，减少了填埋；但它也会降低回收的: Land-constrained regions including Japan, northern Europe and China rely heavily on waste-to-energy, reducing landfill. It can weaken recycling incentives and often faces local opposition.
主动大规模干预气候，如向平流层喷洒气溶胶反射阳光，风险和治理问题巨大。: Proposes large-scale intervention in climate, such as reflecting sunlight with stratospheric aerosols, with major risks and governance challenges.
