1839 年美国人威廉·奥蒂斯（William Otis）获得蒸汽铲专利。20: William Otis patented the steam shovel in the United States in 1839. Hydraulic excavators and tower cranes spread in the mid-twentieth century. Hans Liebherr introduced a rapidly assembled tower crane in Germany in 1949.
工程机械让大坝、高速公路和高楼的建设速度提高了几个数量级。: Construction machinery increased the achievable scale and speed of dam, highway and high-rise projects by orders of magnitude.
把木板交错胶合成大型承重构件，可以建造十几层高的木结构建筑。: Layered timber forms large structural components for multistory wooden buildings.
天然木材顺纹很强、横纹很弱，而且有节疤和裂缝；把木板一层层交错胶合，各个方向的弱: Natural wood is strong along the grain but weaker across it, with knots and cracks adding variability. Bonding boards in alternating directions combines strengths and produces more uniform behavior ([[p:structure|structure determines properties]]).
**交叉层压木材**（CLT）把多层木板按纵横交替的方向胶合压制成大板，可以直接: **Cross-laminated timber**, CLT, bonds alternating board layers into large wall and floor panels. **Glulam** forms long-span beams and columns. CNC-made factory components are assembled on site. Large timber sections char at the surface during fire, forming a protective layer and providing better resistance than often assumed.
CLT 于 1990 年代在奥地利和德国发展起来。2022 年美国密尔沃基建成: CLT developed in Austria and Germany during the 1990s. Milwaukee’s 25-story Ascent timber residential tower opened in 2022 at roughly 87 meters.
木材生长时吸收二氧化碳，用它替代部分钢和混凝土可以降低建筑的碳排放，欧洲和北美正: Growing trees absorb carbon dioxide, and substituting timber for some steel and concrete can lower construction emissions. Europe and North America have been relaxing height limits for timber buildings.
把复杂结构切成成千上万个小单元分别计算受力再拼回整体，是现代结构设计的计算基础。: Divides complex structures into thousands of small elements, calculates their behavior and combines the results—a foundation of modern engineering analysis.
复杂形状的受力算不出解析解，但切成足够小的简单单元后，每个单元的受力都很好算；再: Complex shapes rarely have convenient exact solutions. Dividing them into simple elements makes local behavior manageable. Enforcing compatible displacements at shared boundaries combines them into an approximate whole-structure solution ([[p:stress|stress]], [[p:abstraction|divide and conquer]]).
软件把结构划分成成千上万个三角形或四面体网格，对每个单元列出受力方程，组装成一个: Software meshes a structure into thousands or tens of thousands of triangles or tetrahedra, formulates each element’s equations and assembles a large system for numerical solution.
1956 年美国波音公司的特纳（M. J. Turner）与克拉夫（Ray Cl: M. J. Turner, Ray Clough and colleagues published an element-based aircraft structural method in 1956. Clough introduced the term “finite element” in 1960.
从摩天大楼、桥梁到汽车碰撞、芯片散热，几乎所有工程设计都先在有限元软件里\"试\: Finite-element simulation supports skyscrapers, bridges, vehicle crashes, chip cooling and many other designs before physical construction (see [[scientific-computing]]).
用桩基和沉箱把高楼和大桥的重量传到深处坚硬的土层或岩层上。: Piles and caissons transfer the weight of tall buildings and bridges into deeper, stronger soil or rock.
再结实的楼，最终都要把全部重量交给大地；表层软土承受不了，就要把力一直传到深处坚: Every structure ultimately transfers its weight to the ground. If near-surface soil is too weak, foundations carry forces down to stronger layers ([[p:stress|stress]], [[p:gravity|gravity]]).
**桩基**把钢筋混凝土桩打入或钻孔灌注到几十米深，靠桩底的支撑和桩身与土的摩擦: **Piles** are driven or cast in drilled holes tens of meters deep, carrying load through tip resistance and shaft friction. **Caissons** are large open-bottom chambers sunk by excavation and later filled with concrete. Soft-ground construction also manages groundwater and settlement.
1870 年代修建纽约布鲁克林大桥时，工人在高压空气沉箱里作业，许多人上浮后患上: During Brooklyn Bridge construction in the 1870s, workers excavated in compressed-air caissons. Many developed decompression sickness after returning to normal pressure; chief engineer Washington Roebling was severely affected.
深基础让上海、迪拜等软土或沙地城市也能建起数百米高的楼。: Deep foundations allow towers hundreds of meters high even in soft-soil or sandy cities such as Shanghai and Dubai.
网架、穹顶、壳体和张拉膜结构让体育场、机场和展馆不用中间立柱就能覆盖巨大空间。: Space frames, domes, shells and tensioned membranes cover enormous stadium, airport and exhibition spaces without central columns.
跨度越大，梁自身的重量越难承受（[[p:squarecube|平方—立方定律]]: Long spans make a beam’s own weight increasingly burdensome ([[p:squarecube|square–cube law]]). Efficient forms emphasize tension or compression rather than bending: arches and domes mainly compress, cables and membranes carry tension, and space frames distribute forces through many short members ([[p:stress|stress]]).
**网架和网壳**由钢管和节点球组成三维杆系；**穹顶**和**壳体**用曲面把: **Space frames and gridshells** use three-dimensional networks of members and joints. **Domes and shells** carry loads along curved surfaces to their edges. **Tensioned membranes** stretch high-strength fabric with cables, weighing a fraction of conventional roofs.
1950 年代美国人巴克敏斯特·富勒（Buckminster Fuller）推广: Buckminster Fuller promoted geodesic domes in the 1950s. German architect Frei Otto helped design the cable-net roof of Munich’s 1972 Olympic stadium.
体育场、机场航站楼和会展中心得以拥有上百米的无柱空间。: Stadiums, terminals and exhibition centers gained column-free spaces spanning over a hundred meters.
循环运转的阶梯输送带，能连续不断地运送大量人流，是地铁站和商场的标配。: A continuously circulating staircase carries large flows of people and is standard in metro stations and shopping centers.
电梯一次运一批人、要等；扶梯是一条不停转动的环形阶梯，人流可以连续通过，运量远大: Elevators move batches with waiting intervals. Escalators circulate continuously, providing high capacity over short vertical distances as motors continually supply [[p:energy|energy]].
一串阶梯板连在两条循环链条上，由顶部的电机驱动；每级阶梯的轮子沿两条高度不同的导: Steps attach to two circulating chains driven at the top. Their wheels follow offset guide tracks, forming stairs on the slope and flattening at the ends. Handrails move with the steps, while comb plates help keep objects out of gaps.
1896 年美国人杰西·雷诺（Jesse Reno）在纽约科尼岛安装了一部可工作: Jesse Reno installed a working inclined lift at Coney Island in 1896. An Otis escalator won recognition at the 1900 Paris Exposition; “Escalator” began as a trademark.
扶梯让地铁站、商场和机场可以向地下和高层延伸，大城市的地下交通枢纽离不开它。: Escalators connect underground and upper levels in stations, shops and airports, becoming essential in large urban transport interchanges.
用高强度钢缆把桥面挂起来，单跨可超过 2000 米。: High-strength cables suspend a bridge deck, allowing main spans beyond 2,000 meters.
钢缆只受拉，而钢在受拉时最能发挥强度；把桥面挂在两座高塔之间的主缆上，重量变成缆: Cables work in tension, efficiently using steel’s strength. Hanging a deck from main cables between towers converts weight into cable tension, carried through towers to foundations and restrained by end anchorages ([[p:stress|stress and material strength]]).
**悬索桥**的主缆由数万根钢丝组成，跨过塔顶锚固在两岸巨大的锚碇里，吊索从主缆: **Suspension bridges** use main cables made of tens of thousands of wires over towers and into large anchorages, with vertical hangers supporting the deck. **Cable-stayed bridges** connect inclined cables directly from towers to deck, avoiding separate anchorages and suiting medium spans. Long spans require streamlined decks and wind-tunnel testing.
1883 年纽约布鲁克林大桥建成，首次大规模使用钢丝主缆，由罗布林父子设计。19: The Brooklyn Bridge, completed in 1883 and designed by the Roeblings, pioneered large-scale steel-wire main cables. Washington State’s Tacoma Narrows Bridge collapsed in torsional oscillation in moderate winds in 1940, making aerodynamic testing essential. Turkey’s 1915 Çanakkale Bridge opened in 2022 with a 2,023-meter main span, the longest suspension span in the manuscript’s account.
悬索桥让海峡和大河两岸可以用一跨连通，不必在深水中建桥墩。: Suspension bridges cross straits and large rivers in a single span without piers in deep water.
悬索桥的力流：桥面重量 → 吊索 → 主缆（受拉）→ 塔（受压）和两岸锚碇。斜拉: Suspension-bridge load path: deck → hangers → main cables in tension → towers in compression and shore anchorages. Cable-stayed bridges omit the separate anchorages.
前端刀盘切削岩土、后方同步拼装管片，在城市地下安全掘进。: A rotating front cutter excavates soil or rock while lining segments are assembled behind it, enabling controlled underground tunneling.
在软土或岩层中挖隧道，最大的风险是还没来得及支护就塌方；盾构的思路是\"边挖边撑: Unsupported ground can collapse before a tunnel lining is installed. A shield protects the freshly excavated space with a strong cylinder while permanent lining is assembled inside it: excavate and support together ([[p:stress|stress]], [[p:leverage|mechanical advantage]]).
现代隧道掘进机前端是旋转刀盘，切下的岩土通过螺旋输送机或泥浆管道运出；液压油缸顶: A rotating cutterhead excavates material, removed by screw conveyor or slurry pipes. Hydraulic cylinders push against completed lining segments to advance. Earth-pressure or slurry-pressure systems stabilize the face and limit settlement. A full machine can exceed a hundred meters in length, functioning as a moving underground factory.
1818 年法裔英国工程师马克·布鲁内尔（Marc Isambard Brune: Marc Isambard Brunel patented a tunneling shield in 1818 and began the Thames Tunnel in 1825; it opened in 1843. Switzerland’s 57-kilometer Gotthard Base Tunnel opened in 2016 as the longest railway tunnel.
盾构让城市地铁可以在楼群和河流下方安全施工，也让英吉利海峡隧道这类工程成为可能。: Shield tunneling allows metro construction beneath buildings and rivers and supports major crossings such as the Channel Tunnel.
混凝土大坝拦水发电、防洪和灌溉，如胡佛大坝和三峡大坝。: Concrete dams store water for power, flood control and irrigation, including Hoover Dam and the Three Gorges Dam.
水的压力随深度线性增大，坝底承受的水压最大，所以坝体要做成下宽上窄（[[p:fl: Water pressure rises with depth, making the base most heavily loaded and encouraging a wider lower section ([[p:fluid|fluid pressure]]). **Gravity dams** resist through their own weight; **arch dams** transfer water forces into the valley sides ([[p:gravity|gravity]]).
大坝蓄起的水具有势能，经引水管道冲击水轮机发电（见 [[hydropower]]: Stored water’s potential energy drives turbines through penstocks (see [[hydropower]]). Reservoirs also hold floods and supply irrigation and water during dry periods. Cement hydration in massive pours generates heat, so staged placement and embedded cooling pipes help prevent thermal cracking.
1936 年美国胡佛大坝建成，高 221 米，首次大规模使用埋管冷却技术。200: The 221-meter Hoover Dam was completed in 1936, pioneering large-scale embedded cooling pipes. The main Three Gorges Dam structure was completed in 2006; its power station’s roughly 22.5 GW capacity makes it the world’s largest hydroelectric plant in the manuscript’s account.
大坝提供了防洪、灌溉和清洁电力；代价是移民、泥沙淤积、鱼类洄游受阻和下游生态改变: Dams provide flood protection, irrigation and low-carbon electricity. Costs include displacement, sediment accumulation, blocked fish migration and altered downstream ecosystems.
堤坝、闸门和蓄滞洪区组成的系统，荷兰三角洲工程是代表。: A system of dikes, gates and temporary flood-storage areas, exemplified by the Netherlands’ Delta Works.
洪水是水在 [[p:gravity|重力]]作用下寻找出路；防洪就是给水\"安排: Floodwater seeks lower ground under [[p:gravity|gravity]]. Flood management gives it controlled destinations: hold it back, divert it, store it temporarily or leave space for it ([[p:fluid|fluids]]).
堤防和防洪墙把水挡在河道里；水库和蓄滞洪区在洪峰时暂存洪水；挡潮闸在风暴潮来临时: Dikes and walls contain rivers; reservoirs and designated flood areas temporarily store peak flows. Storm-surge barriers close during dangerous tides and reopen for navigation and ecology. Forecasts and hydrological models guide operation in advance.
1953 年北海大洪水造成荷兰约 1800 人死亡，1958 年荷兰通过《三角洲: The 1953 North Sea flood killed about 1,800 people in the Netherlands. The 1958 Delta Act launched the Delta Works. Its Maeslant barrier opened in 1997 with two gates about 210 meters long each. London’s Thames Barrier was completed in 1982.
荷兰约四分之一的国土低于海平面，三角洲工程让它能长期安全生存。海平面上升让各国防: About a quarter of the Netherlands lies below sea level, making flood defenses fundamental to long-term safety. Rising seas require countries to reassess protection standards.
英法海底隧道（1994）、港珠澳大桥（2018）等把桥、岛、隧组合跨越海峡。: Major sea crossings, including the Channel Tunnel (1994) and Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao Bridge (2018), use tunnels or combinations of bridges, islands and tunnels.
深水中建桥墩又难又贵，海底隧道又要防水和通风；把桥、人工岛和隧道组合起来，让航道: Deep-water bridge piers are difficult and expensive, while subsea tunnels require water control and ventilation. Combining bridges, artificial islands and tunnels can preserve navigation channels while managing these constraints ([[p:stress|stress]]).
浅水段用桥梁，主航道段转入沉管隧道（在岸边预制巨型管段，浮运到位后沉入海底挖好的: Some crossings use bridges in shallow water and immersed tunnels under shipping channels. Large prefabricated tunnel sections are floated into place, sunk into prepared trenches and joined, with artificial islands connecting bridge and tunnel sections.
1994 年英法海底隧道通车，全长约 50 公里，海底段约 38 公里。2000: The Channel Tunnel opened in 1994 at about 50 km overall, including roughly 38 km beneath the sea. The Øresund crossing between Denmark and Sweden opened in 2000. The Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao crossing opened in 2018 at about 55 km, including a 6.7-km immersed tunnel.
跨海通道把岛屿和海峡两岸的城市连成一小时通勤圈。: Sea crossings connect islands and cities across straits into roughly hour-scale commuting regions.
1779 年英国建成第一座铸铁拱桥；桁架用三角形把荷载分解成杆件的拉与压，让铁路: Britain completed the first cast-iron arch bridge in 1779. Triangulated trusses turn loads into member tension and compression, carrying railways across valleys.
铸铁抗压强、抗拉弱，所以第一座铁桥做成只受压的拱；后来的桁架用三角形把荷载分解成: Cast iron is strong in compression but weak in tension, favoring an arch. Later trusses use stable triangles to distribute loads largely as axial tension and compression, spanning efficiently with less material ([[p:stress|stress]]).
桁架桥由上下弦杆和斜腹杆组成一个个三角形，杆件在节点处用销钉、铆钉或螺栓连接。不: Top and bottom chords and diagonal members form a series of triangles, joined by pins, rivets or bolts. Arrangements such as Pratt and Warren trusses distribute forces differently.
1779 年英国什罗普郡建成的铁桥（The Iron Bridge），由亚伯拉罕: The Iron Bridge in Shropshire, cast by Abraham Darby III’s works and completed in 1779, was the first cast-iron arch bridge. Pratt, Warren and other truss forms emerged in the 1840s and spread with European and American railways.
铁桥和桁架桥让铁路可以跨越河谷，也开启了用计算设计结构的工程学。: Iron and truss bridges carried railways across valleys and advanced structural engineering based on calculation.
用挖泥船疏浚航道、吹填泥沙造出新陆地，许多港口、机场和新城区都建在填海土地上。: Dredgers deepen navigation channels and move sediment to create land used for ports, airports and new districts.
海底的泥沙可以被挖起、输送、再堆积到别处；只要堆得够高、压得够实，并筑堤挡住海浪: Seabed sediment can be excavated, transported and deposited elsewhere. Raising and compacting it above water, with protective dikes, creates land ([[p:gravity|gravity]], [[p:fluid|fluids]]).
绞吸式或耙吸式挖泥船把海底泥沙吸起，通过管道吹填到围堰内，再经排水、堆载预压让地: Cutter-suction or trailing-suction dredgers pump sediment into enclosed areas. Drainage and preloading consolidate the ground. Dutch polders use a different approach: enclose water behind dikes and pump it out, creating land below sea level.
荷兰从中世纪起就修堤造田，1932 年建成长约 32 公里的阿夫鲁戴克拦海大堤。: The Netherlands has reclaimed land since medieval times and completed the roughly 32-km Afsluitdijk in 1932. Singapore expanded its land area by about a quarter after independence. Kansai Airport (1994) and Hong Kong International Airport (1998) were built on artificial islands.
填海缓解了沿海城市的用地压力，但会破坏滩涂湿地，填海地也面临沉降问题。: Reclamation eases coastal land shortages but damages tidal wetlands and can create long-term settlement problems.
用地下管网把污水排出城市，伦敦在 1858 年\"大恶臭\"后修建了现代下水道。: Underground networks remove urban wastewater. London built modern intercepting sewers after the 1858 Great Stink.
霍乱、伤寒等疾病通过被粪便污染的水传播（[[p:germ|病原体学说]]）；只要: Cholera and typhoid spread through fecally contaminated water ([[p:germ|germ theory]]). Separating sewage from drinking water breaks transmission routes. Sloping pipes use [[p:gravity|gravity]] to convey sewage without continuous pumping where terrain permits.
每栋房屋的排水管汇入街道下的支管，再汇入越来越粗的干管，按一定坡度流向下游；在地: Building drains feed street branches and larger trunks flowing downhill. Pump stations lift water from low areas, and sewage reaches [[wastewater-treatment|treatment plants]]. Older combined systems mix rainwater and sewage and can overflow in storms; newer districts often separate them.
1854 年伦敦医生约翰·斯诺（John Snow）通过绘制病例地图，把一次霍乱: John Snow traced a London cholera outbreak to a contaminated pump in 1854 by mapping cases. The Thames’s Great Stink in 1858 prompted parliamentary funding. Joseph Bazalgette led construction of intercepting sewers, with major works opening in 1865 and helping eliminate recurring cholera from London.
下水道和自来水一起，被许多医学史学者认为是 19 世纪延长人类寿命最多的公共卫生: Many medical historians regard sewerage and clean water as among the nineteenth century’s greatest life-extending public-health measures.
经混凝、沉淀、过滤和消毒把河水变成可饮用的自来水，通过管网送到千家万户。: Coagulation, settling, filtration and disinfection turn source water into drinking water distributed through pipes.
河水里的泥沙、细菌和病毒可以分步去除：让细小颗粒抱团沉下去，用砂层滤掉残余，最后: Sediment and pathogens are removed in stages: fine particles aggregate and settle, sand captures remaining particles, and disinfection inactivates pathogens ([[p:germ|germ theory]], [[p:diffusion|filtration]]).
原水先加入混凝剂，使微小悬浮物结成较大的絮体，在沉淀池中沉降；再经砂滤池过滤；最: Coagulants form larger flocs from suspended particles for settling. Water then passes through sand filters and is disinfected with chlorine, ozone or ultraviolet light (see [[water-chlorination]]) before pressurized distribution. A small chlorine residual helps protect against recontamination in pipes.
1804 年苏格兰佩斯利的约翰·吉布（John Gibb）建成早期的砂滤供水系统: John Gibb built an early sand-filtered supply in Paisley, Scotland, in 1804. London’s Chelsea Waterworks adopted slow sand filtration in 1829. Widespread chlorination in the early twentieth century sharply reduced typhoid and other waterborne diseases.
拧开水龙头就能喝到安全的水，是现代城市最基本、也最容易被忽视的技术。: Safe water at the turn of a tap is one of the most fundamental—and easily overlooked—technologies of modern cities.
带 S 形存水弯的马桶用一段水封挡住下水道臭气。: A toilet’s S-shaped trap retains a water seal that blocks sewer gases.
U 形或 S 形的存水弯里始终留着一段水，水封把下水道的臭气挡在外面；冲水时一股: Water remaining in a U- or S-shaped trap separates indoor air from sewer gases. In siphonic toilets, a large flush initiates flow that carries waste through the trap ([[p:fluid|fluid pressure]]).
按下冲水阀，水箱中的水快速灌入便池，水位升高后越过存水弯的顶点，形成虹吸把污物吸: Opening the flush valve rapidly empties the cistern into the bowl. Water rises over the trap’s crest and starts a siphon carrying waste away. A float valve refills the cistern, and the trap retains a fresh water seal.
1775 年英国钟表匠亚历山大·卡明（Alexander Cumming）为带: British watchmaker Alexander Cumming patented an S-trap flushing toilet in 1775. Joseph Bramah improved its valve in 1778. Toilets spread with urban sewer networks in the late nineteenth century.
抽水马桶让卫生间可以设在室内。今天全球仍有数十亿人缺乏安全管理的卫生设施，无需下: Flushing toilets made indoor bathrooms practical. Billions still lack safely managed sanitation, motivating designs that do not require sewer connections.
存水弯中的一段水封挡住臭气；冲水时水位越过弯顶形成虹吸，把污物一起带走。: Water held in the trap blocks sewer gases. During a siphonic flush, water passes the crest and carries waste out.
由锅炉或热电厂集中产热，通过管道把热水或蒸汽送到各个房间。: A boiler or combined heat-and-power plant supplies heat centrally through hot-water or steam pipes.
在一个地方集中、高效地把燃料变成热，再用水或蒸汽这种热容量大的介质把热量输送到各: Fuel is converted to heat efficiently at a central source, then water or steam carries that energy to rooms ([[p:heat|heat transfer]]).
锅炉或热电厂把水加热，经保温管道输送到楼内的暖气片或地暖盘管，热水在房间里放热后: Heated water travels through insulated pipes to radiators or floor loops, releases heat and returns for reheating. District systems can use power-station or industrial waste heat (see [[cogeneration]]), improving efficiency and reducing pollution compared with individual coal fires.
1850 年代俄国圣彼得堡的弗朗茨·桑加利（Franz San Galli）发明: Franz San Galli developed cast-iron radiators in St Petersburg in the 1850s. An early commercial district-heating system opened in Lockport, New York, in 1877. Central heating began spreading in northern Chinese cities in the 1950s.
集中供暖让寒冷地区的城市冬天变得舒适。今天的方向是用 [[heat-pump|热: District heating made cold-climate urban winters more comfortable. Current development emphasizes [[heat-pump|heat pumps]] and low-temperature waste heat instead of coal boilers.
温度升高时喷头自动打开洒水，让高层建筑的火灾死亡大幅减少。: Heat automatically activates sprinkler heads, greatly reducing building-fire deaths and damage.
火灾最好在刚起时就扑灭；喷头里的感温元件在温度升到约 68 摄氏度时破裂，只有着: Fire is easiest to control early. A heat-sensitive element, commonly rated around 68°C, opens the affected sprinkler. Nearby heads activate only when sufficiently heated, rather than flooding an entire building automatically ([[p:heat|heat]], [[p:phase|phase change]]).
管网中平时充满有压力的水，每个喷头被一个装有液体的小玻璃泡堵住。火焰加热使液体膨: Pressurized water fills the pipe network. A small liquid-filled glass bulb holds each head closed; heat expands the liquid until the bulb breaks. Water discharges and triggers an alarm, absorbing heat as it warms and evaporates.
1874 年美国人亨利·帕米利（Henry Parmelee）发明了早期实用的自: Henry Parmelee developed an early practical automatic sprinkler in the United States in 1874 to protect his piano factory. Frederick Grinnell made important improvements in 1881.
自动喷淋大大降低了建筑火灾的死亡和损失，如今高层建筑、商场和仓库在多数国家的规范: Automatic sprinklers sharply reduce fire losses and deaths. Many countries’ codes require them in specified high-rise, commercial and storage buildings.
靠保温、气密、遮阳和热回收让建筑几乎不需要主动供暖制冷。: Insulation, airtightness, shading and heat recovery minimize active heating and cooling needs.
建筑的能耗大部分用于抵消冷热的\"泄漏\"；把房子包得足够严实，再回收排出空气中: Much building energy compensates for unwanted heat transfer. A well-insulated, airtight envelope and heat recovery can make body heat, appliances and sunlight supply much of the remaining demand ([[p:heat|three modes of heat transfer]]).
**被动房**的要点：厚保温层、三层玻璃窗、消除冷桥、极高的气密性，加上带热回收: **Passive House** emphasizes thick insulation, triple glazing, minimal thermal bridges, airtightness and heat-recovery ventilation. **Green-building ratings**, including LEED and China’s standards, also assess broader energy and water performance.
1988 年瑞典的阿达姆松（Bo Adamson）和德国的法伊斯特（Wolfga: Bo Adamson of Sweden and Wolfgang Feist of Germany proposed the Passive House concept in 1988. The US LEED pilot rating system launched in 1998.
被动房的采暖需求只有普通建筑的十分之一左右。建筑运行约占全球终端能耗的三成，是实: Passive House heating needs can be around one-tenth those of conventional buildings. Building operation uses roughly 30% of global final energy, making it central to the [[energy-transition|energy transition]].
规划功能分区、交通和公共空间；\"15 分钟城市\"等理念强调步行可达。: Plans land uses, transport and public space. Ideas such as the 15-minute city emphasize walkable access.
城市的价值来自人与人之间的连接（[[p:network|网络效应]]）；规划就是: Cities derive value from connections between people ([[p:network|network effects]]). Planning balances land, transport and public space to make those connections convenient and life safer.
规划确定哪些地块用于居住、商业、工业和绿地，道路和公共交通如何布局，建筑能盖多高: Plans allocate housing, commerce, industry and green space, organize transport networks and set building height and density. Earlier approaches emphasized separated uses; current approaches increasingly favor mixed uses, transit-oriented development and walkability.
1853–1870 年奥斯曼主持的巴黎改造开辟了林荫大道和下水道；1961 年简: Haussmann’s Paris reconstruction from 1853 to 1870 added boulevards and sewers. Jane Jacobs criticized sweeping clearance in The Death and Life of Great American Cities (1961). Carlos Moreno proposed the 15-minute city in 2016.
规划决定了城市几十年的形态，一旦路网和用地定型就很难更改。: Planning shapes cities for decades because established street networks and land uses are difficult to change.
用传感器、数据和 AI 管理交通、能源、安防等城市运行。: Sensors, data and AI help manage urban transport, energy, safety and other services.
城市是一个巨大的系统；把交通、能源、水务的实时数据收集起来，就能像自动控制一样发: A city is a large interacting system. Real-time transport, energy and water data can reveal problems and guide adjustments, much like automatic control ([[p:feedback|feedback and control]]).
遍布城市的传感器、摄像头和 [[iot|物联网]]设备采集数据，汇入城市数据平台: Sensors, cameras and [[iot|Internet of Things]] devices feed city platforms. Algorithms adjust traffic signals, dispatch buses, warn of flooding and detect water leaks. Residents access public services and transport information through phones.
2000 年代后期 IBM 等公司推广\"智慧城市\"概念；韩国松岛新城和西班牙: IBM and others promoted smart-city concepts in the late 2000s. Songdo in South Korea and Barcelona are common examples. Hangzhou introduced its City Brain traffic-optimization system in 2016.
数据让城市管理更精细，也带来隐私、监控和数据垄断的担忧，以及\"技术先行、需求滞: Data supports finer-grained management but raises privacy, surveillance and monopoly concerns. Technology-led projects can also fail when actual needs lag behind ambitious infrastructure.
用透水铺装、绿地和调蓄池让城市像海绵一样吸收和缓释雨水，减轻内涝。: Permeable paving, green space and storage basins absorb and slowly release rainwater, reducing urban flooding.
城市硬化地面让雨水无法下渗，几乎全部变成地表径流，在很短时间内涌进下水道；给雨水: Impervious surfaces prevent infiltration and send rain rapidly into sewers. Providing space for infiltration, detention and storage delays and lowers peak runoff ([[p:fluid|fluids]], [[p:gravity|gravity]]).
透水铺装和下凹式绿地让雨水就地下渗；屋顶绿化和雨水花园先把雨水\"截留\"一会儿: Permeable paving and depressed green spaces encourage local infiltration. Green roofs and rain gardens retain water temporarily. Underground tanks and deep tunnels store stormwater for slower discharge or reuse afterward.
1990 年代美国提出\"低影响开发\"理念；2015 年中国启动海绵城市建设试: Low-impact development emerged in the United States in the 1990s. China launched Sponge City pilots in 2015. Tokyo’s Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel was completed in 2006, with a pressure-adjustment chamber nicknamed an underground temple.
雨洪管理把排水从\"尽快排走\"变成\"先留后排\"，是城市适应极端降雨的重要手: Stormwater management shifts from removing water as quickly as possible toward retaining and releasing it gradually, helping cities adapt to extreme rainfall.
探测到烟雾颗粒就发出警报，让人在火势变大前醒来逃生；1965 年出现首款低价家用: Detects smoke and sounds an early warning, including waking sleeping occupants. An inexpensive home model appeared in 1965.
火灾中致命的往往是烟而不是火，而且很多火灾发生在夜里人们熟睡时；烟雾颗粒会改变空: Smoke often kills before flames, and many fires begin while people sleep. Particles alter air conductivity or scatter light, changes that electronic sensors can detect ([[p:charge|charge]], [[p:photoelectric|photoelectric effect]]).
**离子式**报警器用微量放射源让一小块空气电离导电，烟雾颗粒进入后吸附离子使电: **Ionization alarms** use a tiny radioactive source to ionize air. Smoke captures ions and reduces current, triggering an alarm. **Photoelectric alarms** detect light scattered by smoke into a sensor inside a dark chamber.
1965 年美国人皮尔萨尔（Duane Pearsall）和彼得森（Stanle: Duane Pearsall and Stanley Peterson introduced an inexpensive battery-powered home smoke alarm in the United States in 1965.
几美元的报警器大大降低了住宅火灾死亡率，美国消防协会的统计显示，无有效报警器住宅: Low-cost alarms substantially reduce residential fire deaths. US National Fire Protection Association statistics cited in the manuscript show fatality rates more than twice as high in homes without working alarms.
把地图和各种空间数据分层叠放在计算机里分析，是城市规划、导航和应急管理的基础工具: Layers maps and spatial data in computers for analysis, supporting planning, navigation and emergency management.
几乎所有城市数据都带有\"在哪里\"的信息；把它们按坐标对齐、分层叠放，原本看不: Much urban information includes location. Aligning it by coordinates and overlaying layers exposes spatial relationships that were otherwise hidden ([[p:abstraction|layering]], [[p:sampling|digitization]]).
GIS 把世界存成两类数据：**矢量**（点、线、面，如道路、地块）和**栅格*: GIS represents the world as **vectors**—points, lines and polygons such as roads or plots—and **rasters**, grids such as satellite imagery or elevation. Users overlay layers, measure distances and analyze buffers or networks, for example counting schools within 500 meters of a metro station.
1854 年斯诺的霍乱地图常被视为空间分析的先驱。1960 年代加拿大人罗杰·汤: Snow’s 1854 cholera map is often treated as an early spatial-analysis example. Roger Tomlinson led development of the Canada Geographic Information System in the 1960s and became known as the father of GIS. Esri was founded in the United States in 1969.
GIS 是城市规划、交通、救灾和 [[digital-maps|数字地图]]的基: GIS underpins urban planning, transport, disaster response and [[digital-maps|digital maps]].

被攻破的往往不是密码算法本身，而是实现中的漏洞、弱密码、被盗的密钥或被骗的用户（: Failures often come from implementation flaws, weak passwords, stolen keys, or deceived users rather than the cryptographic algorithm itself (see [[phishing|phishing]]).
用同一把密钥加密和解密，把数据反复置换、代换、与密钥混合很多轮，直到输出看起来和: The same key encrypts and decrypts data. Repeated rounds of permutation, substitution, and mixing with the key make the output appear random ([[p:complexity|computational complexity]]). With a secure algorithm and no useful weakness, an attacker without the key must try possible keys.
存在一些\"陷门单向函数\"：正着算很容易，倒推极难，除非你掌握一个秘密的\"陷: Some mathematical operations are “trapdoor one-way functions”: easy to compute forward, but extremely hard to reverse without a secret “trapdoor” ([[p:oneway|one-way functions]]). Multiplying two large primes is easy, for example, while factoring a sufficiently large product is computationally impractical for classical computers (see [[rsa|RSA]]).
每个人生成一对数学上相关的密钥：**公钥**可以公布给全世界，**私钥**只有自: Each person generates two mathematically related keys: a **public key** that can be shared with everyone and a **private key** kept secret. A message encrypted with the public key can only be decrypted with its matching private key. A related use of a private key to sign and a public key to verify is a [[digital-signature|digital signature]].
公钥密码解决了\"从未见过面的人如何安全通信\"这一千年难题，是 [[https: Public-key cryptography solved the longstanding problem of how people who have never met can communicate securely. It underpins [[https-tls|HTTPS]], e-commerce, signed software updates, and cryptocurrencies.
它面临的新威胁是量子计算：[[shor-algorithm|Shor 算法]]理: A new threat is quantum computing: [[shor-algorithm|Shor’s algorithm]] could theoretically break RSA and elliptic-curve cryptography on a sufficiently capable quantum computer. This is driving migration to [[post-quantum-crypto|post-quantum cryptography]].
只有私钥持有者能生成某个签名，而任何人都能用公钥验证它（[[p:oneway|单: Only the private-key holder can generate a valid signature, while anyone can verify it with the public key ([[p:oneway|one-way functions]]). The signature is tied to a hash of the message: changing even one byte makes verification fail.
1988 年莫里斯蠕虫让网络安全第一次成为公众话题；2010 年 [[stuxn: The Morris Worm in 1988 made cybersecurity a public topic for the first time; the [[stuxnet|Stuxnet]] attack in 2010 showed that network attacks can cause physical destruction; the WannaCry ransomware in 2017 affected over 150 countries; the SolarWinds supply chain attack in 2020 penetrated numerous government agencies and enterprises. On July 19, 2024, a faulty update from security company CrowdStrike caused about 8.5 million Windows computers worldwide to blue screen, showing that security tools themselves can become single points of failure.

**能源 → 一切**：没有便宜的能量（第 1 篇），就没有钢铁、化肥、芯片和数: **Energy → Everything**: Without cheap energy (Chapter 1), there is no steel, fertilizer, chips, or data centers.
**材料 → 电子 → 计算 → 网络 → AI**：硅提纯（第 6 篇）造出晶: **Materials → Electronics → Computing → Networking → AI**: Purifying silicon (Chapter 6) creates transistors (Chapter 2); transistors compose computers (Chapter 3); computers connect to form the Internet (Chapter 4); data from the Internet and computing power from data centers trained artificial intelligence (Chapter 5).
**化学 → 农业 → 人口**：合成氨（第 6 篇）让化肥（第 11 篇）养活: **Chemistry → Agriculture → Population**: Synthetic ammonia (Chapter 6) enables fertilizer (Chapter 11) to sustain several billion people.
**微生物学 → 医学 → 寿命**：细菌理论、疫苗和抗生素（第 10 篇）让人: **Microbiology → Medicine → Lifespan**: Germ theory, vaccines, and antibiotics (Chapter 10) doubled average human lifespan approximately.
**火箭 → 卫星 → 导航与通信**：航天（第 9 篇）把 GPS 和卫星互联: **Rockets → Satellites → Navigation and Communication**: Spaceflight (Chapter 9) brought GPS and satellite internet into every mobile phone (Chapter 4).
